DiffGR00T: Execution-Aware Differentiable Training for Humanoid Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

humanoid whole-body control vision-language-action model execution-aware training action-conditioned world model differentiable training

简要说明：DiffGR00T 是一个用于人形全身 VLA 模型的端到端可微分训练框架，通过将 VLA 生成器与全身控制器及学习的世界模型耦合，利用执行感知的多步损失在 HumanoidArena 上将任务成功率提升 12.5 个百分点。

TLDR: DiffGR00T is an end-to-end differentiable training framework for humanoid whole-body VLA models that couples a VLA generator with a whole-body controller and a learned world model, enabling execution-aware multi-step losses to improve task success by 12.5 percentage points on HumanoidArena.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong results in arm-centric manipulation, yet humanoid whole-body control (WBC) requires dynamic balance and tightly coupled full-body coordination. Existing hierarchical humanoid VLAs typically decouple motion generation from physical execution, leaving tracking and balance errors unable to directly optimize the VLA generator. We propose DiffGR00T, an end-to-end differentiable training framework that couples GR00T N1.7 with SONIC, a pretrained whole-body behavior foundation model. To enable execution-aware differentiable training, we replace the non-differentiable simulator with a learned, action-conditioned world model, allowing multi-step body-execution losses to backpropagate through the frozen whole-body controller and the flow-matching sampler directly into the VLA action head. On four HumanoidArena simulation tasks, DiffGR00T improves average task success by 12.5 percentage points over the supervised base VLA (59.2% to 71.7%), demonstrating that execution-aware gradients effectively align high-level motion generation with closed-loop whole-body dynamics.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在臂部操控任务中取得了显著成果，然而人形全身控制（WBC）要求动态平衡与全身紧密耦合协调。现有分层式人形VLA通常将运动生成与物理执行解耦，导致跟踪误差和平衡误差无法直接优化VLA生成器。我们提出DiffGR00T，一种端到端可微分训练框架，将GR00T N1.7与SONIC（预训练的全身行为基础模型）耦合。为实现执行感知的可微分训练，我们用学习得到的动作条件世界模型替代不可微分的仿真器，使多步身体执行损失能够通过冻结的全身控制器和流匹配采样器直接反向传播至VLA动作头。在四项HumanoidArena仿真任务上，DiffGR00T相较监督基线VLA将平均任务成功率提升了12.5个百分点（从59.2%提升至71.7%），证明执行感知梯度能够有效将高层运动生成与闭环全身动力学对齐。

Authors: Sichen Wu, Qian Sun, Mengfan Liu, Weikai Qin, Bike Zhu, Hesheng Wang

DexWAC: A Unified World-Actor-Critic Model for Dexterous Robot Manipulation Manipulation

VLA World-Actor-Critic Dexterous Manipulation Bootstrap Critic PPO

简要说明：DexWAC 提出了一种统一的世界-演员-评论家模型，在单个预训练阶段联合学习动作、动态和值函数，通过想象轨迹和评论家引导的选择来改进灵巧操作策略。

TLDR: DexWAC proposes a unified world-actor-critic model that jointly learns action, dynamics, and value in a single pretraining stage, improving dexterous manipulation policies through imagined rollouts and critic-guided selection.

Abstract: Robot demonstrations provide more than actions to imitate: they reveal how actions change the world and how those changes contribute to task success. Recent world-action models (WAMs) extend vision-language-action (VLA) models with the first signal by jointly predicting actions and future observations, yet this predictive ability serves only as an auxiliary loss for policy learning. Meanwhile, most policy improvement methods learn dynamics and values in separate models, increasing training overhead and limiting representation sharing between these complementary objectives. We introduce DexWAC, a unified world-actor-critic model that jointly learns an actor, an action-conditioned world model, and a bootstrapped critic in a single robot pretraining stage. Our key insight is that visual prediction encourages control-relevant features, while value supervision promotes task-relevant representations; together, they shape a representation suited to policy learning. Built on an image-editing backbone, DexWAC predicts, for each action chunk, the visual latent and proprioception at its endpoint together with its reward and continuation, so the world model alone efficiently yields complete imagined transitions without generating intermediate video frames. After adapting the world model and critic on real rollouts, we improve the pretrained actor through either PPO on imagined rollouts or critic-guided best-of-$N$ selection. DexWAC surpasses the large-scale pretrained VLA and WAM baselines in simulation and achieves 75% average success on two real-world tasks, compared with 45% for $π_{0.5}$. Its world model is more accurate and faster than video-based baselines, and ablations confirm that learning dynamics and value together improves the policy.

摘要（中文）：机器人示范不仅提供了可模仿的动作，更揭示了动作如何改变世界，以及这些改变如何促成任务成功。近年来的世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过联合预测动作和未来观测，在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型基础上引入了第一个信号，然而这一预测能力仅作为策略学习的辅助损失函数使用。与此同时，大多数策略改进方法在独立模型中分别学习动力学和值函数，增加了训练开销，并限制了这两个互补目标之间的表征共享。我们提出DexWAC，一种统一的世界-演员-评论家模型，在单一机器人预训练阶段联合学习演员、动作条件世界模型和自举评论家。我们的关键洞见在于：视觉预测促使模型关注控制相关特征，而值监督则促进任务相关表征的形成；二者共同塑造出适合策略学习的表征。基于图像编辑骨干网络，DexWAC对每个动作块预测其端点的视觉潜变量和本体感觉，以及其奖励和延续信息，从而仅凭世界模型即可高效生成完整的想象转移，无需生成中间视频帧。在真实轨迹上适配世界模型和评论家后，我们通过基于想象轨迹的PPO或评论家引导的最佳-$N$选择来改进预训练演员。DexWAC在仿真中超越了大规模预训练的VLA和WAM基线，并在两个真实世界任务中达到75%的平均成功率，相比之下$\pi_{0.5}$仅为45%。其世界模型比基于视频的基线更准确且更快速，消融实验证实联合学习动力学和值函数能够改进策略。

Authors: Hongjia Liu, Dacheng Zhou, Minghao Fu, Chuanjun Guo, Tianze Wang, Qingtao Liu, He Wang, Li Yi

CodeWAM: A Code World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

world model executable code end-to-end autonomous driving closed-loop simulator planning

简要说明：CodeWAM将可执行代码融入驾驶世界模型，用代码表示自车动力学，用学习模型表示场景演化，在NAVSIM上提升了闭环驾驶指标，并在Hydra-MDP和DrivoR上无需额外训练即获得增益。

TLDR: CodeWAM integrates executable code into a driving world model, representing ego dynamics as code and scene evolution with a learned visual model. It improves closed-loop driving metrics on NAVSIM and demonstrates gains on Hydra-MDP and DrivoR without extra training.

Abstract: Driving world models anticipate action consequences through representations of how the world evolves. For autonomous driving, these representations must capture both the surrounding scene and the ego vehicle's motion under a candidate plan. We propose CodeWAM, a driving world model that incorporates executable code as part of its world representation. Code represents ego dynamics by expressing how the vehicle state evolves under plan execution, while a learned visual model captures scene-dependent consequences. Executing the code produces a candidate-conditioned motion sequence, which is evaluated relative to the prior plan and recorded motion history. The resulting execution consequences and learned scene outcomes jointly represent the candidate's future, enabling the planner to assess both what a plan may lead to and how the vehicle transitions into that future. The selected plan becomes part of the next decision's execution context, linking successive choices within the model. CodeWAM achieves 93.6 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, 92.1 EPDMS on v2 navtest, and 50.6 EPDMS on NAVHARD. Further experiments demonstrate improved pairwise execution consistency and gains on Hydra-MDP and DrivoR without additional training, supporting executable code as a complementary representation for driving world models.

摘要（中文）：驾驶世界模型通过对世界演化过程的表征来预测行动后果。在自动驾驶中，这些表征必须同时涵盖周围场景以及候选规划下自车的运动状态。我们提出CodeWAM，一种将可执行代码纳入其世界表征的驾驶世界模型。代码通过表达车辆状态在规划执行过程中的演化方式来表征自车动力学，而学习得到的视觉模型则捕捉与场景相关的后果。执行代码生成与候选规划条件化的运动序列，并与先前的规划及已记录的运动历史进行比对评估。由此产生的执行后果与学习得到的场景结果共同表征候选方案对应的未来状态，使规划器能够同时评估某一规划可能导致的结果以及车辆如何过渡至该未来状态。选定的规划成为下一次决策执行上下文的一部分，将模型中连续的选择联系起来。CodeWAM在NAVSIM v1 navtest上达到93.6 PDMS，在v2 navtest上达到92.1 EPDMS，在NAVHARD上达到50.6 EPDMS。进一步的实验表明，在无需额外训练的情况下，CodeWAM在成对执行一致性方面有所提升，并在Hydra-MDP和DrivoR上取得了增益，从而支持可执行代码作为驾驶世界模型的一种互补表征。

Authors: Zhisheng Chen, Jinpeng Wang, Beicheng Lou, Zhengwei Xie, Hao Wu, Rui Qian, Kun Wang, Vivian W. H. Wong

Any2Act: Scaling In-Context Robot Learning from Heterogeneous Demonstrations VLA

in-context learning robot foundation model heterogeneous demonstrations embodiment-grounded representation long-horizon tracking

简要说明：Any2Act 提出了一种用于机器人上下文学习的基础模型，通过将异构演示（人类视频、仿真、其他机器人）统一到执行器的相机布局和动作空间，使得无需微调即可从单个演示执行未见任务。

TLDR: Any2Act introduces a foundation model for robot in-context learning that unifies heterogeneous demonstrations (human videos, simulation, other robots) by expressing them in the executor's camera layout and action space, enabling unseen task execution from a single demonstration without fine-tuning.

Abstract: Robot in-context learning (ICL) enables a policy to perform unseen tasks by following contextual demonstrations, without task-specific fine-tuning. This is increasingly valuable as large language models reasoning at low frequency can specify tasks through demonstrations and delegate high-frequency execution to such a policy. However, methods conditioned on human videos are bounded by scarce human-robot pairs, while those conditioned on robot demonstrations accept only one or two source types at limited scale. We present Any2Act, a foundation model for robot ICL. Our key insight is that a demonstration should be expressed in the camera layout and action space of the robot that performs it (the executor), not of whoever provided it (the demonstrator). This unified embodiment-grounded representation decouples learning to follow from admitting a new source. Any2Act learns to follow once, from robot-to-robot pairs that already take this form in 1.2M real trajectories spanning 10K tasks. Human videos, simulation, UMI, and other robots are then translated into this representation, and source-routed adapters trained on only a few hundred pairs each absorb the residual gap while the pretrained model stays frozen. For long horizons, a training-free tracker feeds only the demonstration window around the executor's progress, bounding the context and rolling back to redo failed steps. From a single demonstration, Any2Act achieves 57.5% success on unseen tasks without fine-tuning, exceeding VLAs fine-tuned on 50 demonstrations per task; other demonstrators retain 74-91% of the success achieved with the executor's own demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：机器人情境学习（ICL）使策略能够通过跟随情境演示执行未见任务，而无需针对特定任务进行微调。随着低频推理的大语言模型能够通过演示指定任务并将高频执行委托给此类策略，这一能力正变得愈发重要。然而，基于人类视频的方法受限于稀缺的人-机器人配对数据，而基于机器人演示的方法仅能接受一两种来源类型且规模有限。我们提出Any2Act，一个用于机器人情境学习的基础模型。我们的关键洞察在于：演示应当以执行该演示的机器人（执行者）的相机布局和动作空间来表达，而非以提供演示的个体（示范者）的视角表达。这种统一的具身对齐表示将“学习跟随”与“接纳新来源”解耦。Any2Act仅需从已具备该形式的机器人-机器人配对中学习一次跟随能力，这些配对数据涵盖1.2M条真实轨迹，跨越10K个任务。人类视频、仿真、UMI及其他机器人的数据随后被转换为此表示形式，仅需少量配对数据（各数百对）训练源路由适配器以吸收残差差距，而预训练模型保持冻结状态。对于长时程任务，一个无需训练的目标跟踪器仅围绕执行者的进度提供演示窗口，从而限制上下文长度，并在失败步骤处回滚重试。仅凭单条演示，Any2Act在未见任务上无需微调即可达到57.5%的成功率，超越在每任务50条演示上微调的视频-语言-动作模型（VLA）；其他示范者的演示能保持执行者自身演示所取得成功的74-91%。

Authors: Ziang Ren, Zifan Wang, Zhuoyang Li, Benhao Qin, Haoyang Li, Qingtao Liu, Xuchuan Chen, Zekun Qi, He Wang, Yanchao Yang, Li Yi

EgoLoAF: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Egocentric Demonstrations with Hand-Object Affordances VLA

egocentric demonstrations hand-object affordances humanoid loco-manipulation VLA post-training cross-attention

简要说明：EgoLoAF提出了一种完全基于第一人称人类演示来训练人形VLA模型进行移动操作的新范式，去除了可穿戴追踪器和真实机器人遥操作数据的需求，通过跨注意力注入手-物可供性来引导动作生成，在真实任务上接近遥操作性能且数据收集效率提升4倍。

TLDR: EgoLoAF introduces a paradigm to train humanoid VLA models for loco-manipulation entirely from egocentric human demonstrations, eliminating wearable trackers and real-robot teleoperation data by estimating humanoid actions and using explicit hand-object affordances via cross-attention; it shows near-teleoperation performance on real tasks with a 4x data-collection efficiency gain.

Abstract: Training humanoid vision-language-action (VLA) models relies heavily on costly real-robot teleoperation. Recent efforts convert egocentric human demonstrations into humanoid training data. However, most methods still require wearable motion trackers and leave important hand-object interaction cues implicit. Many also mix in real-robot teleoperation data for VLA post-training. These dependencies limit scalable data collection, while implicit interaction cues make precise contact harder to learn. To overcome these limitations, we propose EgoLoAF, the first paradigm to derive all training data for humanoid loco-manipulation directly from egocentric demonstrations without wearable motion trackers. We post-train the VLA on the converted data alone, without real-robot teleoperation demonstrations, and use explicit hand-object interaction cues to guide action generation. Specifically, to obtain humanoid action targets, we estimate torso motion from recorded camera poses and reconstruct both hand trajectories from video. From the same recording, we use each hand's current pose relative to the object to represent hand-object affordances. During post-training, we inject these affordances into the action expert through cross-attention while keeping the vision-language backbone frozen. Additionally, we release 128,400 egocentric demonstration episodes spanning 1,000 hours and 1,284 tasks, together with converted humanoid action trajectories and rendered robot-view observations. Across four real-world tasks, EgoLoAF nearly achieves teleoperation performance (73.1 vs. 74.4 in mean Task Progress Score), while achieving a mean 4.03 times improvement in data-collection efficiency.

摘要（中文）：摘要：训练人形视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型严重依赖成本高昂的真实机器人遥操作。近期研究尝试将自我中心的人类演示数据转化为人体形态的训练数据。然而，多数方法仍需穿戴式运动追踪器，且对手-物交互关键线索的隐含处理不足。此外，许多方法在VLA后训练阶段仍混入真实机器人遥操作数据。上述依赖限制了数据采集的可扩展性，而隐含的交互线索则使精确接触更难学习。为克服这些局限，我们提出EgoLoAF——首个无需穿戴式运动追踪器、直接从自我中心演示中获取人形移动操作全部训练数据的范式。我们在仅使用转换所得数据的情况下对VLA进行后训练，不依赖真实机器人遥操作演示，并利用显式手-物交互线索引导动作生成。具体而言，为获取人形动作目标，我们从记录的相机位姿中估计躯干运动，并从视频中重建双手轨迹；基于同一段录像，以每只手相对于物体的当前位姿表征手-物可供性。在后训练阶段，我们通过交叉注意力将这些可供性信息注入动作专家模块，同时冻结视觉-语言骨干网络。此外，我们发布了包含128，400段自我中心演示片段的数据集，覆盖1，000小时、1，284项任务，同时提供转换后的人形动作轨迹及渲染的机器人视角观测。在四项真实世界任务中，EgoLoAF几乎达到遥操作性能水平（平均任务进度得分73.1对74.4），同时在数据采集效率上实现了平均4.03倍的提升。

Authors: Yiming Zeng, Jiangyuxuan Dai, Yuheng Na, Tan Zhu Xuan, Zihan Lin, Xinfang Qi, Shijian Zhang, Chengqi Shi, Yihan Kuang, Zhide Zhong, Junjie He, Junfeng Li, Zimu Han, Naipeng Li, Haoang Li

RoboDemo: Reconciling Demonstration Intent and Execution Progress for Long-Horizon Manipulation Manipulation

dual-cascaded test-time-training demonstration-augmented manipulation long-horizon manipulation interaction-progress memory real-world household tasks

简要说明：RoboDemo 提出了一种基于双级联测试时训练的演示增强操作框架，利用参考视频编码任务意图并跟踪在线交互进度，在长时程任务中取得了高成功率。

TLDR: RoboDemo introduces a demonstration-augmented manipulation framework with Dual-Cascaded Test-Time-Training, using reference videos to encode task intent and online interactions to track progress, achieving high success in long-horizon tasks.

Abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires more than predicting the next action from the current observation. The policy must maintain a global procedural prior that specifies the expected progress of each subtask stage, while also tracking the realized progress produced by its interactions. To this end, we propose RoboDemo, a demonstration-augmented manipulation framework built on Dual-Cascaded Test-Time-Training. RoboDemo accepts either a task-relevant human demonstration video or a semantically compatible robot video retrieved from simulation corpus as reference, allowing us to evaluate its applicability with and without paired human demonstrations. Task semantics and physical motion information from the reference video are then transferred into persistent demonstration-intent memory. During deployment, we causally compress online observations, robot states, and executed actions into interaction-progress memory. To keep reference intent stable while interaction progress continually evolves, reference and execution video tokens independently update their respective fast-weight states. The action expert performs cascaded memory reads, first obtaining reference guidance and then refining it using realized progress, allowing the policy to adapt to execution deviations without overwriting the stored intent. RoboDemo achieves 90.7% success on Imitator Game and 73.3% success across three real-world household tasks. Real-world videos, code and hf-weights are available in our project website.

摘要（中文）：长时程机器人操作任务的要求远不止于根据当前观测预测下一步动作。策略必须维护一个全局的过程先验，用以规定每个子任务阶段的预期进展，同时还要追踪其交互行为所产生的实际进展。为此，我们提出了RoboDemo，一个基于双级联测试时训练的演示增强操作框架。RoboDemo可以接受与任务相关的人类演示视频，或从仿真语料库中检索到的语义兼容的机器人视频作为参考，从而允许我们在有无配对人类演示的情况下评估其适用性。参考视频中的任务语义和物理运动信息随后被迁移至持久的演示意图记忆中。在部署阶段，我们对在线观测、机器人状态及已执行动作进行因果压缩，形成交互进度记忆。为使参考意图在交互进展持续演变过程中保持稳定，参考视频令牌与执行视频令牌分别独立更新各自的快速权重状态。动作专家执行级联记忆读取，首先获取参考引导，随后利用已实现进度对其进行细化，从而使策略能够适应执行偏差而无需覆盖已存储的意图。RoboDemo在模仿者游戏中达到90.7%的成功率，并在三个真实世界家务任务中达到73.3%的成功率。真实世界视频、代码及Hugging Face权重均可在我们的项目网站上获取。

Authors: Xiangkai Ma, Zhihao Yuan, Linbo Zhai, Xinyi Wang, Junjie Wang, Sheng Xu, Guiliang Liu, Han Zhang, Chuyi Chen, Jifeng Gao, Wenzhong Li

VLAs Execute, Code Recovers: 3D Skill Envelopes Bridge the Compositional Gap in Agentic Manipulation VLA

Skill Envelope VLA composition 3D geometric precondition code repair long-horizon manipulation

简要说明：本文提出技能包络（Skill Envelope），通过策略测量的三维几何先决条件预测碰撞并实现基于代码的状态修复，以改善冻结VLA技能在长期操作中的组合性能，在LIBERO-Goal基准上显著提升成功率。

TLDR: The paper introduces Skill Envelopes, policy-measured 3D geometric preconditions that predict collisions and enable code-based state repair to improve the composition of frozen VLA skills in long-horizon manipulation, significantly boosting success rates on LIBERO-Goal benchmarks.

Abstract: Composing frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) skills under an agentic planner promises scalable long-horizon manipulation without long-horizon demonstrations, yet strong atomic skills routinely fail at seams even under a correct plan. Standard remedies reset the robot's pose or draft entry conditions in language, missing the physical cause we uncover via causal interventions: even after re-homing, a frozen VLA rigidly retraces its habitual trajectory and collides with displaced scene residue, whether or not it can see it. We propose the Skill Envelope, a policy-measured 3D geometric precondition capturing the volume a frozen skill sweeps during successful executions. Exploiting the insight that the rigidity making a frozen skill fragile at seams also makes its trajectory predictable in advance, we expose each envelope as two classical 3D tools (CHECK to detect blocking residue and FREE to locate safe placement regions), establishing a division of labor where VLAs execute in-distribution manipulation and code repairs out-of-distribution states. On LIBERO-Goal with frozen $π_{0.5}$, our zero-failure envelope predicts collisions at 0.946 AUROC (0.944 from one RGB-D view) and beats frontier VLMs on seam readiness (0.902 vs. 0.793); using it for skill ordering and code repair lifts success from 82.8% to 92.3% on two-step seams and from 29.7% to 93.8% on drawer-bearing 3-4 step chains, matching privileged world reset. Together, these results show that reliable VLA composition hinges on measuring a policy's physical workspace rather than guessing preconditions in language. Ongoing work closes the loop with autonomous LLM orchestration, synthesized free-object recovery, and cross-policy evaluation on cluttered benchmarks and real hardware.

摘要（中文）：在智能体规划器下组合冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）技能，有望在无需长时程演示的情况下实现可扩展的长时程操作，然而即便在规划正确的情况下，强原子技能也常在衔接处失效。标准补救措施包括重置机器人位姿或以语言编写进入条件，但这些均未触及我们通过因果干预所发现的物理成因：即使在重新归位后，冻结的VLA仍会刚性复现其习惯性轨迹，并与移位后的场景残留物发生碰撞——无论其能否看见该残留物。我们提出“技能包络”（Skill Envelope），这是一种基于策略测量的三维几何前置条件，用于刻画冻结技能在成功执行过程中所扫过的体积。利用“使冻结技能在衔接处脆弱的刚性同时使其轨迹可提前预测”这一洞见，我们将每个包络呈现为两种经典三维工具（CHECK用于检测阻碍性残留物，FREE用于定位安全放置区域），从而建立分工机制：VLA负责分布内操作执行，代码负责修复分布外状态。在采用冻结$π_{0.5}$的LIBERO-Goal基准上，我们的零失败包络以0.946的AUROC预测碰撞（单RGB-D视角下为0.944），并在衔接就绪度上超越前沿VLM（0.902对比0.793）；将其用于技能排序和代码修复后，两步衔接任务成功率从82.8%提升至92.3%，抽屉-轴承类3至4步链式任务从29.7%提升至93.8%，与特权世界重置表现相当。综上，这些结果表明，可靠的VLA组合取决于对策略物理工作空间的测量，而非以语言猜测前置条件。后续工作将基于自主LLM编排、合成自由物体恢复以及杂波基准与真实硬件上的跨策略评估来闭环验证。

Authors: Jiajie Zhang, Yankai Xiang, Changhao Chen

Seeing Is Not Reaching: Instruction Shortcuts Override Visual Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

vision-language-action models shortcut learning visual grounding instruction following manipulation

简要说明：本文发现并分析了视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）中的两种捷径，导致模型在物体位置改变后仍伸向其训练位置；提出了一种无需训练的方法（PSG），通过增强视觉接地并抑制指令捷径，在LIBERO-PRO基准上显著提高了目标到达率和任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper identifies and analyzes two shortcuts in vision-language-action models (VLAs) that cause them to reach for an object's training location instead of its current location, and introduces a training-free method (PSG) that amplifies visual grounding and suppresses the instruction shortcut, significantly improving target-reaching and task success on LIBERO-PRO benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are expected to inherit visual grounding from vision-language models, yet often reach for an object's training location after it has been moved. Across six VLAs, we identify two shortcuts: a scene shortcut, where the arm follows the scene's original task despite a new instruction, and an instruction shortcut, where the instruction retrieves the requested object's training location. In $π_{0.5}$, the instruction shortcut persists even though object-name attention follows the moved target. We call this Seeing Is Not Reaching. To determine whether this grounding is unused or overridden, we separately mask an image-mediated grounding pathway and a direct instruction-to-action pathway. Masking the grounding pathway eliminates reaches to moved targets, whereas masking the direct pathway increases them. Thus, grounding already guides action but is often overridden by the instruction shortcut, which acts through the direct pathway. We introduce Pathway-Separated Guidance (PSG), which amplifies grounding and suppresses the shortcut without training or external target locations. On LIBERO-PRO Object under Position perturbations, PSG raises the target-reaching rate from 22.0% to 52.6% and task success from 16.6% to 40.8%, while largely preserving performance on the original tasks.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动模型（VLA）预期继承视觉-语言模型的视觉定位能力，然而在实际操作中，模型往往会在目标物体被移动后，仍伸向其训练时的位置。在六个VLA模型中，我们识别出两种捷径：场景捷径，即机械臂无视新的指令而遵循场景原有的任务；以及指令捷径，即指令检索出所请求物体在训练时的位置。在$π_{0.5}$中，即使物体名称的注意力已经跟随被移动的目标，指令捷径仍然存在。我们将此现象称为“看见并不等于触及”。为确定该定位能力是未被使用还是被覆盖，我们分别对图像介导的定位通路和直接指令到行动通路进行掩蔽。掩蔽定位通路会消除对移动后目标的触碰，而掩蔽直接通路则会增加这类触碰。由此可知，定位能力已经能够引导行动，但往往被通过直接通路起作用的指令捷径所覆盖。我们引入了通路分离引导（PSG），该方法在无需训练或外部目标位置的情况下，放大定位能力并抑制捷径效应。在位置扰动条件下的LIBERO-PRO Object任务中，PSG将目标触达率从22.0%提升至52.6%，任务成功率从16.6%提升至40.8%，同时在原始任务上基本保持原有性能。

Authors: Qing Zhang, Xuesong Li, Zhaoyuan Yang, Changlin Song, Xinyu Tian, Jing Zhang

KeyMemVLA: Subtask-Guided Key Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation VLA

long-horizon manipulation key memory subtask-guided VLA keyframe prediction

简要说明：KeyMemVLA提出了一种基于子任务引导的关键记忆框架，用于长期机器人操作，通过进度指示和决策证据保留选择关键帧来监督在线记忆写入，并在基准测试和真实世界任务中展示了更高的成功率。

TLDR: KeyMemVLA introduces a subtask-guided key memory framework for long-horizon robotic manipulation, using progress indication and decision-evidence retention to select keyframes that supervise online memory writes, and demonstrates improved success rates on benchmarks and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Memory-dependent long-horizon manipulation requires vision-language-action (VLA) policies to infer task progress and recall evidence absent from current observations. Under a limited memory budget, the challenge is to retain history that resolves stage ambiguity and supports subsequent decisions. We present KeyMemVLA, a subtask-guided key memory framework based on progress indication and decision-evidence retention. A two-level annotation process selects subtasks satisfying either criterion and labels their final frames as keyframes to supervise online memory writes. A shared vision-language backbone jointly learns subtask, action, and keyframe prediction. At inference, the policy first predicts the current subtask from the instruction, visual context, and memory, then uses this semantic condition to predict actions and future memory-write positions. Actual observations are retained at the selected times during execution. We introduce KMBench to evaluate active memory retention for decisions across subtasks. Evaluations on RMBench-$M(n)$, RoboTwin-MeM, KMBench, and real-world manipulation tasks show higher average success rates than the compared baselines. Ablation studies and representation analysis support the roles of key memory and explicit task-progress semantics. These results highlight the value of coupling sparse key memory with online progress inference for history-dependent control.

摘要（中文）：记忆依赖的长时程操作任务要求视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够推断任务进度，并回忆当前观测中缺失的证据。在有限记忆预算下，关键挑战在于保留既能消除阶段歧义又能支持后续决策的历史信息。我们提出KeyMemVLA，一种基于进度指示与决策证据保留的子任务引导式关键记忆框架。通过两级标注流程，选取满足任一判据的子任务，并将其末帧标注为关键帧，以监督在线记忆写入。共享的视觉-语言骨干网络联合学习子任务预测、动作预测与关键帧预测。在推理阶段，策略首先根据指令、视觉上下文和记忆预测当前子任务，随后利用该语义条件预测动作以及未来的记忆写入位置。在执行过程中，于选定时间点保留实际观测。我们引入KMBench基准，用于评估跨子任务决策中的主动记忆保留能力。在RMBench-$M(n)$、RoboTwin-MeM、KMBench及真实世界操作任务上的评估显示，其平均成功率优于对比基线。消融实验与表征分析验证了关键记忆和显式任务进度语义的作用。这些结果凸显了将稀疏关键记忆与在线进度推断相结合对于依赖历史信息的控制任务的重要价值。

Authors: Yongwei Zhang, Tao Chen, Sicheng Ma, Yuanzhe Xing, Pengwei Zhang, Yongen Zhao, Yaoqing Hu, Zhikun She, Ce Hao

VLG-Drive: Unifying Vision-Language and Geometric Priors for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

vision-language model geometric foundation model fusion interface trajectory planning closed-loop driving

简要说明：VLG-Drive 通过轻量级的几何锚定融合接口和命令条件规划器，融合冻结的视觉-语言与几何基础模型特征，在不微调任一主干网络的情况下，实现了自动驾驶闭环轨迹规划的最先进性能。

TLDR: VLG-Drive fuses frozen vision-language and geometric foundation model features via a lightweight geometric-anchored fusion interface and command-conditioned planner, achieving state-of-the-art closed-loop trajectory planning performance in autonomous driving without fine-tuning either backbone.

Abstract: A driving planner needs both scene semantics, which vision-language models (VLMs) provide, and spatial structure, which geometric foundation models recover from visual history. We present VLG-Drive, which keeps both models frozen and trains only a fusion interface and a planner from trajectory labels. At each camera-grid cell, the interface fuses the paired VLM and geometry features into one joint token through a geometry-anchored residual, and a command-conditioned planner reads these tokens to predict the ego trajectory. VLG-Drive achieves 31.78 EPDMS on NavHard under perturbed initial states, the highest among the compared methods, and 88.27 PDMS on NavTest from cameras alone. Pointwise fusion outperforms independent VLM and geometry streams on both benchmarks. In closed-loop driving on 420 HUGSIM scenarios, VLG-Drive outperforms all compared planners. These results indicate that a lightweight planner trained on fused features of frozen vision-language and geometric foundation models is an effective alternative to adapting either model for planning.

摘要（中文）：驾驶规划器需要场景语义（由视觉语言模型提供）和空间结构（由几何基础模型从视觉历史中恢复）的双重支持。我们提出VLG-Drive方法，该方法保持两个模型均冻结，仅训练融合接口和基于轨迹标签的规划器。在每个相机网格单元上，该接口通过几何锚定的残差机制将配对的视觉语言模型特征与几何特征融合为一个联合令牌，命令条件规划器读取这些令牌以预测自车轨迹。在扰动初始状态下的NavHard基准测试中，VLG-Drive取得了31.78的EPDMS，为所有对比方法中最高；在仅依赖摄像头的NavTest基准上取得了88.27的PDMS。逐点融合在两个基准上均优于独立的视觉语言模型和几何特征流。在420个HUGSIM场景的闭环驾驶测试中，VLG-Drive优于所有对比规划器。这些结果表明，在冻结的视觉语言模型和几何基础模型的融合特征上训练轻量级规划器，是替代对任一模型进行规划适配的有效方案。

Authors: Junge Zhang, Jie Zhu, Yanqi Jia, Xiangyu Xu, Zixun Huang, Wenbin He, Xin Li, Jiachen Li, Liu Ren

RESET: One Demonstration, One Verified World, Self-Improved Skills Across Embodiments Manipulation

world reconstruction self-improvement skill transfer embodied manipulation LLM coding agent

简要说明：RESET从单个真实演示中重建接触丰富的世界，通过开环重放和轮廓一致性验证，并根据失败证据自我改进模块化技能代码，在8个操作任务、4台真实机器人和3种异构体上实现高成功率。

TLDR: RESET reconstructs a contact-rich world from a single real demonstration, verifies it via open-loop replay and silhouette consistency, then self-improves modular skill code from per-node failure evidence, achieving high success across 8 manipulation tasks, 4 real robots, and 3 heterogeneous embodiments without target demonstrations.

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents can iteratively self-improve robot manipulation skills in simulation benchmarks, yet real-world tasks provide neither ground-truth success scorers nor resettable practice environments. Our key observation is that a single real demonstration simultaneously specifies scene geometry, defines the terminal success criterion, and serves as a physical reference trajectory for verifying world fidelity---all decoupled from the source robot's kinematics. We present {RESET}: we reconstruct a contact-rich world and derive a frozen read-only criterion from one demonstration ({R}ebuild); check that world against the demonstration by open-loop replay and silhouette consistency ({E}xamine); evolve modular white-box task graphs and skill code from per-node failure evidence ({S}elf-improve); deploy frozen code on real robots with zero runtime LLM calls ({E}xecute); and share the verified world and criterion with unseen robots without new demonstrations ({T}ransfer). On 8 manipulation tasks, each rebuilt from one real demonstration, RESET achieves 97% average success on unseen layouts in simulation, whereas zero-shot code reaches 27%, per-task fine-tuned pi0.5 policies 31%, and Diffusion Policy 50%; injecting reconstruction defects shows that practice tolerates many reconstruction errors, that geometric errors can still stall or mislead it, and that the check flags most of them while physical randomization covers the rest. Without any target demonstrations, 3 heterogeneous robots acquire the same task skills in the shared world: a robot with similar arms copies 95% of its skill functions unchanged from the source robot, while robots with different arms and hands write their own. In real-robot experiments, the resulting programs run on 4 robots and succeed in 80% of 280 trials.

摘要（中文）：大语言模型（LLM）编码智能体可以在仿真基准中迭代式地自我改进机器人操作技能，然而真实世界任务既不提供真实成功评分器，也不提供可重置的练习环境。我们的关键观察是：单次真实演示能够同时指定场景几何、定义终端成功标准，并作为验证世界保真度的物理参考轨迹——所有这些都与源机器人的运动学解耦。我们提出{RESET}：我们从一次演示中重建接触丰富的世界并推导出冻结的只读标准（{R}ebuild，重建）；通过开环重放和轮廓一致性对照演示检验该世界（{E}xamine，检验）；根据逐节点失败证据演化模块化白盒任务图及技能代码（{S}elf-improve，自我改进）；在真实机器人上部署冻结代码且运行时零LLM调用（{E}xecute，执行）；并将经过验证的世界和标准分享给未见过的机器人而无需新增演示（{T}ransfer，迁移）。在8个操作任务上，每个任务均由一次真实演示重建，RESET在仿真的未见布局中实现了97%的平均成功率，而零样本代码仅达到27%，每任务微调的pi0.5策略达到31%，扩散策略达到50%；注入重建缺陷的实验中显示：练习能够容忍许多重建误差，几何误差仍可能使其停滞或误导其行为，而检查环节能标记出其中大部分误差，物理随机化则覆盖其余部分。在没有目标任务演示的情况下，3台异构机器人在共享世界中习得相同的任务技能：具有相似机械臂的机器人从源机器人处原样复制其95%的技能函数，而具有不同机械臂和手爪的机器人则编写自身的技能函数。在真实机器人实验中，所生成的程序在4台机器人上运行，并在280次试验中实现了80%的成功率。

Authors: Zheng Sun, Zhuo Li, Zhihao Li, Hengyi Sim, Ge Wang, Ziyue Zhu, Mingkai Jia, Fei Chen

G0.7: Scaling Up a Fast World Action Model with Long Context VLA

world action model long context real-time control human ego video zero-shot generalization

简要说明：G0.7 通过将上下文扩展到五分钟并在机器人遥操作及人类第一视角视频上预训练，实现了快速、无暂停的实时动作分块，在真实机器人和仿真基准上表现出色。

TLDR: G0.7 scales a world action model by extending context to five minutes and pretraining on robot and human ego video, achieving fast, pause-free real-time action chunking on real robots and simulation benchmarks.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generators for robot control by jointly predicting future camera frames and actions, transferring physical priors learned from video into manipulation policies. However, generating future frames before every action makes test-time inference too slow for closed-loop control, while most existing policies remain restricted to short observation histories. Building on Fast-WAM, which showed that video prediction shapes policy representations during training so that future frame synthesis can be skipped at deployment, we present G0.7, a generalist world action model scaled along two axes: extending the context window from a single observation to up to five minutes of history, and scaling pretraining to a large-scale corpus of robot teleoperation and human egocentric (ego) video. Across public simulation suites and real-robot deployments, direct action decoding (Fast mode) matches imagine-then-act (IDM) inference from the same checkpoint while running in 60 ms per 16-step action chunk on a single RTX 5090 (7.6x faster than IDM) and supporting pause-free real-time chunking. Performance scales consistently with pretraining data, with human ego video driving the largest gains in out-of-distribution generalization: G0.7 achieves a 70.8 mean score across five simulation benchmark suites, 48% and 54% zero-shot pick-and-place success on Galaxea R1 Pro and R1 Lite, 96.7% in-distribution and 93.3% out-of-distribution success on video-conditioned in-context learning tasks, and 86.9% mean task progress across seven real-world post-training tasks including multi-minute box folding, drink preparation, and product bagging. Project page: https://www.galaxea-ai.com/model-g07.html

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合预测未来相机帧和动作，将预训练视频生成器适配到机器人控制任务中，从而将视频中学习到的物理先验迁移至操作策略。然而，在每次动作前生成未来帧导致测试时推理速度过慢，难以满足闭环控制需求，而现有策略大多仍局限于较短的观测历史。基于Fast-WAM的研究发现——视频预测在训练过程中塑造策略表示，使得部署时可以跳过未来帧合成——我们提出G0.7，一个沿两个维度扩展的通用世界动作模型：将上下文窗口从单次观测扩展至最长五分钟的历史记录，并将预训练扩展至包含机器人遥操作和人本第一人称（ego）视频的大规模语料库。在公开仿真套件和真实机器人部署中，直接动作解码（快速模式）与来自同一检查点的想象-然后-行动（IDM）推断在性能上相匹配，同时在单块RTX 5090上以每16步动作块60毫秒的速度运行（比IDM快7.6倍），并支持无暂停的实时分块处理。性能随预训练数据规模持续提升，其中人本第一人称视频对分布外泛化的提升贡献最大：G0.7在五个仿真基准套件上取得70.8的平均得分，在Galaxea R1 Pro和R1 Lite上分别实现48%和54%的零样本抓取-放置成功率，在视频条件上下文学习任务中分别达到96.7%的分布内和93.3%的分布外成功率，并在七个真实世界后训练任务（包括数分钟级折箱、饮品准备和产品装袋）中实现86.9%的平均任务进度。项目页面：https://www.galaxea-ai.com/model-g07.html

Authors: Tianyuan Yuan, Baijun Ye, Shicheng Cao, Xing Nie, Xiaopeng Yu, Ke Dong, Zijie Zhao, Shenling Qiu, Yizhao Xu, Feiyang Xue, Haonan Liu, Haoyu Zhang, Haobo Jia, Zheng Liu, Bowen Zhang, Haodong Yang, Anqi Yang, Jiahui Niu, Yue Sun, Tailai Cheng, Jianpeng Yu, Yang Wen, Longhao Wei, Zibin Dong, Shiduo Zhang, Yicheng Liu, Hang Zhao

LeanWAM: Learning Latent World Action Models from Frozen Video Models VLA

world action model frozen video model future representation action chunk prediction latent distillation

简要说明：LeanWAM 通过将紧凑的预测性未来表示从冻结的视频生成器蒸馏到轻量级策略中，实现了鲁棒且高效的机器人操作动作预测。

TLDR: LeanWAM transfers video priors from a frozen video generator to a lightweight policy by distilling compact predictive future representations, achieving robust and efficient action prediction for robot manipulation.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) typically adapt large pretrained video generators to jointly predict future observations and robot actions, incurring substantial training and deployment costs. However, it remains unclear which future representations a policy actually needs and how compactly they can be represented. Our probing study shows that complementary future representations can be compressed into a few tokens while retaining most of their action-decoding performance. Motivated by this finding, we introduce LeanWAM, a latent WAM that transfers video priors from a frozen video generator to a lightweight policy via two-stage training. In the first stage, a Future Extractor compresses observed transitions into 32 predictive tokens. These tokens condition the frozen generator and are jointly shaped by action, RGB, semantic, and geometric supervision, while a compact readout of the generator's hidden states supplies complementary world tokens. The second stage distills both representations into the policy, which learns to predict them from current observations while generating actions. With 1.4B parameters and no large-scale embodied pretraining, LeanWAM outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and WAM baselines on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin~2.0. It predicts an action chunk in 25.1\,ms on an A100 GPU, 12.3--41.5$\times$ faster than representative WAMs. These results demonstrate that compact predictive supervision can transfer video priors to robust and efficient control.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通常对大型预训练视频生成器进行适配，以联合预测未来观测和机器人动作，这带来了可观的训练与部署成本。然而，策略实际需要何种未来表示，以及这些表示能被压缩到何种程度，仍不明确。我们的探针研究表明，互补的未来表示可以被压缩为少量令牌，同时保留其大部分动作解码性能。受此发现启发，我们提出了LeanWAM，一种潜在世界动作模型，通过两阶段训练将冻结视频生成器的视频先验迁移至轻量级策略。在第一阶段，未来提取器将观测到的转换压缩为32个预测令牌。这些令牌对冻结生成器进行条件约束，并通过动作、RGB、语义和几何监督联合塑造，同时生成器隐藏状态的紧凑读出提供互补的世界令牌。第二阶段将两种表示蒸馏至策略中，该策略学会从当前观测预测这些表示并生成动作。LeanWAM拥有14亿参数，无需大规模具身预训练，即在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin~2.0上超越了强视觉-语言-动作（VLA）与世界动作模型基线。其在A100 GPU上预测一个动作块仅需25.1毫秒，比代表性WAMs快12.3至41.5倍。这些结果表明，紧凑的预测监督能够将视频先验迁移至稳健且高效的控制中。

Authors: Shaolong Li, Hongze Fu, Joyce Chai, Yinpei Dai

FoveaWAM: Role-Aware 4D World-Action Modeling for Dynamic Manipulation Manipulation

world-action model SE(3) trajectory latency-aware evaluation dynamic manipulation sparse 3D flow

简要说明：FoveaWAM 提出了一种角色感知的 4D 世界动作模型，通过预测目标的 SE(3) 轨迹和周围环境的稀疏 3D 流，在低延迟下实现动态操作，并引入了 OnTimeBench 基准以在计算延迟下评估策略。

TLDR: FoveaWAM introduces a role-aware 4D world-action model that predicts the target's SE(3) trajectory and sparse 3D flow for surroundings, achieving fast, precise dynamic manipulation under latency, and presents OnTimeBench for latency-aware evaluation.

Abstract: To manipulate a moving object, a policy must predict the scene at the moment its action executes, yet every millisecond spent predicting pushes that moment further away. Scene-level forecasts are computationally expensive, whereas target-centric forecasts can omit nearby objects that affect contact. Our key insight is that what a policy must predict decouples by role: only the target's pose, which determines contact, requires millimeter precision, while the surroundings matter primarily through the clearance they leave and the motion they impart. We present FoveaWAM, a native 4D world-action model that allocates precision according to these roles. Specifically, it models the target's past and future motion as a metric SE(3) trajectory, the surroundings as sparse 3D flow, and relies on the current frame for everything static. This compact representation lets FoveaWAM act in 15.1 ms on one RTX 5090, about 10 times faster than video world-action baselines, leaving substantially less time for the scene to evolve before action execution. To evaluate each policy under its own latency, we introduce OnTimeBench, a dynamic manipulation benchmark in which the scene keeps moving while the policy computes. FoveaWAM reaches 82.1% success on OnTimeBench, 20.8 points above the strongest baseline, and also leads on DOMINO and real-robot tasks. Project page: https://foveawam.github.io/

摘要（中文）：操控运动物体时，策略必须在动作执行的瞬间预测场景状态，然而预测所耗费的每一毫秒都会使该瞬间进一步延后。场景级预测计算开销巨大，而目标中心预测则可能遗漏影响接触的近旁物体。我们的关键洞察在于，策略所需预测的内容可按角色解耦：唯有决定接触的目标位姿需要毫米级精度，而周围环境主要通过其所留间隙和施加的运动产生影响。我们提出FoveaWAM，一种原生4D世界动作模型，根据上述角色分配预测精度。具体而言，该模型将目标的过去与未来运动建模为度量SE(3)轨迹，将周围环境建模为稀疏3D流场，而静态信息则依赖当前帧。这一紧凑表示使FoveaWAM能够在单块RTX 5090上以15.1毫秒完成推理，比基于视频的世界动作基线快约10倍，从而在动作执行前为场景演变留下更少时间。为在各策略自身延迟条件下进行评估，我们引入OnTimeBench，一个动态操作基准，其中策略计算期间场景持续运动。FoveaWAM在OnTimeBench上达到82.1%的成功率，高出最强基线20.8个百分点，同时在DOMINO及真实机器人任务上也处于领先地位。项目主页：https://foveawam.github.io/

Authors: Jiaqi Yin, Baoyue Zhang, Jiyuan Zhang, Wenxuan Liu, Zhaofei Yu, Yue Deng, Tiejun Huang

Hi3R-VLA: Grounding Semantics and Actions in 3D VLA

vision-language-action 3D grounding point cloud robotic manipulation action prediction

简要说明：Hi3R-VLA 是一种三维视觉-语言-动作模型，将语义视觉特征和语言条件融合到点云中，并在同一三维坐标系中锚定动作，在多个基准和真实机器人上取得了最先进的操作结果。

TLDR: Hi3R-VLA is a 3D-grounded vision-language-action model that fuses semantic visual features with language conditioning into point clouds and anchors actions in the same 3D frame, achieving state-of-the-art manipulation results across multiple benchmarks and real robots.

Abstract: While recent vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate 3D geometry, how to effectively exploit it for precise and generalizable action prediction remains a central challenge. We introduce Hi3R-VLA, a 3D policy that grounds heterogeneous modalities - vision, language, and action - in explicit 3D geometry for robotic manipulation. Our model integrates spatially-aligned visual features and language conditioning into point cloud representations, enriching scene geometry with fine-grained, task-relevant semantics. It then anchors low-level control commands in the same 3D coordinate frame and uses 3D-RoPE enhanced action-to-point attention over coarse-to-fine point features to model geometric relationships between action targets and observed points. Our analysis demonstrates the importance of semantic fusion within 3D and spatial alignment between observations and actions. With fewer than 250M trainable parameters, Hi3R-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa, RLBench, RoboTwin2, DexJoCo and DexSuite across diverse manipulation tasks and embodiments, from single-arm and dual-arm grippers to dexterous hands. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate its effectiveness in the physical world. The model, code and dataset are publicly released at https://cshizhe.github.io/projects/hi3r_vla.html.

摘要（中文）：虽然近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型越来越多地融入3D几何信息，但如何有效利用这些信息实现精准且可泛化的动作预测仍是一个核心挑战。我们提出了Hi3R-VLA，一种将视觉、语言和动作等异构模态锚定于显式3D几何中的3D策略模型，用于机器人操作任务。该模型将空间对齐的视觉特征与语言条件融入点云表示中，为场景几何赋予细粒度且与任务相关的语义信息。随后，模型将低级控制命令锚定在同一3D坐标系中，并利用基于3D旋转位置编码（3D-RoPE）增强的动作-点注意力机制，在从粗到细的点特征上建模动作目标与观测点之间的几何关系。我们的分析证明了3D空间内语义融合以及观测与动作之间空间对齐的重要性。Hi3R-VLA仅需不到2.5亿可训练参数，便在RoboCasa、RLBench、RoboTwin2、DexJoCo和DexSuite等多个操作任务与具身平台上达到了最先进的性能，涵盖单臂、双臂夹爪及灵巧手等多种形态。真实机器人评估进一步验证了其在物理世界中的有效性。模型、代码和数据集已在https://cshizhe.github.io/projects/hi3r_vla.html公开提供。

Authors: Shizhe Chen, Paul Pacaud, Cordelia Schmid

EmboEagle: An Efficient Agentic Embodied Framework for Long-horizon Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

long-horizon manipulation world-action model adaptive supervision memory-guided recovery VLM routing

简要说明：EmboEagle 提出了一种用于长时程机器人操作的闭环代理框架，结合子任务条件世界动作模型、潜在空间自适应监督和记忆引导恢复，在显著减少 VLM 调用的同时实现了高成功率。

TLDR: EmboEagle introduces a closed-loop agentic framework for long-horizon robotic manipulation, combining subtask-conditioned world-action models with latent-space adaptive supervision and memory-guided recovery to achieve high success rates while significantly reducing VLM calls.

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation demands reliable execution across interdependent stages, yet standalone World-Action Models (WAMs) suffer from compounding physical errors, while stateless Vision-Language Model (VLM) supervision incurs prohibitive chunkwise latency and lacks 3D spatial persistence. We present EmboEagle, a closed-loop agentic framework that unifies subtask-conditioned WAM control, latent-space adaptive supervision, and memory-guided geometric recovery. First, we adapt sequential WAMs via decoupled two-stage flow matching that preserves cross-stage visual history while calibrating truncated action supervision at subtask boundaries. Second, without an auxiliary vision encoder, we distill teacher intervention decisions into a lightweight routing gate driven solely by the WAM Action Expert's pre- and post-chunk latent transitions and subtask embeddings. Third, upon invocation, the VLM decouples diagnostic status from discrete routing actions and executes parameterized recovery primitives grounded in structured memory (initial references, active grasp bindings, and tool traces), followed by mandatory post-repair verification. Across RMBench and LIBERO-Mem, EmboEagle achieves 91.3\% and 90.6\% average success, surpassing the strongest baselines by 8.0 and 9.8 percentage points, while boosting real-world success over VoLoAgent under identical executor weights. Moreover, adaptive gating cuts VLM calls by 74.2\% versus chunkwise monitoring (91.3\% vs. 93.7\% success).

摘要（中文）：长期机器人操作要求在相互依赖的阶段之间进行可靠执行，然而，独立的World-Action模型（WAMs）会遭受复合物理误差，而无状态的视觉语言模型（VLM）监督则带来高成本的逐块延迟，并缺乏3D空间持续性。我们提出了EmboEagle，一个闭环的智能体框架，统一了子任务条件化的WAM控制、潜在空间自适应监督以及记忆引导的几何恢复。首先，我们通过解耦的两阶段流匹配来调整顺序WAMs，在保留跨阶段视觉历史的同时，在子任务边界处校准截断的动作监督。其次，在无需辅助视觉编码器的情况下，我们将教师干预决策提炼为一个轻量级路由门，该门仅由WAM动作专家在块前后潜在转换和子任务嵌入驱动。第三，一旦被调用，VLM将诊断状态与离散路由动作解耦，并执行基于结构化记忆（初始参考、主动抓取绑定和工具轨迹）的参数化恢复原语，随后进行强制的修复后验证。在RMBench和LIBERO-Mem上，EmboEagle实现了91.3%和90.6%的平均成功率，分别超过最强基线8.0和9.8个百分点，同时在相同的执行器权重下，在真实世界成功率上优于VoLoAgent。此外，与逐块监控相比，自适应门控将VLM调用次数减少了74.2%（成功率为91.3%对比93.7%）。

Authors: Fan Xu, Zhongtao Wang, Hao Wu, Yitong Zhu, Wenzhuo Ma, Long Li, Zhuohao Li, Zhisheng Chen, Rui Su, Kun Wang, Xian Wu, Wanli Ouyang

EffectWAM: Learning Action-Grounded Effects for Robot Manipulation WorldModel

World-action model Action Grounding Flow matching Robotic manipulation Visual prediction

简要说明：EffectWAM提出了一种用于机器人操作的世界-动作模型，通过流匹配联合预测视觉效果和可执行的动作块，在超过2万小时的异构具身数据上训练，在五个基准上提升了闭环操作性能。

TLDR: EffectWAM introduces a world-action model for robot manipulation that jointly predicts visual effects and executable action chunks via flow matching, trained on 20,000+ hours of heterogeneous embodied data, improving closed-loop manipulation across five benchmarks.

Abstract: World-action models connect visual prediction with executable robot control. We present EffectWAM, which develops this connection through three complementary components: Effect, camera positional encoding (CaPE), and Action Grounding. Effect represents visual change as the difference between independently encoded future observations and a shared current-observation anchor. CaPE conditions endpoint pooling on relative camera pose when reliable extrinsics are available, while sharing the same learned parameters with pose-free pooling for uncalibrated trajectories. Action Grounding trains the visual representation to retain measured changes in end-effector pose and gripper state. An exponential moving average of the observation encoder supplies Effect targets. A shared generation expert learns to jointly predict Effect and an executable action chunk through flow matching, and reuses the sampled pair to generate future video on demand. This allows the controller to execute actions without waiting for video synthesis. We train on more than 20,000 hours of heterogeneous embodied data, excluding unused chain-of-thought data, and accommodate dataset-specific joint, end-effector, and hand-pose representations. Our evaluation uses the Small (8B) configuration on all five benchmarks and additionally evaluates the Large (26B) configuration on RoboDojo. Experiments examine closed-loop manipulation across complementary benchmarks, and comparisons across multiple baseline policies show consistent improvements from Action Grounding.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型将视觉预测与可执行的机器人控制相连接。我们提出了EffectWAM，通过三个互补组件发展这一连接：效应（Effect）、相机位置编码（CaPE）和动作接地（Action Grounding）。效应将视觉变化表示为独立编码的未来观察与共享的当前观察锚点之间的差异。相机位置编码在可靠的相机外参可用时，基于相对相机位姿对端点池化进行条件约束，同时与无位姿池化共享相同的学习参数，以支持未标定轨迹。动作接地训练视觉表示以保留末端执行器位姿和夹爪状态的实测变化。观察编码器的指数移动平均提供效应目标。一个共享的生成专家通过流匹配联合预测效应和可执行的动作块，并复用采样对按需生成未来视频。这使得控制器无需等待视频合成即可执行动作。我们在超过20，000小时的异构具身数据上进行训练，排除未使用的思维链数据，并适配数据集特定的关节、末端执行器和手部姿态表示。我们的评估在所有五个基准上使用小型（8B）配置，并额外在RoboDojo上评估大型（26B）配置。实验检验了跨互补基准的闭环操作，多种基线策略的比较表明动作接地带来的一致性改进。

Authors: Yuan Zhang, Hao Cui, Jingfei Ni, Meiyi Wang, Xin Nie, Chi Liu, Wenjie Xu, Lin Gao, Hao Li, Xianhe Zhang, Jiajia Wu, Diyuan Liu, Jia Pan, Chao Ji

Ground, Guide, Act: Improving VLA Spatial Generalization with Multimodal Foundation Models VLA

VLA spatial generalization multimodal foundation models selective collaboration action-chunk-level dense geometric captions perturbed-state recovery

简要说明：MFM-VLA通过选择性集成多模态基础模型来改进目标定位和空间路由，从而提升VLA的空间泛化能力，在仿真和真实机器人任务上取得了显著的成功率提升。

TLDR: MFM-VLA improves VLA spatial generalization by selectively integrating multimodal foundation models for target grounding and spatial routing, achieving significant success rate gains on simulation and real-robot tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models effectively learn action policies from robot demonstrations, but struggle to generalize to changes in object positions and task goals. General multimodal foundation models (MFMs) offer complementary scene understanding and spatial reasoning, but remain slow and unreliable for direct fine-grained control. To understand how MFMs can improve VLA spatial generalization, we conduct a systematic capability analysis across multiple VLA architectures using atomic-stage interventions, revealing that many failures stem from poor target grounding and global spatial routing, while local manipulation skills remain largely usable. Based on these findings, we propose MFM-VLA, a selective collaboration framework in which an MFM provides target grounding and spatial guidance, controllers execute free-space motion, and the VLA retains control over fine-grained manipulation. We fine-tune the VLA with action-chunk-level dense geometric captions and perturbed-state recovery data to improve local guidance following and recovery from unfamiliar handoff states. A development-calibrated capability router selects between direct VLA execution and MFM-assisted execution to avoid unnecessary intervention. Across LIBERO-PRO, ALOHA-Sim-PRO, RoboCasa365, and real-world chemistry tasks, MFM-VLA improves success rates by 14.9, 74.0, 3.6, and 30.9 percentage points, respectively, over the corresponding base VLA. The project page is available at https://tom-zgt.github.io/MFM-VLA

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够有效地从机器人演示中学习动作策略，但在泛化到物体位置变化和任务目标变化时存在困难。通用多模态基础模型（MFM）提供了互补的场景理解和空间推理能力，但在直接细粒度控制方面仍然缓慢且不可靠。为了理解MFM如何提升VLA的空间泛化能力，我们通过原子级阶段干预对多种VLA架构进行了系统性能力分析，发现许多失败源于目标锚定不准确和全局空间路径规划不足，而局部操作技能大多仍然可用。基于这些发现，我们提出MFM-VLA，一种选择性协作框架，其中MFM提供目标锚定和空间引导，控制器执行自由空间运动，而VLA保留细粒度操作的控制权。我们使用动作块级别的稠密几何标注和扰动状态恢复数据对VLA进行微调，以提高局部引导跟随能力和对陌生交接状态的恢复能力。一个经过开发校准的能力路由器在直接VLA执行和MFM辅助执行之间进行选择，以避免不必要的干预。在LIBERO-PRO、ALOHA-Sim-PRO、RoboCasa365以及真实世界化学任务中，MFM-VLA相较于对应的基础VLA，成功率分别提升了14.9、74.0、3.6和30.9个百分点。项目页面可在 https://tom-zgt.github.io/MFM-VLA 查看。

Authors: Guangting Zheng, Shaoxuan Wang, Yu Yuan, Zhipeng Tang, Jiajun Deng, Yanyong Zhang

Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies Manipulation

embodied AI mirror test robot manipulation VLA world action models

简要说明：本文提出了一个在镜子环境中的机器人操作基准，发现镜像表面而非单纯物理障碍导致多种策略性能下降，并揭示了策略对反射环境的共同脆弱性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a benchmark to evaluate robot manipulation policies in environments with mirrors, showing that policies fail due to reflective surfaces, not just physical obstacles. The findings reveal a shared vulnerability across VLA, World Action Models, and agentic policies, with real-robot experiments confirming the degradation.

Abstract: Can a simple mirror expose the limitations of today's robotic manipulation policies? Inspired by the mirror self-recognition test in animal cognition, we investigate whether robot policies can reliably manipulate physical objects in scenes containing their reflections. We introduce RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark built on RoboDojo that preserves task objectives, success criteria, and policy checkpoints while comparing a mirror-free baseline with single-mirror, dual-mirror, and mirrored-tabletop conditions. Across five policies spanning Vision-Language-Action models, World Action Models, and agentic policies, every mirror condition reduces aggregate success rates: averaged over the three conditions, the drop ranges from 10.8 to 56.7 percentage points across policies, and it reaches 62.5 points on the mirrored tabletop. Because a mirror is also a physical obstacle, we compare it against geometrically matched non-reflective panels; 50--88\% of mirror-specific failures occur without recorded robot--panel contact, so direct collisions alone do not explain the degradation. Trajectory and contact analyses instead reveal recurring behaviors consistent with phantom targeting of reflected objects and spatial mislocalization of real ones. Targeted diagnostics further characterize grasping near reflections, policy-dependent pushing progress, and physical-target interaction under main-camera occlusion. Real-robot experiments with $π_{0.5}$ and FastWAM also show lower overall success rates under the upright-mirror and mirrored-tabletop conditions. These findings reveal a shared vulnerability to reflective environments across diverse robot policies and motivate reflection-aware evaluation of embodied intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.

摘要（中文）：一面简单的镜子能否暴露当今机器人操作策略的局限性？受动物认知中镜像自我识别测试的启发，我们研究了机器人策略在包含其反射的场景中能否可靠地操作物理对象。我们引入了RoboDojo-Mirror，这是一个基于RoboDojo构建的基准测试，在保持任务目标、成功标准和策略检查点不变的同时，对比了无镜像基线条件与单镜、双镜及镜面桌面条件。在涵盖视觉-语言-动作模型、世界动作模型和智能体策略的五种策略中，每种镜像条件均降低了总体成功率：在三种条件上取平均后，各策略的成功率下降幅度从10.8到56.7个百分点不等，在镜面桌面条件下最高达62.5个百分点。由于镜子本身也是一种物理障碍，我们将其与几何匹配的非反射面板进行了对比；50%至88%的镜像特异性失败发生在未记录到机器人-面板接触的情况下，因此直接碰撞无法单独解释性能退化。轨迹和接触分析反而揭示了与镜像目标的虚幻瞄准以及真实目标空间定位错误相一致的重复性行为模式。针对性诊断进一步表征了反射附近的抓取行为、策略相关的推动进展以及主相机遮挡下的物理目标交互。使用π₀.₅和FastWAM进行的真实机器人实验也显示，在直立镜子和镜面桌面条件下总体成功率较低。这些发现揭示了不同机器人策略对反射环境的共同脆弱性，并推动了具身智能的反射感知评估。代码可在https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror获取。

Authors: Xuanchen Liu, Hejun Zhang, Boxuan Dong, Ying Wu, Heshuai Li, Wen Gao, Yonghong Tian, Weihao Yu

VidForce: Predicting Force-Aware Articulation by Observing Humans Manipulation

force-aware articulation human demonstration trajectory prediction robot manipulation joint conditional flow

简要说明：VidForce提出了一种从第三人称RGB视频中估计交互轨迹和力曲线的方法，利用学习的物理原型和联合条件流，并在Spot机器人上成功部署，用于铰接物体操作。

TLDR: VidForce introduces a method to estimate interaction trajectories and force profiles from third-person RGB videos of human-object interactions, using learned physical prototypes and a joint conditional flow, and demonstrates successful deployment on a Spot robot for articulated-object manipulation.

Abstract: People can anticipate how an object moves and the effort an interaction may require by watching others. How can embodied agents acquire this understanding from video? Force measurements provide direct sensory supervision, but require specialized equipment and remain limited in quantity. We introduce VidForce, which estimates an interaction trajectory together with a force profile from a third-person RGB video; 2D contact clicks and textual object-action prompts are optional. Our approach makes limited instrumented measurements useful for interpreting human interactions through learned physical prototypes as a prior. The prototypes share learned force levels and temporal profiles across interactions of comparable effort, with visual and semantic cues determining their contribution to each observation. Geometric and vision-language features adapt this prior to the observed interaction, while a joint conditional flow refines an initial tracked trajectory together with the force profile. Paired human and instrumented-gripper recordings provide measured force references for supervising human video, and a separately trained torque model demonstrates that the formulation extends to other sensory quantities. We evaluate trajectory recovery and force estimation through baseline comparisons and controlled ablations on held-out interactions from the Hoi! dataset. On this evaluation subset, VidForce achieves 6.6 cm ATE, peak-force MAE and RMSE of 4.81 N and 5.92 N, respectively, and force-profile RMSE of 5.52 N. On real-world videos, VidForce infers motion and force reliably and consistently despite the variability in human execution. We further deploy VidForce on a Spot robot, where trajectories and force profiles estimated from human demonstrations drive real-world articulated-object manipulation, and report success rates across repeated trials. Project page: https://rafaymhddn.github.io/vidforce

摘要（中文）：人们可以通过观察他人来预测物体的运动方式以及互动可能需要的力度。具身智能体如何从视频中习得这种理解能力？力测量提供了直接的感官监督，但需要专用设备，且数据量仍然有限。我们提出了VidForce，该方法能从第三人称RGB视频中同时估计互动轨迹和力曲线；二维接触点击和文本形式的物体-动作提示为可选输入。我们的方法通过习得的物理原型作为先验，使有限的仪器测量数据能够用于理解人类互动。这些原型在不同用力相当的互动中共享习得的力度水平与时间分布，视觉和语义线索决定其对每次观测的贡献。几何特征与视觉-语言特征将该先验自适应到观测到的互动中，同时联合条件流对初步跟踪轨迹与力曲线进行联合优化。配对的人类与仪器化夹爪记录为监督人类视频提供了实测力参考，而一个独立训练的力矩模型则证明该框架可扩展到其他感官量。我们通过在Hoi!数据集上的留出互动进行基线比较和受控消融，评估了轨迹恢复与力估计性能。在该评估子集上，VidForce达到了6.6厘米的ATE，峰值力的MAE和RMSE分别为4.81牛和5.92牛，力曲线的RMSE为5.52牛。在真实世界视频中，尽管人类执行方式存在差异，VidForce仍能可靠且一致地推断运动与力。我们进一步将VidForce部署在Spot机器人上，由人类演示估计出的轨迹和力曲线驱动真实世界中关节物体的操作，并报告了多次重复试验的成功率。项目页面：https://rafaymhddn.github.io/vidforce

Authors: Rafay Mohiuddin, Jiaqi Chen, Marc Pollefeys, Hermann Blum

DynaMimic: A Physics-Informed World Model for Humanoid Motion Tracking WorldModel

differentiable world model contact wrench Lagrangian forward dynamics humanoid motion tracking physics-informed

简要说明：DynaMimic 是一个可微世界模型，通过将接触力旋量和残余广义力预测融入拉格朗日正动力学，用于人形机器人运动跟踪，在多种运动与地形上降低了跟踪误差，并成功部署到真实机器人。

TLDR: DynaMimic is a differentiable world model that explicitly incorporates contact wrench and residual force predictions into Lagrangian forward dynamics for humanoid motion tracking, reducing tracking error across motions and terrains and enabling real-robot deployment.

Abstract: Whole-body motion tracking enables humanoid robots to reproduce diverse skills from human demonstrations. Existing model-free reinforcement learning methods either distill motion specialists into a single policy at the cost of performance or train a generalist policy directly using cluster-scale computation. SuperMimic reduces this computational cost through a differentiable world model that implicitly learns the physics shared across motions by predicting the next state from the current state and action. However, this implicit formulation may not fully capture the underlying physical processes. Errors around changes of support can accumulate over imagined rollouts used to train the tracking policy. To address this challenge, we introduce DynaMimic, a differentiable world model that explicitly incorporates shared physics into state prediction. Specifically, its network predicts a contact wrench at each candidate support link and a residual generalized force. DynaMimic then uses these predictions to compute the next state through closed-form Lagrangian forward dynamics. Across 60 full LAFAN1 motions, DynaMimic reduces mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 18.6% relative to SuperMimic. For terrain tracking, we give both methods the same local height maps. Relative to terrain-conditioned SuperMimic, DynaMimic reduces MPJPE by 14.9% on A3 Parkour (66.15 to 56.28~mm) and by 10.8% on GRAIL terrain clips (141.88 to 126.57~mm). On a real A3 humanoid, the learned policies can perform diverse skills, such as floor recovery, cartwheel and a box vault.

摘要（中文）：全身运动跟踪使类人机器人能够复现来自人类演示的多样化技能。现有的无模型强化学习方法要么以牺牲性能为代价将运动专家蒸馏为单一策略，要么直接使用大规模集群计算训练通用策略。SuperMimic通过一种可微分世界模型降低了这一计算成本，该模型通过从当前状态和动作预测下一状态，隐式学习不同动作间共享的物理规律。然而，这种隐式表述可能无法完全捕捉底层物理过程。在用于训练跟踪策略的想象展开中，支撑状态变化附近的误差可能不断累积。为应对这一挑战，我们提出DynaMimic，一种可微分世界模型，将共享物理显式地纳入状态预测中。具体而言，其网络预测每个候选支撑连杆处的接触力螺旋以及残余广义力。随后，DynaMimic利用这些预测，通过闭式拉格朗日前向动力学计算下一状态。在完整的60条LAFAN1动作上，DynaMimic相对于SuperMimic将平均每关节位置误差（MPJPE）降低了18.6%。对于地形跟踪任务，我们为两种方法提供相同的局部高度图。相对于地形条件下的SuperMimic，DynaMimic在A3跑酷（66.15降至56.28毫米）上将MPJPE降低了14.9%，在GRAIL地形片段（141.88降至126.57毫米）上降低了10.8%。在实际A3类人机器人上，学习到的策略能够执行多种技能，如地面恢复、侧手翻和箱体跨越。

Authors: Chaoyue Xing, Linyi Huang, Yiting He, Yixuan Yin, Siqi Hou, Yi Zhang, Liyuan Pan, Miaomiao Liu, Daqi Liu

What Does a Skill Vocabulary Cost? A Closed-Loop Decomposition over Demonstrated Motions VLA

skill vocabulary quantization closed-loop evaluation VLA LIBERO-90

简要说明：本文提出运动原型量化（MPQ），一种无需训练的后处理包装器，将预测的动作块替换为演示运动库中的最近邻元素。它提供了一种分解方法，将技能策略的闭环失败归因于词汇、选择或执行，并在LIBERO-90上表明技能选择代价很小，而选择器自身的组件造成了大部分误差。

TLDR: This paper introduces Movement Prototype Quantization (MPQ), a training-free post-hoc wrapper that replaces predicted action chunks with nearest library elements from demonstrated motions. It provides a decomposition method to attribute closed-loop failures of skill policies to vocabulary, selection, or execution, showing on LIBERO-90 that skill choice costs little while selector-specific components account for most errors.

Abstract: Discrete skill policies execute motions drawn from a finite vocabulary. In most current methods, this vocabulary is a latent codebook learned jointly with a selector and a decoder. When such a policy fails in closed loop, the failure cannot be traced to the vocabulary, to the choice of skill or to its execution. We present Movement Prototype Quantization (MPQ), which places a library of demonstrated motions after a trained policy instead of inside it. MPQ replaces each predicted action chunk with its nearest library element, corrects that element toward the prediction within a bound, and trains no parameters. Across six architectures, including a 7B vision-language-action model, the wrapped policy is statistically equivalent to the original. A reference policy executed through the library is therefore a baseline for any selector over the same library. Substituting a selector's components one at a time attributes its shortfall to them. On LIBERO-90, with selectors on three backbones, quantization costs nothing and the choice of skill costs at most 2 points under the reference's placement and correction. The selectors' own placement and correction account for nearly all of the remaining gap, up to 12 points. Offline reconstruction predicts none of these differences and misjudges library size, design and transfer across benchmark suites. Project page: https://intuitive-robots.github.io/mpq.

摘要（中文）：离散技能策略执行的动作为有限词汇表中所绘制的动作。在当前多数方法中，这一词汇表是潜在码本，与选择器和解码器共同学习。当此类策略在闭环中失败时，无法将失败归因于词汇表、技能选择或其执行过程。我们提出了运动原型量化（Movement Prototype Quantization, MPQ），该方法将演示动作库置于经过训练的策略之后，而非嵌入其中。MPQ将每个预测的动作块替换为其最相近的库内元素，并在一定界限内将该元素朝预测方向修正，且无需训练任何参数。在六种架构中（包括一个70亿参数的视觉-语言-动作模型），该封装策略与原始策略在统计上等价。因此，通过该动作库执行的参考策略，可作为针对同一库内任意选择器的基准。逐一替换选择器的各组件，可将其性能差距归因至相应组件。在LIBERO-90基准上，基于三种骨干网络的选择器，量化过程不带来额外代价，且在参考策略的放置与修正条件下，技能选择造成的性能损失至多为2分。选择器自身的放置与修正机制几乎解释了剩余差距的全部来源，高达12分。离线重建无法预测上述任何差异，并且在库大小、设计及跨基准套件的迁移方面产生误判。项目页面：https://intuitive-robots.github.io/mpq。

Authors: Maximilian Xiling Li, Nils Blank, Paul Mattes, Pankhuri Vanjani, Rudolf Lioutikov

Atomic Policy: Composing Atomic Manipulation Skills with Agentic Reasoning Manipulation

VLM PDDL planning skill composition execution feedback long-horizon manipulation

简要说明：Atomic Policy 通过基于VLM的引导、PDDL规划和执行反馈来组合学习到的操作技能，以完成长时程任务，并在仿真和真实机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: Atomic Policy composes learned manipulation skills with VLM-based grounded steering, PDDL planning, and execution feedback for long-horizon tasks, validated in simulation and on a real robot.

Abstract: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to translate task intent into physical interactions as the scene changes. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer semantic and spatial reasoning, while visuomotor policies provide fine-grained control. Yet ambiguous goals and dependencies between actions make their integration challenging. We introduce Atomic Policy, a framework that composes learned manipulation skills through grounded steering and execution feedback. A VLM estimates the symbolic state and goal, and a PDDL solver constructs a skill plan. An agentic harness steers each skill through language, visual pointing, or both, and verifies its outcome to guide phase transitions and replanning. A common phase-level interface supports specialized policies and generalist action models. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot show how Atomic Policy improves task following and supports recovery in complex, long-horizon manipulation. Project page: https://aaronzkd.github.io/atomic-policy/

摘要（中文）：长期操作要求机器人随着场景变化将任务意图转化为物理交互。视觉语言模型（VLM）提供语义和空间推理能力，而视觉运动策略则提供精细的控制。然而，目标模糊和动作之间的依赖关系使得它们的整合面临挑战。我们引入了Atomic Policy框架，该框架通过基于接地引导和执行反馈的组合学习操作技能。VLM估计符号状态和目标，PDDL求解器构建技能计划。代理化引导通过语言、视觉指向或两者结合来引导每项技能，并验证其结果以指导阶段转换和重新规划。通用的阶段级接口支持专用策略和通用动作模型。在仿真和真实机器人上的实验表明，Atomic Policy如何改善任务跟随，并支持复杂长期操作中的恢复能力。项目页面：https://aaronzkd.github.io/atomic-policy/

Authors: Kaidi Zhang, Pengyuan Guo, Zhengtong Xu, Caiyi Zhang, Huayi Gou, Guanlin Huang, Aaron Lim, Anas Rafei, Yu She

Supply Geometry, Learn Execution: Screw Attention for Zero-Shot Policy Transfer in Robot Manipulation Manipulation

Screw Attention Zero-Shot Transfer Robot Manipulation Sim-to-Real SE(3)

简要说明：本文提出了螺旋注意力策略，一种以几何为中心的操作框架，通过显式提供任务几何（物体位姿、SE(3)变换和关节螺旋轴），使得仅需30K参数的小型策略只需学习执行。在纯仿真中训练后，该策略在新布局、不同机器人本体和真实机器人上均展现出优异的零样本迁移能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces the Screw Attention Policy, a geometry-centric manipulation framework that explicitly supplies task geometry (object poses, SE(3) transforms, and joint screw axes) so that a small 30K-parameter policy needs to learn only execution. Trained purely in simulation, it achieves strong zero-shot transfer across new layouts, robot embodiments, and real robots.

Abstract: We present the Screw Attention Policy, a geometry-centric manipulation framework that supplies task geometry explicitly and learns only execution. The policy operates on object poses, relative SE(3) transforms, and joint screw axes provided by perception and robot models. The policy requires only 30K learned parameters. Trained entirely in simulation on a single robot arm, the policy generalises to new scene layouts, transfers zero-shot across robot embodiments, and deploys directly on a real robot, without adaptation or fine-tuning. It achieves 96% success on LIBERO, 85.8% under layout changes, 80.2% across five unseen robot arms, and 21 of 24 trials on a real robot. These results suggest that much of what manipulation policies learn at scale is geometric structure that can instead be supplied.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了螺旋注意力策略（Screw Attention Policy），这是一种以几何为中心的操作框架，它显式地提供任务几何信息，仅学习执行过程。该策略基于感知和机器人模型提供的物体位姿、相对SE(3)变换以及关节螺旋轴进行运作，仅需30K个可学习参数。该策略完全在仿真环境中针对单一机器人手臂进行训练，却能泛化至新的场景布局，实现跨机器人本体的零样本迁移，并可直接部署于真实机器人，无需适应或微调。在LIBERO基准上，它取得了96%的成功率；在布局变化情况下达到85.8%；在五种未见过的机器人手臂上达到80.2%；在真实机器人上24次试验中成功21次。这些结果表明，大规模操作策略所学习的内容中，很大一部分是几何结构，而这部分其实可以直接提供。

Authors: Aly Magassouba

Simulator-as-Proxy World Model for Robot Manipulation WorldModel

world model video generation robot manipulation simulator-as-proxy state-conditioned rendering

简要说明：SimPWM 提出了一种模拟器作为代理的世界模型，将规则模拟器与视频模型相结合以渲染机器人操作场景，实现状态条件视频生成并分析视频模型对模拟对象状态的遵循程度。

TLDR: SimPWM introduces a simulator-as-proxy world model that combines a rule-based simulator with a video model to render robot manipulation scenes, enabling state-conditional video generation and analysis of how video models adhere to simulated object states.

Abstract: Video world models for robots are increasingly conditioned on a simulated or rendered proxy of the scene, on the assumption that the video will show what the proxy shows. Testing this assumption requires a proxy whose state is explicit and can be perturbed. We present SimPWM (Simulator-as-Proxy World Model): given a calibrated camera, it represents, from the first frame alone, the robot by its 3D model and the objects the gripper may touch as 3D points; a rule-based simulator with no trained parameters moves them under the actions, and a video model renders the result. SimPWM returns the realistic video together with the simulated state. We then freeze the simulated objects while the arm moves as recorded and check whether the video still shows the object lifted. On DROID episodes from unseen setups, the answer differs for the arm and for the objects. With each of three base video models, the arm follows the proxy (robot IoU 0.75-0.78, against at most 0.69 for end-to-end models); rendering the robot alone already gives this. What the simulated objects add is the object state: against a robot-only proxy, they cut missed pick-ups from 54% to 38%, and the video follows them only with some base models: on rigid objects, freezing them lowers the lift rate of MiniMax-H3, fine-tuned on episodes whose simulation agrees with the real video, from 42% to 10%, but that of LTX-2.3, trained on the same episodes, only from 57% to 49%, as if it inferred the grasp from the arm motion; more than half of the remaining lifts of MiniMax-H3 are of cloth and rope, which the simulator carries rigidly. With any base model, the simulated state records what the simulation did; under perturbed actions, a video that disagrees with it reveals that the video ignores the simulated state.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型越来越多地以场景的模拟或渲染代理为条件，其假设是视频将展示代理所展示的内容。要检验这一假设，需要代理的状态是显式的且可被扰动。我们提出了SimPWM（模拟器作为代理的世界模型）：给定一个标定过的相机，它仅从第一帧就通过3D模型表示机器人，并将夹爪可能接触的物体表示为3D点；一个无训练参数的基于规则的模拟器在动作驱动下移动这些点，视频模型则渲染结果。SimPWM返回逼真的视频以及模拟状态。然后，我们冻结模拟物体，同时手臂按记录动作移动，并检查视频是否仍显示物体被举起。在来自未见过的场景的DROID片段上，手臂和物体的答案不同。对于三种基础视频模型中的每一种，手臂都遵循代理（机器人IoU为0.75-0.78，而端到端模型最多为0.69）；仅渲染机器人就已达到此效果。模拟物体所增加的是物体状态：相对于仅含机器人的代理，它们将漏捡率从54%降至38%，但视频仅在部分基础模型中遵循它们：对于刚性物体，冻结它们将使MiniMax-H3的举升率从42%降至10%（该模型在模拟与真实视频一致的片段上微调），但LTX-2.3（在相同片段上训练）仅从57%降至49%，仿佛它从手臂动作中推断出抓取；MiniMax-H3剩余举升中超过一半是布料和绳索，而模拟器以刚性方式携带这些物品。对于任何基础模型，模拟状态记录了模拟所执行的内容；在扰动动作下，与模拟状态不一致的视频揭示出视频忽略了模拟状态。

Authors: Tingting Liao, Mingjia Huo, Hao Li, Zhengzhong Liu, Eric P. Xing, Guangyi Liu

AG-WAM: Attention-Guided World Action Model for Accurate and Efficient Robot Manipulation VLA

World Action Model attention guidance robot manipulation LIBERO RoboTwin

简要说明：AG-WAM 通过三个即插即用的注意力引导模块显式引导世界动作模型的内部注意力，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 等基准上达到最优性能并提升效率。

TLDR: AG-WAM introduces three plug-and-play attention guidance modules to explicitly guide internal attention in World Action Models, achieving state-of-the-art manipulation performance on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and other benchmarks with improved efficiency.

Abstract: Recently developed World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and robot actions, providing predictive context for control. However, existing WAMs typically learn implicit attention allocation with limited explicit action-relevant attention guidance, leading to limited performance. To unleash strong capabilities of WAMs, we introduce explicit attention guidance as a unifying principle and propose our Attention-Guided WAM (AG-WAM), an end-to-end framework with three plug-and-play attention guidance modules that directly reformulate internal attention paradigm in WAMs: the Content-Adaptive Predictive Attention module, the Guidance-Point Visual Attention module, and the State-Conditioned Text Attention module. Without any external plugin module adopted, our end-to-end framework with the unifying principle of explicit attention guidance boosts the accuracy and efficiency of WAMs. Without using any private embodied training data, our AG-WAM establishes new state-of-the-art performance on multiple public robotic manipulation benchmarks including LIBERO-X, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin-2.0, significantly outperforming other methods, even those using massive private embodied training data by a notable margin, meanwhile notably improving training and inference efficiency.

摘要（中文）：近期开发的World Action Models (WAMs)能够联合预测未来的观测结果和机器人动作，为控制提供预测上下文。然而，现有的WAMs通常学习隐式注意力分配，缺乏明确的与动作相关的注意力引导，导致性能受限。为了释放WAMs的强大能力，我们引入显式注意力引导作为统一原则，并提出了注意力引导的WAM (AG-WAM)，这是一个端到端框架，包含三个即插即用的注意力引导模块，直接重塑WAMs内部的注意力范式：内容自适应预测注意力模块、引导点视觉注意力模块和状态条件文本注意力模块。在不采用任何外部插件模块的情况下，我们的端到端框架通过显式注意力引导的统一原则，提升了WAMs的准确性和效率。在不使用任何私有具身训练数据的情况下，我们的AG-WAM在多个公开的机器人操作基准上取得了新的最先进性能，包括LIBERO-X、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin-2.0，显著优于其他方法，甚至大幅超越了使用海量私有具身训练数据的方法，同时显著提高了训练和推理效率。

Authors: Hongcheng Zhang, Lei Sun, Songxuan Liu, Tengteng Pan, Yuqiang Zhai, Xianglong Xu, Jianya Guo, Xiao Song

Seeing to Drive on a Single Board: Attention-Free Depth for Onboard Robot Navigation Perception3D

onboard depth estimation knowledge distillation integer arithmetic Raspberry Pi robot navigation

简要说明：本文介绍了DANIEL，一种为资源受限的机载机器人导航设计的无注意力深度估计模型，专门针对树莓派5和Hailo-8L加速器优化。通过知识蒸馏，它在小型地面机器人上实现了实时、准确的单目深度估计，用于建图、规划和SLAM，并在硬件在环仿真和真实世界测试中得到验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces DANIEL, a knowledge-distilled, attention-free depth estimation model for resource-constrained onboard robot navigation, specifically optimized for a Raspberry Pi 5 with a Hailo-8L accelerator. It demonstrates real-time, accurate monocular depth for mapping, planning, and SLAM on a small ground robot, validated in hardware-in-the-loop simulations and real-world tests.

Abstract: A small ground robot can carry one camera and a few watts of compute, but the depth foundation models that could turn that camera into a range sensor are vision transformers sized for GPUs. We bring one to a Raspberry Pi 5 with the Hailo-8L, an accelerator that runs every layer in integer arithmetic, attention included. Quantised for it, Depth Anything V2 loses large parts of the scene, and we measure why: at 449 tokens, 91% of softmax weights fall below one int8 step while carrying 17-33% of the attention mass. Our answer is to distil, not quantise. An attention-free ResNet-34 U-Net student of Depth Anything V2-Large (24.5M parameters) runs at 27.1 FPS on the chip, its int8 output matches its float twin (Pearson 0.99993), and on held-out scenes of its simulated yard it is the most accurate depth network on the chip (AbsRel 0.269 against 0.354-0.530). On 1,000 stereo-verified points of a real outdoor drive it is not resolvably different from the vendor's Depth Anything V2-Small build, while running faster (27.1 vs 21.6 FPS). Ranging obstacles by where they meet the floor needs only the camera height, so mapping, hybrid-A* planning and SLAM run on the Pi's own CPU. In real-time hardware-in-the-loop tests in a Gaussian-splat reconstruction of a real yard, the stack reaches the goal without contact in 7.9$\pm$1.1 of 10 scenes, against 9.2$\pm$0.4 with exact obstacles, and in 7.7$\pm$0.7 on its own pose with simulated wheel odometry (ten seeds each; 8.2$\pm$0.4 with the real Pi and Hailo-8L in the loop, five seeds). The source code, pre-trained models and data are available at https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL.

摘要（中文）：小型地面机器人可携带一台摄像头和数瓦算力，但能将摄像头转化为测距传感器的深度基础模型却是为GPU设计的视觉Transformer。我们将此类模型部署至搭载Hailo-8L加速器的树莓派5上，该加速器以整数算术运行所有层，包括注意力机制。经量化后，Depth Anything V2丢失了场景中的大部分信息，我们通过测量找到了原因：在449个token下，91%的softmax权重低于int8单步长，却承载了17%至33%的注意力质量。我们的解决之道是蒸馏，而非量化。Depth Anything V2-Large的无注意力ResNet-34 U-Net学生模型（2450万参数）在芯片上以27.1 FPS运行，其int8输出与其浮点版本高度一致（Pearson相关系数0.99993），在其模拟院落的保留场景中，它是该芯片上最精确的深度网络（AbsRel 0.269，对比范围0.354–0.530）。在真实户外行驶的1000个立体校验点上，其性能与厂商的Depth Anything V2-Small版本无显著差异，且运行速度更快（27.1对21.6 FPS）。仅依据相机高度即可通过障碍物与地面的接触点进行测距，因此建图、混合A*路径规划及SLAM均在树莓派自身CPU上运行。在真实院落的Gaussian-splat重建中进行的实时硬件在环测试里，该栈在10个场景中平均7.9±1.1次无需接触即可到达目标，而在精确障碍物条件下为9.2±0.4次；基于模拟轮式里程计的自定位下为7.7±0.7次（各10个随机种子；接入真实树莓派与Hailo-8L时为8.2±0.4，5个种子）。源代码、预训练模型及数据见https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL。

Authors: Itai Mizlish, Boaz Ben-Moshe

DeCoNav-Act: Benchmarking Collective Physical Capability in Multi-Robot Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

multi-robot mobile manipulation language-guided benchmark handoff physics simulation

简要说明：DeCoNav-Act 提出了一个在物理仿真中进行语言引导的多机器人移动操作基准，通过并行和依赖任务评估集体物理能力，并衡量路径效率和交接成功率。结果表明现有方法难以完成交接，使用 GPT-6.1-sol 时最高成功率仅 4.1%。

TLDR: DeCoNav-Act introduces a benchmark for language-guided multi-robot mobile manipulation in physics simulation, evaluating collective physical capability through parallel and dependent tasks, with metrics for path efficiency and handoff success. It reports that current agent methods struggle with handoff completion, achieving at most 4.1% success with GPT-6.1-sol.

Abstract: Robot teams can split workloads or combine complementary bodies, but only if each robot leaves the shared world in a state its teammate can use. Existing multi-robot benchmarks emphasize task allocation and skill sequencing, rarely testing whether the resulting physical states are usable. To evaluate collective physical capability, we introduce DeCoNav-Act, a benchmark for language-guided multi-robot mobile manipulation in a shared physics simulation. Its 350 homogeneous and 150 heterogeneous tasks, each verified by joint reference execution, span two coordination mechanisms: parallel workloads in shared space and physical dependencies in which one robot establishes a condition for a teammate to use. Beyond team success, DeCoNav-Act measures path efficiency and handoff coverage and success, and adds a diagnostic from verified pre-handoff states. Evaluating sensor-grounded adaptations of ASPIRE and RAX and our agent CoMoMa, we find that with GPT-5.6-luna no method completes a task, at most 8.8% of dependencies are reached, and even from pre-handoff states no handoff is completed; with GPT-6.1-sol, CoMoMa establishes the condition in 26.5% of trials, but only 4.1% succeed.

摘要（中文）：机器人团队可以拆分工作负载或组合互补的机体，但前提是每个机器人都必须将共享世界保持在队友可用的状态。现有的多机器人基准测试侧重于任务分配和技能排序，很少检验由此产生的物理状态是否可用。为了评估集体物理能力，我们提出了DeCoNav-Act，这是一个在共享物理仿真中进行语言引导的多机器人移动操作基准。其包含350个同构任务和150个异构任务，每个任务均通过联合参考执行验证，涵盖两种协调机制：共享空间中的并行工作负载，以及物理依赖关系——即一个机器人为队友建立可供使用的条件。除团队成功率外，DeCoNav-Act还衡量路径效率、交接覆盖率与成功率，并基于经验证的交接前状态增加诊断功能。在评估ASPIRE和RAX的传感器接地改编版本以及我们的代理CoMoMa时，我们发现使用GPT-5.6-luna时，没有任何方法能完成任一任务，最多仅有8.8%的依赖关系被达成，甚至从交接前状态出发也没有任何交接得以完成；使用GPT-6.1-sol时，CoMoMa在26.5%的试验中建立了条件，但仅有4.1%取得成功。

Authors: Yunzi Wu, Sunyao Zhou, Xiaotao Zhang, Yucheng Deng, Yuehao Huang, Lin Qian, Xuanrui Cui, Xinhai Li, Chenjia Bai, Hongqing Chu, Xuelong Li

BARE: Body-Aware Reflexive Evasion for Humanoid Robots HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid robots reflexive evasion human motion priors whole-body stability reinforcement learning

简要说明：BARE 提出了一种人形机器人反射式规避框架，利用人体运动先验和风险引导的自适应，在保持全身稳定性的同时进行局部规避动作，并在仿真和真实人形机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: BARE introduces a humanoid reflexive evasion framework that uses human motion priors and risk-guided adaptation to perform localized evasive body adjustments while maintaining whole-body stability, validated in simulation and on a real humanoid.

Abstract: Dynamic obstacle avoidance is essential for safely deploying humanoid robots in real-world environments, where rapidly approaching objects require immediate evasive responses. Recent advances in reflexive evasion have focused primarily on quadrupeds, which typically rely on large-scale whole-body maneuvers. In contrast, humanoids can exploit their rich body articulation to evade through small, localized body adjustments. By moving threatened body regions without repositioning the entire body, these responses may require less execution time and less surrounding free space. However, local adjustments can alter mass distribution or support conditions, making it challenging to achieve rapid evasion while maintaining whole-body stability. To this end, we propose BARE (Body-Aware Reflexive Evasion), a humanoid reflexive evasion framework guided by human motion priors that enables rapid local evasion while maintaining whole-body stability. A risk-guided motion adapter is designed to select reference motions from a retargeted human evasive motion library based on the threatened body region and to adjust their temporal phases based on collision urgency, allowing the robot to reach evasive postures before potential contact. Conditioned on the adapted reference and link-level collision risk, a reflexive evasion policy learns through reinforcement learning to coordinate local body adjustments with whole-body stabilization. We validate BARE in simulation and real-world experiments, demonstrating its ability to perform targeted local evasion while maintaining whole-body stability.

摘要（中文）：动态避障对于人形机器人在真实环境中安全部署至关重要，因为快速接近的物体要求机器人立即做出规避反应。近年来，反射式规避的研究主要集中于四足机器人，其通常依赖大规模全身动作。相比之下，人形机器人可以利用其丰富的身体关节结构，通过微小、局部的身体调整来实现规避。通过移动受威胁的身体部位而不重新定位整个身体，这类反应所需的执行时间和周围自由空间可能更少。然而，局部调整可能改变质量分布或支撑条件，使得在保持全身稳定性的同时实现快速规避具有挑战性。为此，我们提出了BARE（身体感知反射式规避），一种以人体运动先验引导的人形机器人反射式规避框架，能够在保持全身稳定性的同时实现快速局部规避。我们设计了一种风险引导的运动适配器，根据受威胁的身体部位从重定向后的人体规避运动库中选择参考运动，并根据碰撞紧迫性调整其时相，使机器人能够在潜在接触发生前达到规避姿态。以适配后的参考动作和连杆级碰撞风险为条件，反射式规避策略通过强化学习学习协调局部身体调整与全身稳定控制。我们在仿真和真实世界实验中验证了BARE，证明了其在保持全身稳定性的同时执行针对性局部规避的能力。
