Authors: Zihao Li, Tong Chen, Hua Song, Zitong Ding, Zihao Xu, Ce Hao, Weibang Bai

ReFocus: Progress-Guided Adaptive Practice for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

long-horizon manipulation progress-guided RL bottleneck diagnosis adaptive practice windows DAG-based reward

简要说明：ReFocus 是一个多轮强化学习框架，通过基于DAG的进度奖励识别并练习长时程操作中的瓶颈子任务，在模拟和真实任务中显著提高了成功率。

TLDR: ReFocus is a multi-round RL framework that identifies and practices bottleneck subtasks in long-horizon manipulation using DAG-based progress rewards, significantly improving success rates over baselines in simulation and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables vision-language-action policies to improve through environmental interaction. However, in long-horizon manipulation, sparse success/failure feedback provides little information about where policies encounter bottlenecks. Moreover, repeated full-task rollouts also leave these bottlenecks weakly analyzed and insufficiently practiced. To this end, we introduce ReFocus, a progress-guided multi-round RL framework that alternates between Global and Local RL to identify task-specific bottlenecks and allocate additional practice to them. Specifically, during Global RL, we decompose each task into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of subtasks. Then a DAG-based Progress Reward is leveraged for both policy training and bottleneck diagnosis. Based on the identified bottlenecks, ReFocus selects Adaptive Practice Windows, defining task segments from an entry stage to a target stage. It allocates additional interaction to these segments during Local RL while updating the entire policy. After that, it evaluates the policy to perform the full task for the next round of RL, forming an iteration between Global and Local RL. Experiments on LIBERO-Long and RoboCasa365 show that ReFocus achieves success rates of 97.8% and 51.3%, respectively, compared with 90.6% and 39.3% for the $π_{0.5}$ baseline. Furthermore, we evaluate a real-world adaptation on three long-horizon tasks. On BreadBaker, ReFocus achieves 95% success, compared with 30% for the $π_{0.5}$. Project page: https://refocus-robotics.github.io.

摘要（中文）：在线强化学习（RL）使得视觉-语言-动作策略能够通过与环境的交互不断改进。然而，在长时程操作任务中，稀疏的成功/失败反馈难以提供关于策略在何处遇到瓶颈的有效信息。此外，反复执行完整任务回放也使这些瓶颈得不到充分分析和针对性练习。为此，我们提出ReFocus，一种基于进度引导的多轮强化学习框架，在全局RL与局部RL之间交替运行，以识别任务特定的瓶颈并为其分配额外练习。具体而言，在全局RL阶段，我们将每个任务分解为子任务的有向无环图（DAG），并利用基于DAG的进度奖励同时进行策略训练和瓶颈诊断。基于识别出的瓶颈，ReFocus选择自适应练习窗口，定义从起始阶段到目标阶段的任务片段，在局部RL期间为这些片段分配额外的交互，同时更新整个策略。随后，对策略进行评估，执行完整任务以进入下一轮RL，形成全局RL与局部RL之间的迭代。在LIBERO-Long和RoboCasa365上的实验表明，ReFocus的成功率分别达到97.8%和51.3%，而$π_{0.5}$基线的成功率分别为90.6%和39.3%。此外，我们还在三个长时程任务上评估了真实世界的适应性。在BreadBaker任务中，ReFocus实现了95%的成功率，而$π_{0.5}$基线仅为30%。项目页面：https://refocus-robotics.github.io。

Authors: Haoyuan Li, Wei Huang, Jiehong Lin, Shengrong Zhang, Chenzhi Liu, Shengchao Zhou, Hehe Fan, Xiaojuan Qi, Yi Yang

MXI-MemICL: Towards In-Context Robot Manipulation through Self-Retrieved Interaction Memory VLA

in-context learning memory-guided retrieval vision-language-action model robotic manipulation demonstration memory

简要说明：MXI-MemICL提出了一种通过自检索交互记忆进行机器人操作上下文学习的方法，利用视觉-动作因果编码器和意图预测器检索示范并调节VLA策略，无需大规模预训练或额外标注，在仿真和真实机器人实验中均取得稳定提升。

TLDR: MXI-MemICL introduces a self-retrieved interaction memory mechanism for in-context robot manipulation, using a visual-action causal encoder and intention predictor to retrieve and condition demonstrations for VLA policies without extensive pretraining or annotations. It improves success rates in simulation and real robot experiments.

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) offers robots a way to acquire new skills from a single demonstration without parameter updates. However, existing robotic ICL methods either rely on large-scale pretraining constrained by scarce, costly robot interaction data or require additional annotations yet struggle to generalize across tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose MXI-MemICL, a framework for memory-guided ICL in vision-language-action (VLA) models. By treating demonstrations as retrievable memory, MXI-MemICL enables in-context manipulation without additional large-scale pretraining or specialized annotations. Specifically, a visual-action causal encoder turns actions and their observed effects in demonstrations and completed interactions into reusable memory to guide execution. To retrieve experience suited to upcoming execution, an intention predictor forecasts the next stage's intent and uses it to query memory. The retrieved experience conditions the language backbone through experience-token prefixes and gated cross-attention, guiding action generation with a learned gate that regulates its influence. MXI-MemICL improves success over the baseline by +8.2% and +14.4% on RoboCasa365 and RoboTwin 2.0. Real-robot experiments show a +9.0% gain, with demonstrations adding +5.0% on seen and +16.7% on unseen tasks. The code will be made publicly available.

摘要（中文）：上下文学习（ICL）使机器人能够通过单次演示获取新技能，而无需进行参数更新。然而，现有的机器人上下文学习方法要么依赖受稀缺且昂贵机器人交互数据限制的大规模预训练，要么需要额外标注却难以跨任务泛化。为弥合这一差距，我们提出MXI-MemICL，一种面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的记忆引导上下文学习框架。通过将演示视为可检索记忆，MXI-MemICL无需额外的大规模预训练或专门标注即可实现上下文操控。具体而言，视觉-动作因果编码器将演示及已完成交互中的动作及其观察到的效果转化为可复用记忆，以指导执行。为检索适合即将执行任务的经验，意图预测器预测下一阶段的意图，并以此查询记忆。检索到的经验通过经验令牌前缀和门控交叉注意力对语言主干进行条件约束，通过学习的门控机制调节其对动作生成的影响，从而指导动作生成。MXI-MemICL在RoboCasa365和RoboTwin 2.0上分别将成功率较基线提升+8.2%和+14.4%。真实机器人实验显示+9.0%的提升，其中演示在已见任务上贡献+5.0%，在未见任务上贡献+16.7%的提升。代码将公开发布。

Authors: Jialong Peng, Shihao Zhou, Feng Yan, Wen Xiao, Haozheng Wang, Wenqi Ren, Wenyuan Sheng, Jian Qiao, Jiaxu Miao, Lin Ma, Chao Yang

Next-Manip: On-Demand Agent-Policy Collaboration for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

agent-policy collaboration Agent Invocation Controller Task Dynamics Context robotic manipulation multimodal agents

简要说明：Next-Manip 提出了一种按需的智能体-策略协作框架，通过轻量级智能体调用控制器分配控制权，并利用任务动态上下文打包任务参考，在降低推理成本的同时实现了最先进的性能。

TLDR: Next-Manip introduces an on-demand agent-policy collaboration framework for robotic manipulation, using a lightweight Agent Invocation Controller to allocate control and Task Dynamics Context to package task references, achieving state-of-the-art performance with reduced agent inference costs.

Abstract: General-purpose robotic manipulation requires task reasoning, failure recovery, and precise control, yet limited manipulation data make these abilities difficult to obtain from a single policy. Recent multimodal agents show promise in task reasoning and recovery but lack reliable fine-grained control and incur high inference cost, whereas learned policies provide efficient fine-grained execution but struggle beyond their learned skills. Although their complementary strengths suggest combining the two, doing so requires repeatedly deciding which executor should act as task demands change. Instead of relying on the agent for each decision, we present Next-Manip, an on-demand agent--policy collaboration framework that decouples executor allocation from costly agent inference. We propose an Agent Invocation Controller (AIC) that allocates control between the policy and the agent through a lightweight classifier of current execution demands. We further introduce Task Dynamics Context (TDC), which packages informative manipulation changes from in-context examples into compact task references to support both agent reasoning and executor allocation. Across two simulation benchmarks and real-world experiments, Next-Manip achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing agent inference costs.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人操作需具备任务推理、失败恢复及精确控制能力，然而有限的操作数据使得单一策略难以同时获得这些能力。近期多模态智能体在任务推理与恢复方面展现潜力，但缺乏可靠的细粒度控制且推理成本高昂；而学习型策略虽能高效执行细粒度操作，却难以应对超出其学习技能范围的任务。尽管两者优势互补，暗示了结合使用的可能性，但任务需求变化时需反复决策由哪个执行器接管。我们不再依赖智能体进行每次决策，提出Next-Manip——一种按需的智能体-策略协作框架，将执行器分配与高成本的智能体推理解耦。我们设计了智能体调用控制器（AIC），通过轻量级分类器根据当前执行需求在策略与智能体间分配控制权。进一步引入任务动态上下文（TDC），将上下文示例中包含的信息性操作变化封装为紧凑的任务参考，同时支持智能体推理与执行器分配。在两项仿真基准测试及真实世界实验中，Next-Manip在降低智能体推理成本的同时达到了最先进性能。

Authors: Jiayi Liu, Ke Ye, Jiaming Zhou, Yufei Huang, Haotian Liang, Kun-Yu Lin, Junwei Liang

ContinualDrive: A Deployment-Anchored, Multi-Axis Benchmark for Continual Updates of Learned Driving Planners AutonomousDriving

continual learning driving planner closed-loop evaluation nuPlan deployment-anchored benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了ContinualDrive，一个用于自动驾驶规划器部署后持续学习评估的基准，揭示了闭环性能在更新后往往下降，尽管开环指标有所提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces ContinualDrive, a benchmark for evaluating continual learning of autonomous driving planners in a deployment-anchored manner, revealing that closed-loop performance often degrades after updates despite open-loop gains.

Abstract: Learned driving planners keep being updated after deployment as new logs arrive, yet continual learning evaluations rarely ask whether an update improves on the deployed model, and their verdicts rest on unstated evaluation choices. We present ContinualDrive, a deployment-anchored benchmark for post-deployment continual learning of driving planners. It updates a deployed planner on real-world nuPlan logs one scenario-type group at a time, evaluates the same checkpoints in open and closed loop, makes four measurement axes explicit (evaluation loop, reference checkpoint, temporal aggregation and stream protocol), and anchors a three-valued release verdict to the deployed checkpoint. We study two planners (PlanTF and Diffusion Planner) under full fine-tuning and adapter or LoRA updates, with and without replay or gradient projection, in three task orders. Verdicts can reverse or vanish when one axis changes: open-loop ADE ranks the final PlanTF model above the deployed one in half of its core-suite runs, whereas every closed-loop score ranks it below; backward transfer misses this loss, which on average is already present when each group has just been learned; and regime rankings vary far less across training seeds than across task orders. In the core suite of full and adapter updates, no regime measurably improved on the deployed planner in closed loop; on a panel more than ten times larger every evaluated final checkpoint trails it, and joint training on all groups recovers much of the loss without exceeding its nuPlan closed-loop score. We distill these findings into a reporting contract and will release the code and all checkpoints.

摘要（中文）：学习型驾驶规划器在部署后会随着新日志的到来而持续更新，然而持续学习评估很少追问更新是否真正优于已部署模型，其结论也往往依赖于未言明的评估选择。我们提出ContinualDrive，一个以部署为锚点的驾驶规划器部署后持续学习基准。该基准在真实世界nuPlan日志上按场景类型分组逐一更新已部署规划器，在开环和闭环两种模式下评估同一检查点，明确四个测量轴（评估回路、参考检查点、时间聚合与数据流协议），并将三值发布判定锚定于已部署检查点。我们在三种任务顺序下，针对两种规划器（PlanTF和Diffusion Planner），考察了全量微调以及适配器或LoRA更新，并对比有无回放或梯度投影的情况。研究结果显示，当任一测量轴发生变化时，判定结果可能反转或消失：在核心套件半数运行中，开环ADE将最终PlanTF模型排在已部署模型之上，而所有闭环分数均将其排在后者之下；反向迁移未能捕捉到这一损失，而该损失在每组刚学习完毕时平均就已存在；不同训练随机种子下的方案排名差异远小于不同任务顺序间的差异。在包含全量更新和适配器更新的核心套件中，没有任何方案在闭环评估中显著优于已部署规划器；在规模扩大十倍以上的测试面板上，所有评估的最终检查点均落后于已部署模型，而基于全部分组联合训练虽能恢复大部分损失，但仍未超越其nuPlan闭环分数。我们将这些发现凝练为一项报告契约，并将公开代码及所有检查点。

Authors: Zirui Li, Zhiqi Mao, Yangang Ren, Heye Huang, Haohan Yang, Qihang Huang, Zhan Chen, Chen Lv

Boundary-Aware Policy Learning for Agent-Orchestrated Robot Manipulation Manipulation

boundary-aware policy learning agent-orchestrated robot manipulation handoff boundary visuomotor policy self-improvement

简要说明：本文提出边界感知策略学习，通过显式塑造和扩展多模态智能体与学习型视觉运动策略之间的交接边界，实现了更稳健的智能体编排机器人操作，提高了成功率并降低了成本。

TLDR: The paper introduces Boundary-Aware Policy Learning, which explicitly shapes and expands the handoff boundary between a multimodal agent and learned visuomotor policies, enabling robust agent-orchestrated robot manipulation with higher success rates and lower cost.

Abstract: Agent-orchestrated robot systems combine the general reasoning capability of multimodal agents with the precise physical control of learned visuomotor policies. Yet such systems often fail at the moment of handoff: a policy is reliable only from a limited set of start states, while the agent may invoke it outside this region. We call this region the policy's handoff boundary. Existing whole-task policies typically have handoff boundaries that are narrow and difficult for an agent to characterize, making reliable coordination challenging. We propose Boundary-Aware Policy Learning, which explicitly shapes and then expands the handoff boundary of a visuomotor policy. First, Boundary-Explicit Training fine-tunes the policy on contact segments with diverse start poses, yielding a wide and well-defined boundary that can be communicated to the agent through a simple handoff protocol. Second, Boundary-Expanding Self-Improvement retrains the policy on curated successful system rollouts, extending the boundary toward earlier stages of each task and allowing the agent to hand over sooner with fewer language-model calls. Across RoboTwin 2.0 and RoboDojo, our system outperforms the strongest baseline by over 26 percentage points, reaching 98.4% success in randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes, while further reducing its API cost and execution time by 41.3% and 37.5%, respectively. These results suggest that the key to robust agent-policy orchestration lies not only in improving either component individually, but also in explicitly shaping the boundary between them.

摘要（中文）：Agent编排的机器人系统将多模态代理的通用推理能力与学习到的视觉运动策略的精确物理控制相结合。然而，这类系统往往在交接时刻失败：策略仅对有限的初始状态集合可靠，而代理可能会在该区域之外调用它。我们将该区域称为策略的交接边界。现有的全任务策略通常具有狭窄且难以被代理表征的交接边界，这使得可靠协调充满挑战。我们提出边界感知策略学习（Boundary-Aware Policy Learning），该方法显式塑造并扩展视觉运动策略的交接边界。首先，边界显式训练（Boundary-Explicit Training）在具有多样初始姿态的接触片段上对策略进行微调，产生一个宽广且明确定义的边界，可通过简单的交接协议传达给代理。其次，边界扩展自改进（Boundary-Expanding Self-Improvement）在精心筛选的成功系统回放轨迹上重新训练策略，将边界向每个任务的更早阶段延伸，使代理能够更早交接，并减少语言模型调用次数。在RoboTwin 2.0和RoboDojo上，我们的系统比最强基线高出超过26个百分点，在随机化RoboTwin 2.0场景中达到98.4%的成功率，同时进一步将API成本和执行时间分别降低41.3%和37.5%。这些结果表明，实现稳健的代理-策略编排的关键不仅在于分别改进各个组件，还在于显式塑造它们之间的边界。

Authors: Kaipeng Fang, Yuhao Wang, Ji Zhang, Yunsong Zhou, Jingkuan Song, Lianli Gao

Disentangling Visual Dynamics for World Model Planning WorldModel

disentangled visual dynamics world model planning counterfactual learning semantic routing continuous control

简要说明：本文提出了 FactorWorld，一种用于世界模型规划的解耦视觉动态框架，通过反事实共识残差因子分解器和语义路由分离智能体与外源动态，在 MiniGrid、MetaDrive 和 CARLA 上提升了规划性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces FactorWorld, a disentangled visual dynamics framework for world model planning that separates agent and exogenous dynamics using counterfactual consensus residual factorizer and semantic routing, improving planning performance on MiniGrid, MetaDrive, and CARLA.

Abstract: Visual world models enable planning through predictive latent states. However, entangled agent and exogenous dynamics can obscure task progress. Disentangling visual dynamics for planning requires addressing two challenges: 1) suppressing cross-factor interference while retaining useful information; and 2) linking factors to task-relevant signals, since stability alone does not ensure meaningful planning distances. Therefore, we introduce FactorWorld, a disentangled visual dynamics framework for world model planning. To separate agent and exogenous dynamics, we propose a Counterfactual Consensus Residual Factorizer (CCRF) guided by bidirectional counterfactual pairs. CCRF separates shared context from dynamic residuals, combining average and worst-partner constraints to suppress interference with state and motion supervision to retain useful information. To translate these factors into planning decisions, we introduce semantic routing to refine full-representation task predictions for state estimation, trajectory scoring, and task-adapted planning. Experiments on MiniGrid, MetaDrive, and CARLA show improved bidirectional factor stability across two backbones. On MiniGrid, factor routing raises mean SR from 78.80% to 82.40%. Across four continuous control tasks, including Push-T, FactorWorld achieves mean success rates ranging from 91.67% to 100% across tasks. These results demonstrate that combining decoupled visual dynamics with explicit tasks can significantly improve the planning capabilities of world models.

摘要（中文）：视觉世界模型能够通过预测潜在状态实现规划。然而，智能体动态与外部动态相互纠缠，可能掩盖任务进展。为实现规划而解耦视觉动态需解决两个挑战：1) 在保留有用信息的同时抑制跨因素干扰；2) 将因素与任务相关信号关联起来，因为仅凭稳定性并不能确保有意义的规划距离。为此，我们提出FactorWorld，一种用于世界模型规划的解耦视觉动态框架。为分离智能体动态与外部动态，我们提出由双向反事实对引导的反事实共识残差因子分解器（CCRF）。CCRF将共享上下文与动态残差分离，结合平均约束与最差伙伴约束以抑制干扰，并通过状态与运动监督保留有用信息。为将这些因素转化为规划决策，我们引入语义路由，以优化全表征任务预测，用于状态估计、轨迹评分及任务自适应规划。在MiniGrid、MetaDrive和CARLA上的实验表明，两种骨干网络下的双向因素稳定性均有所提升。在MiniGrid上，因素路由将平均成功率从78.80%提升至82.40%。在包括Push-T在内的四项连续控制任务中，FactorWorld的平均成功率介于91.67%至100%之间。这些结果表明，将解耦视觉动态与显式任务相结合，能够显著提升世界模型的规划能力。

Authors: Yuhong Shi, Yihan Guo, Jie Wei, Jianyi Liu, Jingwen Fu

SkillHarness: Execution-Aware Coordination with Plug-and-Play Skills for Long-Horizon Traversal Locomotion

execution-aware coordination plug-and-play skill library vision-language-guided perceptive reinforcement learning long-horizon traversal

简要说明：SkillHarness 是一个用于长时程地形穿越的执行感知协调框架，集成了即插即用的运动技能库、视觉语言引导的协调、感知强化学习以增强鲁棒性，以及执行反馈以自适应技能选择。

TLDR: SkillHarness is an execution-aware coordination framework for long-horizon terrain traversal, integrating a plug-and-play locomotion skill library with vision-language-guided coordination, perceptive RL for robustness, and execution feedback for adaptive skill selection.

Abstract: Traversing complex terrain requires robots to coordinate diverse locomotion skills while adapting to unseen obstacles and changing environments. Although perceptive reinforcement learning enables agile locomotion, conventional multi-terrain locomotion rely on fixed policy, limiting adaptability and skill extensibility. Perceptual disturbances and unreliable skill transitions further challenge robust execution. To address these challenges, we propose SkillHarness, an execution-aware coordination framework that integrates a flexible, plug-and-play locomotion skill library. To enhance traversal robustness, we introduce a perceptive reinforcement learning approach that preserves task-relevant environmental references while continuously updating proprioceptive feedback, reducing sensitivity to perceptual fluctuations. A vision-language-guided Harness coordinates navigation and skill execution through event-triggered reasoning, geometric feasibility verification, and execution-phase constraints. By flexibly composing and extending available skills, SkillHarness adapts to unseen terrain and task combinations without retraining the locomotion policies. The framework further incorporates execution feedback and retrospective decision revision to improve skill selection and avoid inappropriate skill switching. We evaluate SkillHarness across diverse terrain configurations, perceptual disturbances, and multi-obstacle traversal tasks to assess its adaptability and reliability in long-horizon traversal.

摘要（中文）：穿越复杂地形要求机器人协调多种运动技能，同时适应未知障碍和动态变化的环境。尽管基于感知的强化学习能够实现敏捷运动，但传统的多地形运动依赖于固定策略，限制了适应性和技能可扩展性。感知干扰和不可靠的技能切换进一步对鲁棒执行构成挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了SkillHarness——一种执行感知协调框架，集成了灵活、即插即用的运动技能库。为增强穿越鲁棒性，我们引入了一种基于感知的强化学习方法，在持续更新本体感觉反馈的同时保留与任务相关的环境参考，从而降低对感知波动的敏感性。一种视觉-语言引导的Harness通过事件触发推理、几何可行性验证和执行阶段约束来协调导航与技能执行。通过灵活组合和扩展可用技能，SkillHarness无需重新训练运动策略即可适应未见地形和任务组合。该框架进一步融入执行反馈与回顾式决策修正，以改善技能选择并避免不当技能切换。我们在多种地形配置、感知干扰和多障碍穿越任务中评估了SkillHarness，以检验其在长时程穿越中的适应性和可靠性。

Authors: Bailin He, Xiting Zhao, Kang Wang, Xinyu Zhou, Yongxing Cui, Haojie Liu, Qiao Sun, Hongyan Zhang, Wenqiang Zhang

Reading Geometric Anchors: Viewpoint Generalization in Imitation Learning for Robotic Manipulation with RGB-Only Deployment Manipulation

viewpoint generalization imitation learning geometric anchors robotic manipulation RGB-only deployment

简要说明：ReGeoAnch 是一个基于几何锚点的模仿学习框架，通过构建全局和局部锚点提供跨视角的共享物理参考，并结合解耦的外观引导几何读取和跨视角一致性，提高了 RGB 机器人操作中的视角泛化能力。

TLDR: ReGeoAnch is a geometry-anchored imitation learning framework that improves viewpoint generalization in RGB-based robotic manipulation by building global and local anchors for shared physical references across views, and using decoupled appearance-guided geometric readout with cross-view consistency.

Abstract: Moving the camera changes where objects appear in an image, challenging RGB-based imitation learning. A common strategy pairs synthesized views with the same demonstrated action, but ignores supporting physical correspondence across views. By predicting depth with camera calibrations, 3D policies may handle it yet suffer the issue of varied observed point sets. To address these limitations, we propose ReGeoAnch, a geometry-anchored imitation learning framework for viewpoint generalization. Specifically, we build global anchors in the robot base frame and local anchors in the gripper frame, providing shared physical references across viewpoints. Furthermore, Decoupled Appearance-Guided Geometric Readout uses Point-to-Anchor Aggregation (PAA) to obtain comparable and stable geometry around anchors beyond pointwise correspondence. A controllable and decoupled information flow, Anchor-to-Policy Readout (APR), leverages complementary visual and geometric information and supports viewpoint generalization: view-dependent appearances are queried by view-invariant robot state to select task-relevant anchors, with geometric values alone to form the final readout. We further introduce Cross-View Readout Consistency to align the directions of policy readouts from paired source and synthesized target views. Experiments on 12 manipulation tasks across MetaWorld and ManiSkill3 demonstrate improved viewpoint generalization over baseline policies.

摘要（中文）：移动相机会改变物体在图像中的位置，这对基于RGB的模仿学习构成了挑战。一种常见策略是将合成视图与相同的示范动作配对，但忽略了跨视图间支撑性的物理对应关系。通过利用相机标定预测深度，3D策略或许能够应对这一问题，但仍面临观测点集不一致的困扰。为解决上述局限，我们提出了ReGeoAnch，一种面向视角泛化的几何锚定模仿学习框架。具体而言，我们在机器人基座坐标系中构建全局锚点，在夹爪坐标系中构建局部锚点，从而为不同视角提供共享的物理参考。此外，解耦外观引导的几何读出模块采用点-锚聚合（PAA）方法，在超越逐点对应的基础上获取锚点周围可比且稳定的几何信息。可控且解耦的信息流——锚点-策略读出（APR）模块，利用互补的视觉与几何信息支持视角泛化：视角相关的外观信息由视角无关的机器人状态查询，以选择任务相关的锚点，最终仅利用几何值形成读出结果。我们还引入了跨视角读出一致性约束，以对齐成对源视图与合成目标视图的策略读出方向。在MetaWorld和ManiSkill3上的12项操控任务实验中，所提方法相较于基线策略在视角泛化性能上取得了显著提升。

Authors: Chengyu Tao, Chunxi Huang

RoboProbe: Benchmarking Physical Plausibility of Robot World Models WorldModel

physical plausibility world models video evaluation spatiotemporal reasoning manipulation

简要说明：该论文提出了RoboProbe，一个通过特定物理法则指标评估机器人世界模型生成视频物理合理性的代理式评估框架，并构建了包含人工标注视频的RP-Bench基准。该框架在检测五种视频生成器的物理违规方面优于现有评估器。

TLDR: This paper introduces RoboProbe, an agentic evaluation framework with law-specific metrics to assess the physical plausibility of videos generated by robot world models, along with RP-Bench, a benchmark of human-labeled videos for evaluating these metrics. The framework outperforms existing evaluators on detecting physical violations across five video generators.

Abstract: Evaluating the physical plausibility of generated videos is critical for reliable robotic planning with world models. These videos inform action proposal and assessment before real-world execution, so undetected physical violations can lead to erroneous assessments of action feasibility and safety. Yet current video generators often produce physically implausible interactions. Detecting such violations directly with vision-language models (VLMs) remains challenging as physical verification requires evidence-grounded spatiotemporal reasoning beyond high-level semantic understanding. We develop five law-specific metrics for evaluating physical plausibility by combining spatiotemporal evidence from segmentation, tracking, 3D geometry, or appearance comparisons with targeted VLM reasoning: Contact fidelity, Object persistence, Solidity, Robot deformation, and Object deformation. Building on this metric suite, we introduce RoboProbe, an agentic evaluation framework that coordinates metric execution and selectively refines evaluations through constrained actions. To evaluate the physical plausibility of robot world models, we further introduce RP-Bench, with 761 human-labeled generated videos and 130 real demonstrations of 239 manipulation tasks from 12 robot datasets. On RP-Bench, all five metrics achieve AUROCs above 0.85 and outperform the evaluated learned judges, prior evaluators, and a frames-only Gemini baseline. Applying these metrics to five video generators reveals distinct patterns of physical violations across models, in both violation types and frequencies.

摘要（中文）：评估生成视频的物理合理性，对于基于世界模型的可靠机器人规划至关重要。此类视频在实际执行前为动作提案与评估提供依据，因此，未被检测到的物理违例可能导致对动作可行性与安全性产生错误判断。然而，当前的视频生成器常常产生物理上不合理的交互。直接利用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）检测此类违例仍具挑战性，因为物理验证需要基于证据的时空推理，这超出了高层语义理解的范畴。我们开发了五项针对特定物理法则的评估指标，通过结合来自分割、跟踪、三维几何或外观比较的时空证据与目标化的VLM推理，来评估物理合理性，具体包括：接触保真度、物体持续性、坚固性、机器人形变以及物体形变。基于这一指标体系，我们进一步提出了RoboProbe，一个智能体化评估框架，用于协调指标执行，并通过受约束的动作选择性地细化评估。为评估机器人世界模型的物理合理性，我们还引入了RP-Bench基准，包含来自12个机器人数据集的239个操作任务的761个带人工标注的生成视频及130个真实演示。在RP-Bench上，所有五项指标的AUROC均超过0.85，且优于所评估的学习型评判器、先前评估器以及仅基于帧的Gemini基线。将这些指标应用于五个视频生成器，揭示了不同模型在违例类型与频率上的显著物理违例模式差异。

Authors: Zhuoying Yang, Jiachen Ni, Yichen Guo, Xiaoshan Wu, Mengyu Wang

Duo: Towards Spatiotemporal Action Coordination in Bimanual Policies Manipulation

bimanual manipulation flow matching cross-arm attention action tokenization robotic policies

简要说明：Duo 提出了一种共享动作头，将双臂动作在每个时间步分解为两个令牌，通过跨臂注意力增强双臂协调，并在多个策略上提升了成功率。

TLDR: Duo introduces a shared action head that separates bimanual arm actions into two tokens per timestep, enabling cross-arm attention during flow matching to improve coordination and success rates across multiple policies.

Abstract: Bimanual manipulation requires each arm to perform distinct motions while coordinating with the other. Common flow-based robotic policies combine both arms' actions into one token per future timestep, giving attention distinct positions across time but not across arms. We introduce Duo, a simple but effective design that models spatial and temporal dependencies within one shared action head. Specifically, Duo separates both arms into two action tokens per timestep, allowing each arm's motion to interact via cross-arm attention during flow matching. On RoboTwin 2.0, Duo improves the overall success of all four base policies, from 0.45B to 3.62B parameters, with gains of 12.55 and 9.02 percentage points for FLOWER (0.89B) and $π_{0.5}$ (3.62B), respectively. Despite its compact size, FLOWER-Duo achieves the best randomized-generalization, precision, and memory scores on RoboDojo. In real-world tasks, it outperforms $π_{0.5}$ in both success rate and execution speed, while scaling effectively with increasing training data. To provide deeper insight into the design of Duo, we conduct systematic ablations on inter-arm coordination, action grouping, and token granularity, confirming that cross-arm attention drives the improvement while arm-wise interaction offers the best accuracy-compute trade-off.

摘要（中文）：双臂操作要求每只手臂在执行不同运动的同时，与另一只手臂进行协调。常见的基于流的机器人策略将双臂动作合并为每个未来时间步的一个令牌，从而使注意力在不同时间位置间分布，但并未在双臂之间进行区分。我们提出Duo，一种简单而有效的设计，在共享动作头内同时建模空间和时间依赖关系。具体而言，Duo将每只手臂在每个时间步分离为两个动作令牌，使得各手臂的运动能够在流匹配过程中通过跨臂注意力进行交互。在RoboTwin 2.0上，Duo将四种基础策略的整体成功率从0.45B参数提升至3.62B参数，其中FLOWER（0.89B）和π₀.₅（3.62B）分别提升了12.55和9.02个百分点。尽管FLOWER-Duo规模紧凑，但在RoboDojo上却取得了最佳的随机泛化、精度和记忆得分。在真实世界任务中，它在成功率和执行速度上均优于π₀.₅，同时随着训练数据的增加表现出有效的扩展能力。为深入理解Duo的设计，我们对臂间协调、动作分组和令牌粒度进行了系统性消融实验，确认跨臂注意力是性能提升的关键驱动因素，而按臂交互则在精度与计算开销之间提供了最佳权衡。

Authors: Zhimu Zhou, Yuqi Yang, Yixin Lin, Junsen Zhang, Jian Zhao, Jiayu Zhong, Jiaxun Sun, Bingxin Wang, Binhua Zuo, Bo Zhao

Ego2Real: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Visuo-Tactile Demonstrations Manipulation

bimanual dexterous manipulation egocentric demonstrations tactile sensing contact-informed reinforcement learning human-to-robot skill transfer

简要说明：Ego2Real利用以自我为中心的演示和触觉手套重建双手物体交互，并通过接触信息增强的强化学习训练拟人机器手，提高灵巧操作技能迁移的成功率。

TLDR: Ego2Real uses egocentric demonstrations and tactile gloves to reconstruct bimanual hand-object interactions and train anthropomorphic robotic hands via contact-informed reinforcement learning, improving dexterous manipulation transfer.

Abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation from egocentric human demonstrations offers a scalable path toward robot skill acquisition. Vision alone, however, provides limited information about physical contacts and the demonstrator's force intent, leading to ambiguities in interpreting hand-object interactions. Capturing human touch via tactile sensing is therefore crucial for reliable human-to-robot dexterous skill transfer. We present Ego2Real, a framework that leverages egocentric demonstrations and tactile gloves to transfer bimanual dexterous manipulation skills to robotic hands. Ego2Real incorporates tactile supervision at two complementary stages: (1) tactile-guided hand-object interaction reconstruction, which uses measured tactile signals to refine hand poses and contact geometry; and (2) contact-informed reinforcement learning, which translates human contact patterns into robotic contact rewards. By combining refined motion references with physical contact rewards during training, Ego2Real guides anthropomorphic robotic hands to emulate demonstrated contact behaviors while adapting to their own morphology and actuation. Experiments show that incorporating tactile supervision into both reconstruction and policy learning yields higher manipulation success rates, underscoring the importance of enriching egocentric demonstrations with tactile observations to improve their quality and transferability.

摘要（中文）：从自我中心的人类演示中学习灵巧操作，为机器人技能习得提供了一条可扩展的路径。然而，仅依靠视觉对手部接触和演示者的力意图提供的信息有限，导致在手-物交互的解读上存在歧义。因此，通过触觉感知捕捉人类触觉信息，对于实现可靠的人到机器人灵巧技能迁移至关重要。我们提出了Ego2Real框架，该框架利用自我中心演示和触觉手套将双臂灵巧操作技能迁移至机器人手部。Ego2Real在两个互补阶段引入触觉监督：（1）触觉引导的手-物交互重建，利用实测触觉信号细化手部姿态和接触几何；（2）接触信息增强的强化学习，将人类接触模式转化为机器人接触奖励。通过在训练过程中将精细化的运动参考与物理接触奖励相结合，Ego2Real引导拟人机器人手部模仿演示的接触行为，同时适应其自身的形态结构和驱动方式。实验表明，在重建和策略学习两个阶段均引入触觉监督可显著提高操作成功率，这凸显了利用触觉观测丰富自我中心演示以提升其质量和可迁移性的重要性。

Authors: Ange Bao, Haishan Zhang, Lingzi Xie, Shuang Li, Pei Zhao, Ling Shi, Bidan Huang

ActiveBridge: Scaling Active Prior for Robots through Egocentric Perception-Interaction Modeling VLA

active prior egocentric perception world-action modeling head-wrist action active manipulation

简要说明：ActiveBridge 是一种训练框架，通过世界-动作建模从自我中心视频中学习人类主动先验并传递给机器人，使机器人仅用单个头部摄像头主动控制视角以完成操作任务。联合预测未来视频和同步的头-腕动作轨迹，并通过显式头部动作监督，提升了主动操作基准的性能。

TLDR: ActiveBridge is a training framework that learns human active priors from egocentric videos and transfers them to robots via world-action modeling, enabling a single head camera to actively control viewpoint for manipulation tasks. Jointly predicting future videos and synchronized head-wrist action trajectories with explicit head-action supervision improves performance on active manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Robotics foundation models are now widely used for manipulation, and egocentric videos offer rich data for scaling. However, existing methods overlook the human active priors captured in egocentric videos, which limits performance in unstructured scenes. They act on given observations instead of actively seeking information as humans do. We propose ActiveBridge, a training framework that learns these human active priors and transfers them to robots through world-action modeling. We design a robot that actively controls its viewpoint through head actions to acquire the visual information needed for manipulation using a single head camera, without wrist cameras. During human training, an instruction-conditioned model jointly predicts future egocentric videos and synchronized head-wrist action trajectories, with head actions providing explicit supervision for active perception. Experiments show that ActiveBridge outperforms baselines on active manipulation tasks, while ablations demonstrate the benefit of joint head-wrist action supervision.

摘要（中文）：机器人基础模型现已广泛用于操作任务，而第一人称视频为规模化提供了丰富的数据。然而，现有方法忽视了第一人称视频中捕捉到的人类主动先验，这限制了其在非结构化场景中的表现。它们基于给定的观察进行动作，而非像人类那样主动寻求信息。我们提出ActiveBridge，一种训练框架，用于学习这些人类主动先验，并通过世界-动作建模将其迁移至机器人。我们设计了一种机器人，能够通过头部动作主动控制其视角，利用单个头部摄像头获取操作所需的视觉信息，无需腕部摄像头。在人类训练阶段，一个指令条件模型联合预测未来的第一人称视频以及同步的头部-腕部动作轨迹，其中头部动作提供了对主动感知的显式监督。实验表明，ActiveBridge在主动操作任务上优于基线方法，而消融实验则证明了头部-腕部联合动作监督的益处。

Authors: Zixiao Gu, Qiren Qin, Yu He, Zhengyang Liu, Da Huang, Hongquan Zhang, Simo Wu, Peng Zhou, Guangnan Ye, Yunbo Wang, Yanwei Fu

MARGIN: A Risk-Aware Agent for Robot Program Refinement Manipulation

robot program refinement near-miss margin risk-aware safe racing LIBERO

简要说明：MARGIN 提出一种风险感知代理，利用成功机器人回滚中的执行预算余量来指导程序优化，在 LIBERO 和 Robosuite 基准上减少了失败和执行步骤。

TLDR: MARGIN introduces a risk-aware agent that uses execution budget margins from successful robot rollouts to guide program refinement, reducing failures and execution steps across LIBERO and Robosuite benchmarks.

Abstract: Robot-programming agents improve executable control policies through repeated testing and repair, yet binary success saturates while execution risk persists across unseen scenes. We introduce MARGIN, a risk-aware agent that converts successful robot rollouts into actionable evidence for program refinement. Its near-miss margin measures the fraction of the execution budget remaining in the slowest successful development rollout. The agent uses this signal to prioritize fragile programs, guide targeted repairs, and select revisions that preserve development success while increasing execution headroom. An exact safe-racing rule accelerates success-based candidate evaluation. We evaluate MARGIN across LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-90, and Robosuite. In our 80-task LIBERO-Pro reproduction, 78 programs attain perfect development success while accounting for substantial failures on unseen seeds. The near-miss margin predicts held-out failures with an AUC of 0.774, and low-margin programs exhibit 2.97 times higher failure risk. Across two independent evaluation rounds spanning 37 unique LIBERO-Pro tasks, MARGIN reduces executed control steps by 10.7% and 15.0%, with reductions of 18.0-20.0% on LIBERO-90 and Robosuite. Safe racing reduces fixed-sequence candidate-evaluation episodes by 53.5% while retaining identical selections, and paired execution probes improve acceptance decisions by identifying hidden regressions. Together, these results establish near-miss evidence as an effective basis for risk-aware, budget-efficient robot program refinement.

摘要（中文）：机器人编程智能体通过反复测试和修复来改进可执行的控制策略，然而，二元成功指标趋于饱和，而执行风险在未见场景中仍然持续存在。我们提出MARGIN，一种风险感知智能体，它将成功的机器人 rollout 转化为可操作的程序改进证据。其“险失裕度”衡量最慢成功开发 rollout 中剩余执行预算的比例。该智能体利用此信号对脆弱程序进行优先级排序、指导针对性修复，并选择既能保持开发成功又能增加执行余量的修订方案。一条精确的“安全竞速”规则加速了基于成功的候选方案评估。我们在 LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-90 和 Robosuite 上评估了 MARGIN。在我们包含 80 个任务的 LIBERO-Pro 复现中，78 个程序达到了完美的开发成功率，但在未见种子上存在大量失败。险失裕度以 0.774 的 AUC 预测了保留失败，低裕度程序的失败风险高出 2.97 倍。在覆盖 37 个独特 LIBERO-Pro 任务的两轮独立评估中，MARGIN 将执行控制步骤分别减少了 10.7% 和 15.0%，在 LIBERO-90 和 Robosuite 上减少了 18.0%-20.0%。安全竞速使固定序列候选评估轮次减少了 53.5%，同时保持了相同选择结果，而成对执行探针通过识别隐藏回归改进了接受决策。综合来看，这些结果确立了险失证据作为风险感知、预算高效的机器人程序改进的有效基础。

Authors: Hongbo Duan, Fan Du, Haipeng Luo, Bin Qian, Zichao Nie, Yilin Mi, Yaopeng Tian, Jiake Tian, Siyuan Liu, Yan Gao, Fangming Liu, Xueqian Wang

RoboHarness-RL: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for VLM-Based Robot Manipulation VLA

agentic reinforcement learning VLM-based robot manipulation multi-turn RL tool calls hierarchical memory

简要说明：RoboHarness-RL 提出了一种代理式强化学习框架，通过工具调用来微调紧凑型视觉语言模型以进行机器人操作，在 RoboTwin 2.0 和 LIBERO-Pro 基准上提高了成功率，且不依赖 VLA 或世界动作模型。

TLDR: RoboHarness-RL presents an agentic reinforcement learning framework that fine-tunes compact vision-language models for robot manipulation via tool calls, improving success rates on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Pro benchmarks without relying on VLA or world action models.

Abstract: Agentic harnesses enable frontier vision-language models (VLMs) to manipulate robots through perception, planning, and control tools, yet achieving comparable performance with compact open-weight VLMs remains challenging. We present RoboHarness-RL, an agentic reinforcement learning framework for improving VLM-based robot manipulation through tool calls. Starting from supervised fine-tuning on successful teacher demonstrations, the VLM further improves through multi-turn reinforcement learning with task-outcome rewards, without relying on vision-language-action models or world action models. To support efficient multi-turn training, we develop LiteHarness, which uses hierarchical memory to keep interaction contexts compact while preserving task performance. With Qwen3.5-9B, RL raises success from 31.2% to 44.0% on RoboTwin 2.0 and from 57.8% to 73.3% on LIBERO-Pro; these gains extend to randomized RoboTwin scenes unseen during training (26.4% to 38.0%). Behavioral analysis further shows that RL reduces repetitive-call rates by up to $4\times$, shortens successful executions, and improves recovery from negative feedback. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/RoboHarness-RL/

摘要（中文）：智能体工具框架使前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）能够通过感知、规划和控制工具操纵机器人，然而，让紧凑型开源权重VLM达到同等性能仍具挑战。我们提出RoboHarness-RL，一种基于智能体的强化学习框架，通过工具调用提升基于VLM的机器人操作能力。该方法从在成功教师示范上的监督微调出发，进一步通过多轮强化学习与任务结果奖励相结合来改进VLM，无需依赖视觉-语言-动作模型或世界动作模型。为支持高效的多轮训练，我们开发了LiteHarness，其采用分层记忆机制，在保持任务性能的同时压缩交互上下文。基于Qwen3.5-9B，强化学习在RoboTwin 2.0上将成功率从31.2%提升至44.0%，在LIBERO-Pro上从57.8%提升至73.3%；这些提升同样扩展到训练中未见过的随机化RoboTwin场景（从26.4%提升至38.0%）。行为分析进一步表明，强化学习将重复调用率降低高达4倍，缩短成功执行时间，并改善了从负面反馈中的恢复能力。项目主页：https://aim-uofa.github.io/RoboHarness-RL/

Authors: Liyang Li, Mingyu Liu, Xiaoman Li, Zhiyue Zhao, Jin-Chuan Shi, Canyu Zhao, Haokai Zhang, Jinyuan Tian, Linhao Zhong, Hao Chen, Chunhua Shen

Perception Is Enough, at the Right Scale: Scale-Adaptive Token Pruning for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

token pruning vision-language-action models scale-adaptive real-time robotic control training-free

简要说明：TauPrune-VLA 提出了一种无需训练的尺度自适应令牌剪枝方法，用于视觉-语言-动作模型，在模拟基准和真实机器人上实现最高1.86倍推理加速，同时保持接近基线的任务成功率。

TLDR: TauPrune-VLA introduces a training-free, scale-adaptive token pruning method for Vision-Language-Action models, achieving up to 1.86x inference speedup with near-baseline task success rates across simulation benchmarks and real robots.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models must process continuous streams of visual observations, and the resulting computational cost limits real-time robotic control. Token pruning reduces this cost, but a fixed semantic scale of perceptual representation can overlook information needed at different stages of manipulation. We show that perceptual semantics can guide effective token selection without relying on internal attention when the selection scale adapts to the scene's evolving semantic structure. Based on this observation, we introduce TauPrune-VLA, a training-free method that controls the scale of the retained perceptual representation through a single perception temperature $τ$. To adapt this scale as manipulation proceeds, TauPrune-VLA updates $τ$ online using trends in perceptual semantics, with robot-state changes and action magnitude regulating the adjustment strength. While these semantics evolve over the course of manipulation, they remain relatively stable between consecutive frames. This continuity allows retention indices computed from the current observation to be applied at the next policy invocation, enabling token selection to run asynchronously with inference and reducing pruning overhead. Evaluated across diverse VLA models and simulation benchmarks, TauPrune-VLA achieves up to a $1.86\times$ inference speedup while maintaining near-baseline task success rates. We further validate its effectiveness on two real-world robotic platforms.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型必须处理连续的视觉观察流，由此产生的计算成本限制了机器人的实时控制。令牌剪枝可以降低这一成本，但固定语义尺度的感知表示可能会忽略操作不同阶段所需的信息。我们发现，当选择尺度适应场景不断演变的语义结构时，感知语义可以在不依赖内部注意力的情况下有效指导令牌选择。基于这一观察，我们引入了TauPrune-VLA，一种无需训练的免训练方法，通过单一的感知温度$τ$来控制保留的感知表示的尺度。为了在操作过程中自适应调整该尺度，TauPrune-VLA利用感知语义的趋势在线更新$τ$，并以机器人状态变化和动作幅度来调节调整强度。虽然这些语义在操作过程中不断演变，但它们在相邻帧之间保持相对稳定。这种连续性使得从当前观测计算出的保留索引可以应用于下一次策略调用，从而使令牌选择能够与推理异步运行，并降低剪枝开销。在多种VLA模型和仿真基准上的评估表明，TauPrune-VLA实现了高达$1.86\times$的推理加速，同时保持了接近基准的任务成功率。我们进一步在两个真实机器人平台上验证了其有效性。

Authors: Yifeng Lin, Liuxiang Qiu, Yunfeng Chen, Tiesong Zhao

DUALingo: A Dual-Hand Instruction-Guided Dataset for Affordance Grounding on 3D Objects Manipulation

bimanual affordance grounding 3D objects dataset foundation models robotic manipulation

简要说明：DUALingo 是一个大规模、自动生成的日常物体上双手机器人任务条件与角色感知的3D可交互性定位数据集，使现有模型能够学习协作性双手交互，并显著提升定位性能。

TLDR: DUALingo is a large-scale, automatically generated dataset for task-conditioned, role-aware bimanual 3D affordance grounding on everyday objects, enabling existing models to learn cooperative dual-hand interactions and improving grounding performance significantly over zero-shot baselines.

Abstract: Affordance grounding localizes where an agent should interact with an object to perform a task. Many everyday manipulation tasks, however, require bimanual affordance, in which two hands assume complementary and cooperative roles to accomplish a shared goal. Existing 3D affordance datasets primarily ground single interaction regions, and manually annotating dual-hand, cooperative contacts does not scale. To address this gap, we introduce DUALingo, a large-scale dataset for task-conditioned, role-aware bimanual 3D affordance grounding on diverse everyday objects. DUALingo represents each task as two cooperative, hand-agnostic roles, each grounded as a heatmap on the object surface. It contains 271K free-form tasks on 71K objects, generated by a fully automated pipeline of open-weight foundation models without human labeling. Expert ratings and a validated LLM judge confirm the quality of the resulting annotations. Trained on DUALingo, existing 3D affordance models learn to ground both cooperative roles from natural-language instructions, with the best-performing model achieving a more than threefold improvement in aIoU over the zero-shot baseline, from 10.3 to 37.8. Robotic manipulation demonstrations illustrate the actionability of the predicted bimanual affordances in performing cooperative tasks. These results position DUALingo as a scalable foundation for learning everyday bimanual affordances. Project page: https://nycu-pair-labs.github.io/DUALingo/

摘要（中文）：可供性定位（Affordance grounding）是指确定智能体应如何与物体交互以完成某项任务的位置。然而，许多日常操作任务需要双手可供性（bimanual affordance），即两只手承担互补且协作的角色，以完成共同目标。现有的三维可供性数据集主要标注单一交互区域，而人工标注双手协作接触点难以规模化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DUALingo，一个面向多样化日常物体的大规模数据集，用于任务条件化、角色感知的双手三维可供性定位。DUALingo将每项任务表示为两个协作的、与手部无关的角色，每个角色在物体表面以热力图形式进行标注。该数据集包含71,000个物体上的271,000个自由形式任务，通过全自动流水线由开源基础模型生成，无需人工标注。专家评分及经过验证的LLM评判确认了所生成标注的质量。基于DUALingo训练后，现有三维可供性模型能够从自然语言指令中学习定位两个协作角色，其中最佳模型在aIoU指标上相比零样本基线提升了三倍以上，从10.3提升至37.8。机器人操作演示验证了预测的双手可供性在执行协作任务中的可操作性。上述结果使DUALingo成为学习日常双手可供性的可扩展基础。项目页面：https://nycu-pair-labs.github.io/DUALingo/

Authors: Ming-Lun Lee, Yi-En Li, Feng-Dian Su, Ming-Han Lee, Kun-Ru Wu, Krzysztof Czarnecki, Yu-Chee Tseng

Beyond Expert Replay: Cross-Instruction Anchoring for Continual Vision-Language-Action Learning VLA

continual learning catastrophic forgetting instruction-conditioned response preservation experience replay vision-language-action models

简要说明：本文提出跨指令锚定（XIA）方法，通过在持续VLA学习中冻结先前策略作为教师并匹配旧指令响应，有效缓解灾难性遗忘，在LIBERO、RoboCasa及真实世界实验中提升成功率并减少遗忘。

TLDR: This paper introduces Cross-Instruction Anchoring (XIA), a method to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in continual VLA learning by preserving instruction-conditioned responses from a frozen teacher policy, improving success rates and reducing forgetting across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models need to continually acquire new manipulation skills while retaining the ability to follow previously learned instructions. Experience replay (ER) can mitigate catastrophic forgetting, but retaining only a small number of historical expert frames per task leaves many old-instruction responses without direct supervision. Under limited replay, we observe a structured failure mode in which an earlier instruction can trigger a subsequently learned, competing goal. To address this gap, we propose Cross-Instruction Anchoring (XIA), which supplements expert replay with instruction-conditioned response preservation. At each task boundary, XIA freezes the previous policy as a teacher and matches its responses to old instructions paired with current observations. This extends supervision beyond stored historical examples without requiring additional expert replay data. Experiments across multiple VLA architectures and three LIBERO suites demonstrate improved success rates and reduced forgetting compared with ER under identical historical expert-data budgets. Additional RoboCasa and real-world experiments further support the effectiveness of XIA.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要在持续获取新操作技能的同时，保持执行先前所学指令的能力。经验回放（ER）能够缓解灾难性遗忘，但每个任务仅保留少量历史专家帧，会导致许多旧指令的响应缺乏直接监督。在有限的回放条件下，我们观察到一种结构化的失败模式：较早的指令可能触发后续学到的、相互竞争的目标。为解决这一问题，我们提出跨指令锚定（XIA）方法，该方法在专家回放的基础上补充了指令条件下的响应保持机制。在每个任务边界处，XIA将先前策略冻结为教师模型，并将其对旧指令与当前观测配对时的响应进行匹配。这将监督范围扩展到了存储的历史样本之外，而无需额外的专家回放数据。在多种VLA架构和三个LIBERO基准套件上的实验表明，在相同的历史专家数据预算下，与ER相比，XIA提高了成功率并减少了遗忘。此外，RoboCasa和真实世界实验进一步验证了XIA的有效性。

Authors: Ziyang Chen, Dehua Chen, Shaoguang Wang, Xu Yan, Hao Huang, Tao Chen

PreWAM: Exploring the Design of Latent Future Prediction for World-Action Modeling VLA

world-action model future prediction DINO features residual prediction robotic manipulation

简要说明：PreWAM 提出了一种世界动作模型，利用预训练的 DINO 特征和残差时间尺度预测来联合学习动作生成和未来预测，在仿真和真实机器人操作基准上展现出强大的操作性能和鲁棒性。

TLDR: PreWAM introduces a world-action model that uses pretrained DINO features and residual temporal-scale prediction to jointly learn action generation and future prediction, demonstrating strong manipulation performance and robustness across simulated and real robot benchmarks.

Abstract: World-action models combine action generation with future prediction, allowing visual transitions to serve as supervision for policy learning. Our controlled study of prediction spaces shows that spatially structured semantic features support better overall generalization under visual perturbations and make motion information more readily recoverable from learned predictive representations. Building on these observations, we introduce PreWAM, a world-action model that organizes future supervision around state changes in a prediction space defined by pretrained DINO features. Specifically, Residual World Prediction jointly learns source-relative changes and their resulting future states to emphasize dynamic information while preserving future-state semantics. Temporal-Scale Prediction conditions world queries on temporal distance to capture both short-term local motion and longer-horizon state evolution. These predictive objectives jointly shape a shared vision-language backbone with action supervision during pretraining and downstream policy learning. Experiments across the LIBERO benchmark family, SimplerEnv, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world robotic manipulation demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved generalization and robustness under diverse distribution shifts.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型将动作生成与未来预测相结合，使得视觉状态转换能够为策略学习提供监督信号。我们对预测空间的受控研究表明，空间结构化的语义特征在视觉扰动下能够支持更好的整体泛化能力，并且使运动信息更容易从学习到的预测表征中恢复。基于这些观察，我们提出了PreWAM，一种世界-动作模型，它以预训练的DINO特征所定义的预测空间中的状态变化为核心来组织未来监督。具体而言，残差世界预测联合学习源相对变化及其产生的未来状态，以强调动态信息同时保留未来状态的语义。时间尺度预测根据时间距离对世界查询进行条件化，以同时捕捉短期局部运动与更长时程的状态演化。这些预测目标在预训练和下游策略学习阶段共同塑造一个共享的视觉-语言骨干网络，并与动作监督相结合。在LIBERO基准系列、SimplerEnv、RoboTwin 2.0以及真实机器人操作上的实验表明，该方法具有强大的操作性能，并在多种分布偏移下展现出改进的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

Authors: Wan Chi, Sen Li, Zihang Cui, Chuqin Huang, Yunlong Wang, Nanshan Deng, Yanjun Huang

Ada-BFM: Adapting Behavior Foundation Models for Humanoid Scene Interaction HumanoidEmbodied

Behavior Foundation Models Humanoid Scene Interaction Lightweight Adapter Post-training Whole-body Control

简要说明：Ada-BFM提出了一种后训练框架，通过轻量适配器调整预训练行为基础模型，使人体机器人具备场景交互能力，同时保留其全身控制能力。

TLDR: Ada-BFM introduces a post-training framework with a lightweight adapter to adapt pretrained behavior foundation models for humanoid scene interaction, enabling diverse terrain and object interaction tasks while preserving pretrained whole-body control capabilities.

Abstract: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose humanoid control through pretraining on large-scale behavioral data. However, their proficiency in whole-body coordination does not readily extend to scene interaction, which requires adapting motion to scene-dependent geometric constraints and contact dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce Ada-BFM, a post-training framework that adapts pretrained BFMs for humanoid scene interaction. Ada-BFM augments the original architecture with a lightweight adapter, enabling interaction-specific adjustments while leveraging pretrained control capabilities. Rather than producing a separate controller for each task, the framework yields a shared model for each interaction domain, supporting diverse tasks involving terrain or object interaction. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that Ada-BFM enables diverse scene interaction behaviors, accelerates learning compared with training from scratch, and largely preserves pretrained behavioral competence. These findings establish Ada-BFM as an effective and efficient approach to extending the capabilities of BFMs beyond their pretraining settings while retaining their strengths in general whole-body control.

摘要（中文）：行为基础模型（BFMs）已成为一种有前景的范式，通过对大规模行为数据进行预训练，实现通用人形机器人控制。然而，它们在全身协调方面的能力并不能直接迁移到场景交互任务中，这类任务要求动作适应与场景相关的几何约束和接触动力学。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了Ada-BFM，一种针对预训练BFMs进行后训练的框架，使其适应人形机器人的场景交互。Ada-BFM在原有架构基础上引入轻量级适配器，在利用预训练控制能力的同时，实现交互特化的调整。该框架并非为每个任务生成独立的控制器，而是为每个交互领域生成一个共享模型，支持涉及地形或物体交互的多样化任务。在仿真和真实世界中的大量实验表明，Ada-BFM能够实现多样化的场景交互行为，相比从头训练加速了学习过程，并在很大程度上保留了预训练的行为能力。这些发现确立了Ada-BFM作为一种高效且有效的方法，可将BFMs的能力扩展到预训练设置之外，同时保留其在全身控制方面的优势。

Authors: Furui Xu, Weishuai Zeng, Zirui Wang, Kangning Yin, Jiacheng Bao, Huayi Wang, Yingying Qin, Yufei Xue, Yang Tang, Zenghao Tang, Kailin Li, Jingbo Wang, Weinan Zhang

Co-DRIS: Physics-Informed Predictive Belief and Variable-Impedance Learning for Reactive Catching under Coupled Uncertainty Manipulation

physics-informed world model variable-impedance control reactive catching belief encoder perception-action co-design

简要说明：Co-DRIS 将物理信息世界模型与可变阻抗控制及双流信念编码器相结合，使反应式机器人抓取在感知和驱动耦合不确定性下具有鲁棒性，在真实 Franka 机械臂上提升了成功率。

TLDR: Co-DRIS couples a physics-informed world model with variable-impedance control and a dual-stream belief encoder to make reactive robotic catching robust under coupled perception and actuation uncertainties, improving success rates on real Franka arms.

Abstract: Reactive robotic manipulation is acutely sensitive to simultaneous sensing noise, measurement dropouts, joint execution errors, and contact parameter variations. While single-frame frameworks like Domain-Randomized Instance Set (DRIS) achieve strong robustness under isolated uncertainties (86.4%), they degrade severely when perception and actuation uncertainties co-occur (27.6% across 10 coupled stress scenarios) due to memoryless encoding and fixed high-stiffness PD control. We propose Co-DRIS + SuperMimic, a perception-action co-design framework coupling: (i) an inertial world-frame physics-informed world model combining exact ballistic kinematics with a zero-initialized contact residual to roll forward missing observations and accelerate training via zero-cost counterfactual dropout consistency; (ii) an action-conditioned dual-stream causal GRU belief encoder resolving the denoising-vs-lag deadlock; and (iii) phase-aware variable-impedance soft-catching that transitions the 7-DoF Franka Research 3 arm into an overdamped regime (zeta/zeta0 ~ 2.26x) at the torque layer. Under unbiased 3-seed tail evaluation on unseen throws (15,360 throws/scenario), our method achieves 89.6 +/- 0.4% on standard benchmarks (+10.5% on 4-sigma noise to 70.5%) and 66.6 +/- 0.5% across 10 coupled/dropout stress scenarios (+39.0% over DRIS; +30.4% on 50% dropout). We further validate impedance decoupling, causal contact triggering under +0.65 s flight-time shifts, and cross-task transfer to steel-plate ping-pong bouncing (87.5% to 100.0%) and FR3+Hand catching (+8.4% under 4x noise with 6-13% lower peak impact force).

摘要（中文）：反应式机器人操作对同时发生的感知噪声、测量丢失、关节执行误差以及接触参数变化极为敏感。尽管诸如域随机化实例集（DRIS）之类的单帧框架在孤立的不确定性条件下展现出较强的鲁棒性（86.4%），但在感知与驱动不确定性同时出现时（10种耦合应力场景下为27.6%），其性能严重退化，原因在于无记忆编码和固定高刚度PD控制。我们提出了Co-DRIS + SuperMimic，一种感知-动作协同设计框架，其结合了：（i）惯性世界坐标系下基于物理信息的惯性世界模型，将精确的弹道运动学与零初始化接触残差相结合，以向前推算缺失观测，并通过零成本反事实丢弃一致性加速训练；（ii）动作条件下的双流因果GRU置信编码器，以解决去噪与滞后之间的死锁问题；（iii）相位感知的可变阻抗软捕获机制，在力矩层将7自由度Franka Research 3机械臂过渡到过阻尼状态（zeta/zeta0~2.26倍）。在无偏3种子尾部评估中，针对未见过的投掷（每种场景15,360次投掷），我们的方法在标准基准上实现了89.6 ± 0.4%的成功率（在4 sigma噪声下提升至70.5%，相对提升10.5%），在10种耦合/丢弃应力场景下实现了66.6 ± 0.5%的成功率（相对DRIS提升39.0%；在50%丢弃率下相对提升30.4%）。我们进一步验证了阻抗解耦、在+0.65秒飞行时间偏移下的因果接触触发，以及跨任务迁移至钢板乒乓球反弹（87.5%至100.0%）和FR3+手爪抓取（在4倍噪声下提升8.4%，峰值冲击力降低6-13%）。

Authors: Yonglong Zhang

Beyond the Benchmark: Localizing Released Autonomous Driving Models to Real Vehicles AutonomousDriving

deployment localization source-system coupling Human-Anchored Reinforcement Learning closed-loop planning sensor adaptation

简要说明：本文提出了Released-to-Real（R2R）部署本地化方法，通过修正源系统耦合的数据、行为和传感器配置，将已发布的自动驾驶模型适配到新实车上。R2R的Human-Anchored强化学习（HA-RL）和冻结感知的传感器适配提升了闭环规划成功率和真实传感器配置下的检测精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces Released-to-Real (R2R), a deployment-localization methodology to adapt released autonomous-driving models to new real vehicles by correcting source-system coupling in data, behavior, and sensor configurations. R2R's Human-Anchored Reinforcement Learning (HA-RL) and frozen-perception sensor adaptation improve closed-loop planning success and detection accuracy on real sensor rigs.

Abstract: Released autonomous-driving models achieve strong benchmark performance, yet deploying them on a new real vehicle remains challenging. We study this deployment gap and find that released models can remain coupled to assumptions from their source sensing, data, and execution processes even after conventional adaptation. We introduce Released-to-Real (R2R), a deployment-localization methodology that identifies such source-system coupling and corrects only the affected components while preserving the released model. For data and behavior adaptation, we find that the mismatch between trajectory-level optimization and receding-horizon execution enters through the ego state rather than the observation, and introduce Human-Anchored Reinforcement Learning (HA-RL), which corrects it on recorded target driving without the costly rollouts of generative closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). For physical sensor adaptation, R2R localizes and corrects source-dependent spatial and temporal representations with frozen perception weights, requiring neither target annotations nor retraining. HA-RL improves the closed-loop success rate of a released diffusion-based planner from 82.2% to 95.2%, while sensor adaptation across multiple released detectors and three real sensor rigs improves the vehicle mean average precision (mAP) of a released multi-camera detector from 0.041 to 0.420 on a five-camera target rig. These results provide a practical path for preparing released models before deployment on new real vehicles. Our project page is publicly available at https://released-to-real.github.io.

摘要（中文）：发布的自动驾驶模型在基准测试中表现优异，但将其部署到新型实车上仍面临挑战。我们研究了这一部署差距，发现已发布模型即使在传统适配之后，仍可能与其源感知、数据和执行过程中的假设存在耦合。我们提出了一种部署定位方法——Released-to-Real (R2R)，用于识别此类源系统耦合，并仅修正受影响的组件，同时保持已发布模型不变。在数据和行为适配方面，我们发现轨迹级优化与滚动时域执行之间的失配是通过自车状态而非观测引入的，并由此提出人类锚定强化学习 (HA-RL)，该方法可利用记录的目标驾驶数据修正该失配，而无需生成式闭环强化学习 (RL) 的高成本 rollout。在物理传感器适配方面，R2R 通过冻结感知权重，定位并修正源依赖的空间和时间表示，既不需要目标标注，也不需要重新训练。HA-RL 将已发布的基于扩散的规划器的闭环成功率从 82.2% 提升至 95.2%，而跨多个已发布检测器和三个真实传感器套件的传感器适配则将已发布的多相机检测器在五相机目标套件上的车辆平均精度 (mAP) 从 0.041 提升至 0.420。这些结果为在新型实车部署前准备已发布模型提供了一条实用路径。我们的项目页面公开发布于 https://released-to-real.github.io。

Authors: Morui Zhu, Deyuan Qu, Qi Chen, Qing Yang

Many Senses, One World: Learning Hierarchical Multimodal World Representations for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

hierarchical multimodal representation world-action transformer bimanual dexterous manipulation pretraining tactile/force-torque/audio

简要说明：HiMoDex 提出了一种两阶段框架，在119万个同步多模态时间步上预训练层级多模态世界状态表示，并用其条件化一个共享的世界-动作变换器，在五个真实世界双臂灵巧操作任务中实现了78.7%的平均成功率和相比基线32%的绝对提升。

TLDR: HiMoDex introduces a two-stage framework that pretrains hierarchical multimodal world-state representations on 1.19M synchronized time steps and uses them to condition a shared world-action transformer, achieving 78.7% average success and a 32% absolute improvement over baselines in five real-world bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Bimanual dexterous manipulation relies on multimodal inputs that capture visual context and non-visual physical interaction cues for precise and coordinated control. To address the challenge of effectively integrating these modalities for policy learning, we propose HiMoDex, a two-stage framework centered on hierarchical multimodal world-state representations. In Stage 1, we pretrain a hierarchical representation network on the collected dataset of 1.19 million synchronized multimodal time steps. The network integrates visual context with tactile, force-torque, and audio cues into unified world-state embeddings. In Stage 2, we freeze the pretrained network and use its embeddings to condition a shared world-action transformer. The transformer jointly learns action generation and action-conditioned future-state prediction. Experiments across five real-world tasks show that HiMoDex achieves an average success rate of 78.7\%, representing an absolute improvement of 32.0\% over the strongest evaluated baseline. Extensive ablations validate the benefits of hierarchical representation learning and two-stage training. Failure analysis helps explain performance differences across variants. Code, data, and demos will be released at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/research-website-BAB4/.

摘要（中文）：双臂灵巧操作依赖于多模态输入，这些输入捕捉视觉上下文以及非视觉的物理交互线索，以实现精确且协调的控制。为应对有效整合这些模态以进行策略学习的挑战，我们提出了HiMoDex——一个以层级多模态世界状态表示为核心的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，我们在收集的119万个同步多模态时间步数据集上预训练一个层级表示网络。该网络将视觉上下文与触觉、力-力矩和音频线索整合为统一的世界状态嵌入。在第二阶段，我们冻结预训练网络，并利用其嵌入来条件化一个共享的世界-动作变换器。该变换器联合学习动作生成和以动作为条件的未来状态预测。在五个真实世界任务上的实验表明，HiMoDex的平均成功率达到78.7%，相比于最强评估基线实现了32.0%的绝对提升。广泛的消融研究验证了层级表示学习和两阶段训练的益处。失败分析有助于解释不同变体间的性能差异。代码、数据和演示将在https://anonymous.4open.science/w/research-website-BAB4/发布。

Authors: Jin Yang, Youlin Wang, Ping Wei

Sparks of Weight-Space Programming for Robot Foundation Models VLA

weight-space programming robot foundation models policy editing vision-language-action parameter efficient

简要说明：本文提出权重空间编程（WSP），通过直接编辑极少量参数来修复机器人基础策略的失败，无需额外训练或数据，并在pi0.5 VLA策略的仿真中验证了效果。

TLDR: This paper introduces weight-space programming (WSP) to correct robot foundation policy failures by directly editing a small set of parameters, without additional training or data, demonstrating improved success in simulation on a pi0.5 VLA policy.

Abstract: This paper demonstrates an approach for correcting failures of robot foundation models (RFMs) without additional data collection, demonstrations, or training. We apply weight-space programming (WSP), in which a language-model agent directly reads and writes a neural network's parameters, to a large, pre-trained vision-language-action policy. The idea is simple: many policy failures are not random but repeatedly land in the same recognizable stuck state, so if that state is visible in the model's internal activations, a small edit could trigger a corrective movement while leaving the rest of the model's parameters unchanged. A core design choice is where to write the edit: repurposing a few near-silent neurons in the action expert lets the edit switch on in situations associated with the failure and produce a corrective movement, such as lowering the gripper toward the target, that is specified directly rather than learned through training. Empirically, when applied to the pi0.5 policy in simulation, we find that edits to roughly 0.0002% of the parameters can improve success on recurring failures, including for a policy that was already fine-tuned on its task. Reversed and random edits indicate that the gains come from the intended behavior, and the approach works best when the failure situation is recognizable and a simple correction can address it.

摘要（中文）：本文展示了一种无需额外数据采集、示范或训练即可纠正机器人基础模型（RFMs）故障的方法。我们将权重空间编程（WSP）应用于一个大规模预训练的视觉-语言-动作策略，在该方法中，语言模型代理直接读取和写入神经网络的参数。其思路很简单：许多策略故障并非随机发生，而是反复陷入相同的可识别停滞状态，因此，如果该状态在模型的内部激活中可见，那么一次小幅编辑即可触发纠正动作，同时保持模型其余参数不变。一个核心设计选择是编辑的写入位置：重新利用动作专家中少数近乎静默的神经元，使编辑在故障相关情境下被激活，并产生直接指定的纠正动作（如将夹爪向目标降低），而非通过训练学习而来。实验结果表明，在仿真环境中应用于pi0.5策略时，对约0.0002%的参数进行编辑即可改善反复出现的故障，包括对于已在任务上微调过的策略也是如此。反向和随机编辑表明，性能提升源于预期行为，且该方法在故障情境可识别且简单纠正即可解决的情况下效果最佳。

One Phase Is Enough: Sim-to-Real Transfer with Direct Visual Reinforcement Learning Manipulation

visual reinforcement learning sim-to-real transfer frozen pretrained vision encoders manipulation policies one-phase RL

简要说明：DRIFT提出了一种简单的一阶段视觉强化学习方案，利用冻结的预训练视觉编码器直接从图像训练策略，在模拟到现实的迁移中优于两阶段蒸馏方法。

TLDR: DRIFT proposes a simple one-phase visual RL recipe using frozen pretrained vision encoders to directly train policies from images, outperforming two-phase distillation in sim-to-real transfer across manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has enabled impressive robotic behaviors, yet deploying policies directly from vision remains challenging. A common approach first trains a teacher policy with RL using privileged state observations, then distills its behavior into a vision-based student via imitation. However, the resulting student can substantially underperform its teacher. Directly training visual policies with RL offers a promising alternative, but learning task-relevant visual representations from scratch can be sample-inefficient, making one-phase visual RL intractable. We propose DRIFT, a simple recipe for efficient one-phase visual RL using image observations available at test time. Our key insight is to use frozen, pretrained foundation vision encoders, allowing RL to focus on learning control from existing visual representations. Freezing the encoder avoids costly backpropagation through the vision backbone, while its pretrained representations enable real-world transfer from fast, rasterized simulation rendering. Under matched architectures, observations, and compute budgets, DRIFT outperforms two-phase distillation and achieves a 58.8% relative improvement in average real-world success rate across three manipulation tasks. Controlled simulation evaluations demonstrate that DRIFT's relative advantage grows from roughly 9% in-distribution to over 61% under out-of-distribution shifts, suggesting that stronger generalization contributes to superior real-world transfer. Project website: https://jmarangola.github.io/one-phase-visual-rl/

摘要（中文）：摘要： 仿真到现实（Sim-to-real）的强化学习已展现出令人瞩目的机器人行为，但直接从视觉信息部署策略仍具挑战。常见做法是先用基于特权状态观测的强化学习训练教师策略，再通过模仿将其行为蒸馏到基于视觉的学生策略中。然而，学生策略的性能往往明显逊于教师策略。直接使用强化学习训练视觉策略是一种有前景的替代方案，但从头学习任务相关的视觉表征可能样本效率低下，使得单阶段视觉强化学习难以实现。我们提出DRIFT，一种利用测试时可获取的图像观测实现高效单阶段视觉强化学习的简洁方案。我们的关键洞察是使用冻结的预训练基础视觉编码器，使强化学习能够专注于从已有视觉表征中学习控制。冻结编码器避免了视觉主干网络中的昂贵反向传播，而其预训练表征则支持从快速栅格化仿真渲染中进行真实世界迁移。在匹配的架构、观测和计算预算下，DRIFT优于两阶段蒸馏方法，并在三个操作任务中实现了平均真实世界成功率58.8%的相对提升。受控仿真评估表明，DRIFT的相对优势从分布内场景的约9%增长到分布外偏移下的超过61%，表明更强的泛化能力促成了更优的真实世界迁移效果。项目网站：https://jmarangola.github.io/one-phase-visual-rl/

Authors: John Marangola, Antonia Bronars, Younghyo Park, Stephen Andrews, Kushal Kedia, Pulkit Agrawal

FabricBench: A Standardized Policy Benchmark for Bimanual Fabric Manipulation with a Contact-Driven Deformable Simulator Manipulation

bimanual fabric manipulation contact-driven deformable simulator vision-language-action models world action models configuration generalization

简要说明：FabricBench 提出了一个用于双臂布料操作的标准基准，基于新的接触驱动可变形模拟器，评估了包括 VLA 和世界动作模型在内的六种策略，揭示了配置泛化方面的重大挑战。

TLDR: FabricBench introduces a standardized benchmark for bimanual fabric manipulation with a new contact-driven deformable simulator, evaluating six policies including VLA and world action models, revealing significant challenges in configuration generalization.

Abstract: Fabric manipulation challenges robot policies with changing geometry, self-occlusion, and contact, yet standardized evaluation remains focused on rigid objects. We introduce FabricBench, a benchmark for bimanual fabric manipulation with six tasks spanning garments, silk, and bags, 10,000 simulation-ready assets, and controlled tests of configuration and appearance generalization. Built on an open-source solver in Newton, our simulator enables stable bimanual grasping, holding, and release through contact forces, without artificial attachment. Redesigned cloth-rigid contact and bidirectional force coupling support interactions among robot arms, fabric, and free rigid objects, allowing a bag to support its contents and transmit their weight to the grippers. In a controlled grasp-hold-release evaluation, our solver succeeds in all 45 trials, compared with none for the tested baseline configurations. Evaluating six representative policies, including vision-language-action models and world action models, reveals substantial remaining challenges: the best policy achieves 77% average success, while no policy exceeds 36% on long-horizon T-shirt folding. Under the most deformed initial T-shirt configurations, success falls to 6-14% across policies, with larger drops than under the evaluated appearance shifts. Zero-shot deployment of $π_{0.5}$ on a real robot largely preserves task difficulty ordering across six tasks (Spearman $ρ=0.94$). These results establish FabricBench as a reproducible testbed for measuring fabric-manipulation capabilities and exposing limitations in configuration generalization. The project website is available at https://fabricbench.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：布料操作对机器人策略提出了几何变化、自遮挡和接触等方面的挑战，然而标准化评估仍集中在刚体物体上。我们引入了FabricBench，一个双机械臂布料操作基准，包含涵盖服装、丝绸和袋子的六项任务、10,000个可供仿真使用的资产，以及对形态和外观泛化的受控测试。该基准基于Newton中的开源求解器构建，我们的仿真器通过接触力实现稳定的双臂抓取、握持和释放，无需人为附加约束。重新设计的布料-刚体接触和双向力耦合支持机械臂、布料和自由刚体物体之间的交互，使袋子能够承载其内容物并将其重量传递到夹爪上。在受控的抓取-握持-释放评估中，我们的求解器在全部45次试验中均成功，而所测试的基线配置则全部失败。评估六种代表性策略（包括视觉-语言-动作模型和世界动作模型）揭示了仍然存在的重大挑战：最佳策略平均成功率仅为77%，而在长时程T恤折叠任务上，没有任何策略超过36%。在最极端变形的初始T恤形态下，各策略的成功率降至6-14%，其下降幅度大于所评估的外观变化带来的影响。π₀.₅在真实机器人上的零样本部署在六项任务间基本保持了任务难度排序（Spearman ρ = 0.94）。这些结果使FabricBench成为衡量布料操作能力并揭示形态泛化局限性的可复现测试平台。项目网站地址为 https://fabricbench.github.io/。

Authors: Wenkang Hu, Haoran Wang, Liu Liu, Wenchao Huang, Yiji Chen, Mengao Zhao, Xincheng Tang, Zhengjie Shu, Lai Jiang, Wei Li, Zhendong Wang, Zhizhong Su, Huamin Wang, Ruigang Yang

Near-Zero Forgetting Is Not Enough: Out-of-Distribution Robustness in Continual Learning of Pretrained VLAs VLA

Continual Learning Out-of-Distribution Robustness Pi0 LIBERO Experience Replay

简要说明：本文研究了预训练VLA模型在持续学习中的分布外（OOD）鲁棒性，发现即使域内遗忘接近零，先前任务的OOD性能也会因多模态和动作特征的表示漂移而急剧下降。

TLDR: This paper investigates out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness in continual learning of pretrained VLA models, finding that even with near-zero in-domain forgetting, OOD performance on previous tasks degrades sharply due to representational drift in multimodal and action features.

Abstract: Recent work shows that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit near-zero forgetting in specific continual learning settings with experience replay. However, robustness to domain shift of learned tasks remains unexplored. In this work, we study the robustness of Pi0 fine-tuned with experience replay under out-of-distribution (OOD) data using the LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks. While the in-domain (ID) setup achieves near-zero catastrophic forgetting, OOD performance on previous tasks quickly collapses. Specifically, we show that during the continual learning process, the OOD capabilities of the model degrade, following a shared representational pattern across domain shifts, which is also visible behaviorally in the two simpler suites. Representational analysis shows that drift concentrates in the multimodal and action features. Linear probes indicate that OOD features still retain task-relevant information, but appear unreadable, consistent with representation misalignment. These findings suggest that even when ID stability remains intact, severe OOD forgetting can still occur, accompanied by representational drift during continual learning.

摘要（中文）：近期研究显示，在特定持续学习场景下，经过经验回放微调的预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型展现出近乎零遗忘的特性。然而，所学任务在域偏移情况下的鲁棒性尚未得到探索。本研究利用LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus基准，探究了在分布外（OOD）数据下，结合经验回放微调的Pi0模型的鲁棒性。尽管域内（ID）设置实现了近乎零的灾难性遗忘，但以往任务的OOD性能却迅速崩溃。具体而言，我们发现在持续学习过程中，模型的OOD能力出现退化，且在不同域偏移间呈现出共享的表征模式，这在两个较简单的套件中也在行为层面表现明显。表征分析显示，漂移集中于多模态特征和动作特征。线性探针表明，OOD特征仍保留任务相关信息，但呈现不可读取状态，这与表征错位现象一致。这些发现表明，即使域内稳定性保持不变，严重的OOD遗忘仍可能发生，并在持续学习过程中伴随表征漂移。

Authors: Adrià Ruiz, Bartłomiej Twardowski, Tinne Tuytelaars, Sergi Masip

Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action VLA

structured pruning vision-language-action model autonomous driving trajectory prediction reasoning

简要说明：本文提出MoOP，一种针对自动驾驶VLA模型的结构化剪枝方法，结合推理和动作目标的重要性排名来剪枝VLM，并选择固定的专家MLP通道子集，在保持推理和轨迹预测性能的同时，实现了显著的参数减少、推理加速和内存节省。

TLDR: This paper proposes MoOP, a structured pruning method for autonomous driving VLA models that combines importance ranks from reasoning and action objectives to prune the VLM and selects a fixed subset of expert MLP channels, achieving significant parameter reduction, inference speedup, and memory savings while preserving reasoning and trajectory prediction performance.

Abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）：推理型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自动驾驶中利用思维链（CoT）推理来引导动作生成，但带来了显著的内存和计算开销。本文针对这类模型研究结构化剪枝，重点关注同时保持场景理解与轨迹预测能力。我们对Alpamayo-1.5-10B中泰勒重要性的分析表明，推理目标与轨迹目标对同一视觉-语言模型（VLM）结构赋予了不同的重要性。在动作专家模块中，MLP通道在去噪步骤间的重要性排序比查询头更为稳定，且少量通道贡献了所测得的大部分重要性。基于这些发现，我们提出MoOP方法，该方法结合两个目标的重要性排名进行VLM剪枝，并聚合逐步重要性以选择固定的专家MLP通道子集。在总参数量减少24.0%的情况下，使用MoOP仅对VLM进行剪枝，其驾驶性能与最强基线相当或略优，同时保留了稠密模型LingoQA评分的94.0%，显著高于所有其他方法。在更高的30.0%削减率下，MoOP的性能下降幅度远小于其他所有方法，因为它是唯一一个推理未发生崩塌的方法。移除93.75%的专家MLP通道可将总参数量削减提升至39.4%，与仅进行VLM剪枝相比，开环误差几乎不变，闭环性能具有竞争力。最终模型相比稠密模型实现了1.37倍的端到端推理加速和36.6%的峰值内存降低，且无需剪枝后微调。

Authors: Seongchan Kim, Soowon Son, Sangoh Kim, Hyunah Ko, Eunbeen Hong, Hyunkoo Lee, Sanghyun Lee, WonJun Moon, Kihong Kim, Dongyeon Son, Woongchan Nam, Seungryong Kim

ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control Manipulation

Asynchronous Coding Agents Robot Control Multi-agent Coordination Real-world Rollout Mobile Manipulation

简要说明：ACAP 将机器人组织为一组异步编码代理，每个代理控制特定组件，并由超代理协调，在 72 次真实世界测试中将任务完成时间缩短 28.2%。

TLDR: ACAP organizes a robot as a team of asynchronous coding agents, each controlling a specific component, with a hyper-agent for coordination, reducing task completion time by 28.2% across 72 real-world rollouts.

Abstract: Coding agents can construct and revise robot behavior during execution, but using one agent for the whole robot can delay otherwise independent work. We introduce Asynchronous Coding Agents as Policy (ACAP), an asynchronous framework that organizes one robot as a team of persistent agents. Each member reasons and acts for a configurable control group, such as an arm with its gripper or the torso and chassis, enabling asynchronous reasoning and execution. However, different robot components often have physical dependencies that require coordination. To address this challenge, ACAP introduces a hyper-agent that assigns tasks, coordinates dependencies, and dynamically allocates control between the lead and member agents. This allows independent work to progress concurrently while supporting tightly coupled manipulation when necessary. Across 72 real-world rollouts covering 25 task/platform settings, ACAP reduces task-balanced time cost by 28.2% compared with a single-agent Direct Policy, with improvements across Fully Parallel, Parallel-Sequential, and Collaborative tasks. Across all eight Collaborative settings, ACAP also achieves lower mean time cost than Fixed Delegation, where only member agents can control their assigned groups. An additional 90-rollout study shows lower mean 30-minute-capped time cost than Direct on all six tasks. We further demonstrate mobile manipulation using the same member interface for chassis and torso control. We present the framework and a real-world rollout dataset containing observations, generated programs, actions, and feedback to support research on how coding agents reason and act in the physical world.

摘要（中文）：编码智能体能够在执行过程中构建和修正机器人行为，但若整个机器人仅由一个智能体控制，可能会延误本可独立推进的工作。我们提出了一种异步框架——作为策略的异步编码智能体（ACAP），该框架将一台机器人组织为一个由多个持久智能体组成的团队。每个成员针对可配置的控制组（例如带有夹爪的机械臂，或躯干与底盘）进行推理与行动，从而实现异步推理与执行。然而，机器人不同部件之间往往存在物理依赖关系，需要进行协调。为应对这一挑战，ACAP引入了超智能体（hyper-agent），负责任务分配、依赖关系协调，并在主智能体与成员智能体之间动态分配控制权。这使得独立工作能够并行推进，同时在必要时支持紧密耦合的操作任务。在覆盖25种任务/平台设置、总计72次真实世界部署的实验中，与单智能体直接策略（Direct Policy）相比，ACAP将任务均衡时间成本降低了28.2%，并在完全并行、并行-顺序及协作类型任务中均取得改进。在所有八种协作设置中，ACAP的平均时间成本也低于固定委派（Fixed Delegation）策略——后者仅允许成员智能体控制其分配到的部件。此外，一项包含90次部署的补充实验显示，在全部六项任务中，ACAP在30分钟上限内的平均时间成本均低于直接策略。我们还进一步展示了利用同一成员接口控制底盘与躯干的移动操作能力。本文呈现了该框架，并提供了一个包含观测数据、生成程序、动作及反馈的真实世界部署数据集，以支持关于编码智能体如何在物理世界中推理与行动的研究。

Authors: Zexin He, Rui Li, Yushi Lan, Chengkai Jin, Zhi Hou, Xingang Pan

Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness VLA

frontier-model-as-policy closed-loop harness prompting planning action execution

简要说明：Embo-Harness 系统研究了将前沿多模态模型直接用作闭环机器人策略的设计原则，提炼出实用配方，在 RoboLab-120 和真实世界任务中取得高成功率，并分析了驱动性能的关键能力（空间估计 vs 低层轨迹生成）。

TLDR: Embo-Harness systematically studies design choices for using frontier multimodal models directly as closed-loop robot policies, distilling a practical recipe that achieves high success on RoboLab-120 and real-world tasks, and analyzes the capabilities (spatial estimation vs. low-level generation) driving performance.

Abstract: Frontier multimodal models exhibit extraordinary generalization in generating robot actions from observations and instructions, enabling a new paradigm in which they serve directly as policies within closed-loop robotic harnesses. However, the design principles of such harnesses, and the capabilities underlying their strong performance, remain unclear. We present Embo-Harness, a framework for systematically studying frontier-model-as-policy harnesses. We investigate four components of the robotic agentic loop, namely, prompting, planning, action execution, and tool use, and distill six empirical findings into a practical recipe. This recipe prioritizes interfaces that exploit the model's native visual reasoning and tool-use capabilities over handcrafted plans, skills, or action priors, and identifies effective choices for action representation, chunking, reasoning effort, visual observations, short multi-action sequences, and policy refinement. On RoboLab-120, Embo-Harness achieves an 83.3\% success rate, outperforming the strongest reported baseline by 26.2 percentage points. It also succeeds in 15 of 20 zero-shot trials across four real-world manipulation tasks. Beyond performance, controlled interventions indicate that the studied model depends more strongly on accurate spatial target estimation than on explicit low-level joint or trajectory generation. These results provide both a practical recipe for building strong frontier-model-as-policy harnesses and a clearer account of the capabilities that drive their performance.

摘要（中文）：前沿多模态模型在根据观测和指令生成机器人动作方面展现出非凡的泛化能力，这使得一种新范式成为可能——模型可直接作为闭环机器人控制系统中的策略模块。然而，此类控制系统的设计原则及其卓越性能背后的能力基础仍不明确。我们提出Embo-Harness，一个用于系统研究前沿模型即策略控制系统的框架。我们考察了机器人智能体循环的四个组成部分，即提示、规划、动作执行和工具使用，并将六项实证发现提炼为实用的设计指南。该指南优先采用利用模型原生视觉推理和工具使用能力的接口，而非手工设计的规划、技能或动作先验，并确定了动作表示、分块、推理强度、视觉观测、短多动作序列及策略优化方面的有效选择。在RoboLab-120上，Embo-Harness取得了83.3%的成功率，比已报告的最强基线高出26.2个百分点。在四个真实世界操作任务的20次零样本试验中，它也成功完成了15次。除性能表现外，受控干预实验表明，所研究的模型对精确空间目标估计的依赖程度高于对显式低级关节或轨迹生成的依赖。这些结果既为构建强大的前沿模型即策略控制系统提供了实用指南，也对这些系统性能背后的能力给出了更清晰的阐释。

Authors: Xiao-Ming Wu, Kang Liao, Yuexiao Ma, Taolin Zhang, Mingqian Zhou, Nuo Chen, Ziming Li, Yihang Luo, Rui Li, Zhonghua Wu, Tianyu Xie, Xiawu Zheng, Zhongang Cai, Zhi Hou, Chen Change Loy

VITA-WAM: Manifold-Aligned World-Action Modeling for Real-Time Robot Control Manipulation

world action model flow matching manifold alignment real-time robot control LIBERO

简要说明：VITA-WAM 提出了一种流形对齐的流匹配世界动作模型，将机器人动作生成加速到单步 ODE，在推理速度和性能上均优于先前方法。

TLDR: VITA-WAM introduces a manifold-aligned flow-matching world-action model that accelerates robot action generation to a single ODE step, achieving faster inference and better performance than prior WAMs.

Abstract: World action model (WAM) is a promising paradigm for visuomotor control by jointly modeling world dynamics and actions. Notably, existing WAMs often rely on large generative models and iterative sampling which incur substantial latency for action generation, limiting real-time deployment. In particular, there are two root causes of inefficiency in conventional flow matching or diffusion based action models in WAMs: 1) transporting uninformative Gaussian noise into precise actions necessitating multiple ODE steps, and 2) repeatedly injecting task context through expensive cross-attention modules. Our key insight is that jointly learning and aligning the source and action manifolds streamlines the transport between them, substantially accelerating action generation. Building on this insight, we introduce VITA-WAM, a WAM architecture with manifold-aligned flow-matching (VITA flow matching) that directly transports latent observation representations containing visual, language, and proprioceptive information into latent actions. More specifically, a flow latent alignment (FLA) mechanism is employed to facilitate manifold alignment between latent observation and action representations, enabling accurate generation with few ODE steps. The resulting architecture also eliminates costly attention for observation conditioning during repeated denoising steps. Notably, with a single ODE step, VITA-WAM outperforms 10-step FastWAM by 21.47 pp on LIBERO-Plus and by 1.65 pp on LIBERO, achieving these gains through the FLA objective without distillation, while inferring at 55.67~ms latency, a $2.10\times$ speedup compared to FastWAM.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAM）是一种通过联合建模世界动态与动作来实现视觉运动控制的前沿范式。值得注意的是，现有WAM通常依赖大型生成模型和迭代采样，导致动作生成延迟显著，限制了实时部署。具体而言，传统基于流匹配或扩散的WAM动作模型存在两个低效根源：1）将无信息的高斯噪声传输为精确动作需要多次常微分方程（ODE）步骤；2）通过昂贵的交叉注意力模块重复注入任务上下文。我们的关键洞见在于，联合学习并对齐源流形与动作流形能够简化两者之间的传输过程，从而大幅加速动作生成。基于这一洞见，我们提出了VITA-WAM，一种采用流形对齐流匹配（VITA流匹配）的WAM架构，可直接将包含视觉、语言和本体感觉信息的潜在观测表示传输为潜在动作。具体而言，我们采用流潜对齐（FLA）机制促进潜在观测表示与动作表示之间的流形对齐，从而以少量ODE步骤实现精确生成。该架构还消除了重复去噪步骤中对观测条件注入所需的高成本注意力计算。值得注意的是，在单步ODE条件下，VITA-WAM在LIBERO-Plus上比10步FastWAM高出21.47个百分点，在LIBERO上高出1.65个百分点，这些性能提升完全通过FLA目标实现，无需蒸馏，同时推理延迟仅为55.67毫秒，相比FastWAM实现了2.10倍的加速。
