Authors: Boqi Zhao, Dechen Gao, Hanchu Zhou, Hang Wang, Junshan Zhang

Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

evidence sufficiency grounding abstention VLM benchmark autonomous driving

简要说明：DriveAnswer 是一个包含 20,151 个问题的自动驾驶 VLM 基准，通过匹配的强/弱证据对，联合评估语义正确性、证据充分性和接地性；结果表明这些是独立能力，且适配可大幅提升联合性能。

TLDR: DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions for autonomous driving VLMs, jointly evaluates semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding using matched strong- and weak-evidence pairs; results show these are distinct capabilities and that adaptation can greatly improve joint performance.

Abstract: Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior and complete grounding. With controlled adaptation, Gemma-4-12B reaches 63.29% on this joint capability, nearly tripling its zero-shot performance. Qwen3-VL-8B exhibits the same broad improvement in evidence-sensitive answering and grounding. These results show that semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are distinct capabilities that should be evaluated jointly.

摘要（中文）：可靠的驾驶视觉语言模型（VLM）不仅要能正确回答问题或定位相关场景参与者，还必须能够判断现有视觉证据是否足以支撑其回答。现有评估大多将定位能力与可回答性作为两个独立维度分别衡量，因而难以区分那些证据充分、支撑到位的预测，与那些虽定位到相关对象但证据不足的预测之间的差异。为此，我们提出了DriveAnswer基准，包含七个推理族共20,151个问题，通过匹配的“强证据”与“弱证据”配置来明确刻画这一区别。每一组配置对在保持底层场景事实和语义答案不变的前提下，仅改变观测信息是否足以支撑回答，从而在弱证据情况下，弃答（abstention）成为合理应对。在六族评估中，最强的零样本基线在强证据上的准确率达到67.31%，但在匹配问题中，仅21.55%同时满足正确弃答行为与完整定位要求。经过受控适配后，Gemma-4-12B在该联合能力上达到63.29%，相比其零样本表现提升了近三倍。Qwen3-VL-8B也在证据敏感的回答与定位方面展现出同样广泛的改进。这些结果表明，语义正确性、证据充分性与定位能力是三种相互独立的能力，应进行联合评估。

Authors: Nhat Ha Nguyen, Sudipta Chowdhury, Lokesh Das

Sparse Poison, Strong Hijack: Efficient Trajectory-Level Backdoors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Only 1\% Poisoning VLA

backdoor attack vision-language-action models trajectory-level hijacking low poisoning rate dual-LoRA adaptation

简要说明：该论文提出了一种两阶段协同优化框架，仅用1%的毒化数据即可在VLA模型中注入轨迹级后门，在多个VLA骨干和真实机器人试验中实现了高目标任务成功率并保持干净任务性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a two-stage co-optimization framework for injecting trajectory-level backdoors into VLA models using only 1% poisoned data, achieving high target-task success while maintaining clean-task performance across multiple VLA backbones and real-robot trials.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models advance robotic manipulation, but their reliance on demonstrations exposes them to backdoor threats. Among these threats, trajectory-level targeted backdoors are particularly challenging and may pose greater safety risks than behavior-disrupting attacks: rather than merely causing task failures or local action deviations, they must sustain closed-loop redirection to complete an attacker-specified multi-step task. To reliably induce such behaviors, existing methods typically rely on high poisoning rates to obtain sufficient target-trajectory supervision. However, high poisoning rates may compromise clean-task performance, whereas low rates leave target-trajectory supervision scarce and backdoor learning vulnerable to interference from dominant clean-task updates. To resolve this trade-off at low poisoning rates, we propose a two-stage co-optimization framework guided by vision, language, and action. Stage I freezes the policy and uses differentiable rendering and multimodal supervision to optimize a 3D trigger's texture, translation, and scale, strengthening trigger-target associations from limited poisoned demonstrations. Building on the optimized trigger, Stage II applies source-selective dual-LoRA adaptation to decouple clean and backdoor updates and mitigate their interference, followed by learned column-wise calibration and analytic fusion into a unified policy. Experiments on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$ across four LIBERO suites show consistent gains over all evaluated attack baselines. With only 1% poisoned data, our method achieves 86.4% target success and 95.2% clean-task success on OpenVLA-OFT in LIBERO-Spatial. Real-robot trials also demonstrate trajectory-level hijacking.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推动了机器人操作技术的进步，但其对演示数据的依赖使其面临后门攻击的威胁。在这些威胁中，轨迹级定向后门尤为棘手，且可能比行为破坏型攻击带来更大的安全风险：它不仅会造成任务失败或局部动作偏差，还必须维持闭环重定向以完成攻击者指定的多步任务。为可靠地诱发此类行为，现有方法通常依赖较高的投毒率以获得充足的目标轨迹监督信号。然而，高投毒率可能损害干净任务性能，而低投毒率则导致目标轨迹监督信号稀缺，使后门学习易受占主导地位的干净任务更新的干扰。为解决低投毒率下的这一权衡问题，我们提出了一种由视觉、语言和动作引导的两阶段协同优化框架。第一阶段冻结策略网络，利用可微渲染和多模态监督优化三维触发器的纹理、平移和缩放，从有限的投毒演示中强化触发器与目标之间的关联。在优化触发器的基础上，第二阶段采用源选择性双LoRA适配来解耦干净更新与后门更新并减轻二者间的干扰，随后通过学习得到的逐列校准与解析融合将其整合为统一策略。在四个LIBERO套件上对OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、$π_0$和$π_{0.5}$的实验表明，所提方法在所有被评估的攻击基线中均取得了一致的性能提升。在仅使用1%投毒数据的情况下，我们的方法在LIBERO-Spatial的OpenVLA-OFT上实现了86.4%的目标成功率和95.2%的干净任务成功率。真实机器人实验也验证了轨迹级劫持的有效性。

Authors: Simin Huang, Jiawei Chen, Shaolong Zhu, Qiwei Liang, Zhaoxia Yin

PoseVLN: Learning Geometric State Evolution for Vision-Language Navigation VLN

Vision-Language Navigation geometric state evolution pose prediction R2R-CE RxR-CE

简要说明：PoseVLN 提出了一种位姿感知框架，联合预测导航动作和几何位姿演化，以提升连续环境中的视觉-语言导航。

TLDR: PoseVLN introduces a pose-aware framework that jointly predicts navigation actions and geometric pose evolution to improve Vision-Language Navigation in continuous environments.

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to relate past experience, current spatial state, and future motion while following natural-language instructions. Recent approaches improve these capabilities through long-horizon memory, state-aware reasoning, and future prediction, yet these components are often modeled separately, leaving navigation state evolution insufficiently connected across time. We argue that camera pose provides a natural geometric representation for bridging past, present, and future states. Based on this insight, we propose PoseVLN, a pose-aware VLN framework that jointly learns navigation decisions and geometric state evolution. PoseVLN organizes visual memory and the current observation in an episode-relative coordinate frame, and jointly predicts the next K navigation actions together with a local $Δ$Pose over the same horizon. The predicted $Δ$Pose is composed with the current trajectory-level pose to obtain the future pose state, which is recursively propagated throughout navigation, forming a continuous geometric state evolution from past memory to future motion. Experiments on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen splits demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly modeling geometric state evolution, with PoseVLN outperforming the strongest compared baselines by 2.6 and 2.9 percentage points in success rate, respectively, using only single RGB observations.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体在遵循自然语言指令的同时，将过往经验、当前空间状态与未来运动相关联。近期方法通过长时记忆、状态感知推理和未来预测提升了这些能力，然而这些组件往往被单独建模，导致导航状态演化在时间维度上缺乏充分的连贯性。我们认为，相机位姿为连接过去、现在与未来状态提供了一种天然的几何表征。基于这一洞见，我们提出PoseVLN——一种位姿感知的VLN框架，可联合学习导航决策与几何状态演化。PoseVLN将视觉记忆与当前观测组织在情节相对坐标系中，并在同一时间跨度内联合预测接下来的K个导航动作及局部$\Delta$位姿。预测得到的$\Delta$位姿与当前轨迹级位姿复合，从而获得未来位姿状态，该状态在导航过程中递归传播，形成从过去记忆到未来运动的连续几何状态演化。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE验证未见拆分的实验表明，显式建模几何状态演化具有有效性，PoseVLN仅使用单一RGB观测，在成功率上分别比最强基线高出2.6和2.9个百分点。

Authors: Pengyu Hou, Mingfei Han, Haihong Hao, Xiaolong Wu, Bo Dong, Xiaojun Chang, Salman Khan, Bin Shi

XMind: Thinking Twice via Cross-Memory Reasoning for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

memory-augmented LLM counterfactual reasoning working memory episodic memory closed-loop driving

简要说明：XMind是一种无需训练、通过跨记忆推理（结合工作记忆与情景记忆及反事实验证）增强基于LLM的自动驾驶决策的框架，在闭环高速模拟和真实高风险交互中显著提升了成功率并降低了决策风险。

TLDR: XMind is a training-free framework enhancing LLM-based autonomous driving by integrating working and episodic memory, enabling counterfactual cross-memory reasoning to improve decision-making in closed-loop highway simulations and real-world high-risk scenarios.

Abstract: Memory-augmented large language model (LLM) driving agents can reuse past experience, yet previously learned corrections often fail to transfer when traffic conditions change. A key limitation is that existing memories mainly record observed outcomes, providing little evidence about alternative actions. We introduce XMind, a training-free framework that enables LLM-based driving to "Think Twice" through cross-memory reasoning. XMind integrates working memory of recent traffic states with episodic memory of critical risk events. The agent first makes an initial decision from the current context and then cross-checks it against retrieved historical experience. If a conflict arises, it makes a second decision guided by the retrieved evidence. To construct reliable episodic memory, XMind evaluates alternative actions through counterfactual rollouts under perturbed traffic conditions and stores the verified outcomes as structured risk capsules. These capsules are retrieved by jointly matching spatial risk patterns and scenario semantics. Across closed-loop highway simulations, XMind achieves success rates of 83.3-93.3%, exceeding the strong baseline by 6.6 percentage points on average. Evaluation on K-Risk further demonstrates lower decision risk on unseen real-world high-risk interactions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary benefits of working memory, risk-text retrieval, and counterfactual verification. Code is available at https://github.com/xiangxiangliuwo/XMind

摘要（中文）：记忆增强的大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体能够复用过往经验，然而，当交通状况发生变化时，先前习得的修正往往难以迁移。一个关键限制在于，现有记忆主要记录已观测到的结果，对备选行为提供的证据很少。我们提出XMind，一个无需训练的框架，使基于LLM的驾驶能够通过跨记忆推理实现“三思而行”。XMind将近期交通状态的工作记忆与关键风险事件的情景记忆相整合。智能体首先根据当前语境做出初步决策，然后将其与检索到的历史经验进行交叉核对。若出现冲突，则基于检索到的证据做出第二次决策。为构建可靠的情景记忆，XMind通过在扰动交通条件下的反事实推演评估备选行为，并将验证后的结果存储为结构化风险胶囊。这些胶囊通过联合匹配空间风险模式与场景语义进行检索。在闭环高速公路仿真中，XMind取得了83.3%-93.3%的成功率，平均超过强基线6.6个百分点。在K-Risk上的评估进一步表明，在未见过的真实世界高风险交互中，其决策风险更低。消融研究证实了工作记忆、风险文本检索与反事实验证之间的互补优势。代码可在 https://github.com/xiangxiangliuwo/XMind 获取。

Authors: Zuyi Guo, Xianjie Dai, Lei Yang, Xiaocong Zhao, Jingguang Li, Kitae Jang, Heye Huang

Do Occupancy World Models Really Follow Actions? AutonomousDriving

occupancy world model counterfactual action ego-trajectory action faithfulness Occ3D-nuScenes

简要说明：ReCast 是一种以自我轨迹引导的 transformer 占用世界模型，通过解耦历史编码与未来解码，并利用自我变换对齐可变形交互，提高了反事实轨迹下的动作忠实度，在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上验证。

TLDR: ReCast is an ego-trajectory-guided transformer for occupancy world models that improves action faithfulness under counterfactual trajectories by decoupling historical encoding from future decoding and aligning deformable interactions with ego transformations, validated on Occ3D-nuScenes.

Abstract: Occupancy world models predict future 3D scenes conditioned on ego actions, yet their predictions may not faithfully follow the specified trajectory under counterfactual actions. Because driving datasets provide sparse coverage of alternative trajectories for each scene, existing models learn the spatial effect of ego motion implicitly from observed scene--trajectory combinations, which may entangle action effects with scene--trajectory correlations. We propose ReCast, an ego-trajectory-guided transformer that grounds future prediction in action-induced geometric correspondence across ego-centric frames. ReCast decouples historical encoding from future decoding and aligns deformable interactions using relative ego transformations, while retaining flexibility for non-rigid scene evolution. We also introduce a counterfactual action-faithfulness benchmark covering in-distribution, tail, and out-of-distribution trajectories. On Occ3D-nuScenes, ReCast achieves competitive standard forecasting performance while improving counterfactual forecasting, with particularly clear gains under out-of-distribution trajectories.

摘要（中文）：占用世界模型根据自我动作预测未来的三维场景，然而在反事实动作条件下，其预测可能无法忠实遵循指定轨迹。由于驾驶数据集对每个场景的替代轨迹覆盖稀疏，现有模型隐含地从观测到的场景-轨迹组合中学习自我运动的空间效应，这可能导致动作效应与场景-轨迹相关性相互纠缠。我们提出ReCast，一种自我轨迹引导的 Transformer 架构，基于跨自我中心帧的动作诱导几何对应关系来锚定未来预测。ReCast将历史编码与未来解码解耦，并利用相对自我变换对齐可变形交互，同时保留非刚性场景演化的灵活性。我们还引入了一个涵盖分布内、尾部及分布外轨迹的反事实动作忠实性基准。在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上，ReCast在保持具有竞争力的标准预测性能的同时，提升了反事实预测能力，尤其在分布外轨迹下取得了显著改进。

Authors: Jongseong Bae, Ha Young Kim

FATCAT: Fault Injection Attacks Targeting Chip-level Alignment VLA

fault injection model alignment vision-language-action robotic safety electromagnetic attack

简要说明：FATCAT 提出了一种非侵入式电磁故障注入攻击，可禁用边缘GPU上多模态大语言模型的对齐机制，并在真实机器人操作臂上验证了该攻击可导致危险物理动作。

TLDR: FATCAT introduces non-invasive electromagnetic fault injection attacks that disable model alignment in multimodal LLMs on edge GPUs, and demonstrates the attack on a real robotic manipulator, causing hazardous physical movements.

Abstract: Model alignment is the primary safety and security mechanism for enforcing refusal of malicious prompts in modern foundation models; yet, existing adversarial evaluations implicitly assume underlying hardware integrity. In this paper, we present FATCAT, the first physical fault-injection attacks capable of eliminating refusal in modern large language and vision-language models. Specifically, we present a non-invasive electromagnetic (EM) fault injection attack targeting GPU-accelerated Systems-on-Chip with physical access, requiring neither software execution privileges nor model-layer access. By leveraging an autonomous Radio Frequency (RF) side-channel trigger to synchronize EM faults to the prompt prefill phase, the attack corrupts safety-critical memory transactions across off-chip LPDDR5 DRAM and on-chip LPDDR physical interfaces without crashing the system while preserving model coherence. Evaluated on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano and AGX Thor running Llama 3.2 1B and Gemma 3 1B, localized physical faults reliably force models to fulfill restricted requests, demonstrating that model-level alignment provides no robust security guarantees without hardware-level fault tolerance. Finally, we demonstrate the physical-world consequences of this vulnerability on an active 6-DoF robotic manipulator controlled by a SmolVLA vision-language-action policy. Our attack silently corrupts the model forcing the arm into abrupt, hazardous lunges; in two instances the robotic arm attempted to pinch the paper author -- proving that hardware faults can directly translate into real physical harm.

摘要（中文）：模型对齐是现代基础模型中强制执行对恶意提示拒绝的主要安全与安保机制；然而，现有的对抗性评估隐含地假定底层硬件具有完整性。在本文中，我们提出了FATCAT，这是首个能够消除现代大型语言模型和视觉语言模型中拒绝行为的物理故障注入攻击。具体而言，我们提出了一种针对具有物理访问权限的GPU加速片上系统的非侵入式电磁（EM）故障注入攻击，该攻击既不需要软件执行权限，也不需要模型层访问权限。通过利用自主射频（RF）侧信道触发器将电磁故障同步到提示预填充阶段，该攻击会破坏跨片外LPDDR5 DRAM和片上LPDDR物理接口的安全关键内存事务，而不会导致系统崩溃，同时保持模型连贯性。在运行Llama 3.2 1B和Gemma 3 1B的NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano和AGX Thor上进行的评估表明，局部物理故障能够可靠地迫使模型执行受限请求，从而证明在没有硬件级容错的情况下，模型级对齐无法提供稳健的安全保障。最后，我们在由SmolVLA视觉-语言-动作策略控制的主动6自由度机器人机械臂上展示了这一漏洞的物理世界后果。我们的攻击悄无声息地破坏模型，迫使机械臂发生突然的、危险的前冲动作；在两次实例中，机械臂试图捏住论文作者——这证明硬件故障可以直接转化为真实的身体伤害。

Authors: Peter Horvath, Ilia Shumailov, Zhuoran Liu, Lukasz Chmielewski, Lejla Batina

CriticalScenes: Scalable Photorealistic Critical-Scenario Generation for Closed-Loop Driving Adaptation AutonomousDriving

critical-scenario generation closed-loop driving end-to-end planner collision avoidance photorealistic simulation

简要说明：CriticalScenes 是一个基于重建的框架，将普通驾驶场景转换为逼真的关键交互并提供碰撞避免监督，从而提升端到端规划器的闭环驾驶安全性。

TLDR: CriticalScenes is a reconstruction-based framework that transforms ordinary driving scenes into photorealistic critical interactions with collision-avoidance supervision, improving closed-loop driving safety in end-to-end planners.

Abstract: Safety-critical interactions are rare in recorded driving data, leaving end-to-end driving planners with limited exposure to evasive behaviour during training. This lack of critical supervision can lead to unsafe behaviour and, in rare instances, collisions. To address this gap, we introduce CriticalScenes, a reconstruction-based framework that transforms ordinary recorded driving scenes into photorealistic safety-critical interactions with corresponding collision-avoidance supervision. Across 53 reconstructed source scenes, 979 of 1,060 attempted interactions yield feasible threat trajectories (92.4\%), while the inserted threat actors remain detectable in more than 95\% of non-occluded observations within 5--35\,m. Experiments with two structurally different end-to-end planners show that the generated supervision improves critical-scenario planning, while closed-loop transfer varies across planner architectures. SparseDrive achieves a 46.5\% relative reduction in collision rate on an independent photorealistic closed-loop benchmark, whereas UniAD shows only a modest closed-loop improvement despite substantial open-loop gains. The results further highlight the importance of closed-loop evaluation, as improvements in open-loop trajectory prediction do not necessarily translate into equivalent safety gains.

摘要（中文）：安全关键交互在录制的驾驶数据中较为罕见，导致端到端驾驶规划器在训练过程中对规避行为的接触十分有限。这种关键监督的缺失可能导致不安全行为，并在少数情况下引发碰撞。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CriticalScenes——一种基于重建的框架，可将普通录制的驾驶场景转化为逼真的安全关键交互，并提供相应的碰撞规避监督。在53个重建源场景中，1,060次尝试交互中有979次生成了可行的威胁轨迹（占92.4%），同时插入的威胁主体在5至35米范围内超过95%的无遮挡观测中仍可被检测到。针对两种结构不同的端到端规划器进行的实验表明，所生成的监督能够改善关键场景规划性能，而闭环迁移效果则因规划器架构不同而有所差异。SparseDrive在独立的逼真闭环基准上将碰撞率相对降低了46.5%，而UniAD尽管在开环指标上有显著提升，但闭环改进较为有限。实验结果进一步强调了闭环评估的重要性，因为开环轨迹预测的改进并不一定转化为同等的安全收益。

Authors: Alexandros Theocharous, Holger Caesar, Ziqi Zhang

MemAnchorWorld: A Sparse World Model with Horizon-Conditioned Memory Retrieval for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

sparse world model 4D semantic occupancy forecasting memory-anchor retrieval von Restorff effect autonomous driving

简要说明：MemAnchorWorld提出了一种带有预测时间条件分层双路径记忆锚检索机制的稀疏世界模型，在Occ3D-nuScenes上实现了最先进的4D语义占用预测。

TLDR: MemAnchorWorld introduces a sparse world model with a forecast-time-conditioned hierarchical dual-path memory-anchor retrieval mechanism, achieving state-of-the-art 4D semantic occupancy forecasting for autonomous driving on Occ3D-nuScenes.

Abstract: Sparse world models for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting represent scenes with a small set of evolving queries to efficiently predict future geometry and semantics for autonomous driving. However, existing sparse world models face a bottleneck in using historical temporal evidence for long-horizon forecasting. They rely on scene states to carry historical information implicitly, allowing errors to propagate and accumulate across successive forecasting steps and causing geometric and semantic deviations. To address this limitation, we present MemAnchorWorld, a sparse occupancy world model that explicitly retrieves relevant historical geometric and semantic evidence for 4D semantic occupancy forecasting. Inspired by the von Restorff effect, we introduce a forecast-time-conditioned hierarchical dual-path memory-anchor retrieval mechanism. Guided by the effective age and semantic compatibility of historical information, it combines query-level candidate selection with point-level memory-anchor retrieval to provide historical evidence for sparse points at different forecast times. To better use memory anchors and existing features, a point-level residual adapter jointly gated by the task and forecast time separately controls residual corrections to semantics, occupancy confidence, and spatial positions. On Occ3D-nuScenes, MemAnchorWorld achieves an average mIoU of 13.55% and an average IoU of 22.84% across the 1-3 s forecasting horizons, attaining state-of-the-art performance on both metrics.Project page: https://memanchorworld.github.io/

摘要（中文）：稀疏世界模型通过少量动态查询表示场景，以高效预测自动驾驶中的未来几何与语义，用于4D语义占用预测。然而，现有稀疏世界模型在利用历史时间证据进行长时预测方面存在瓶颈。它们依赖场景状态隐式携带历史信息，导致误差在连续预测步骤中传播与累积，进而引发几何与语义偏差。为解决该局限，我们提出MemAnchorWorld，一种稀疏占用世界模型，显式检索相关历史几何与语义证据以进行4D语义占用预测。受冯·雷斯托夫效应启发，我们引入了一种预测时间条件的分层双路径记忆锚点检索机制。在历史信息的有效年龄和语义兼容性引导下，该机制结合查询级候选选择与点级记忆锚点检索，为不同预测时间点的稀疏点提供历史证据。为更好地利用记忆锚点与现有特征，一个由任务和预测时间联合门控的点级残差适配器分别控制语义、占用置信度及空间位置的残差修正。在Occ3D-nuScenes上，MemAnchorWorld在1-3秒预测范围内实现了平均mIoU 13.55%和平均IoU 22.84%，在两项指标上均达到最先进性能。项目页面：https://memanchorworld.github.io/

Authors: Xinyang Jia, Yuqi Zhang, Jiakai Wang, Yahu Yang, Guandong Pan, Chao Tong, Xianglong Liu

Knocked Off Course: Tracing Uncommanded Motion from Perception to Action in Embodied VLAs VLA

vision-language-action models uncommanded egomotion target loss robustness fine-tuning

简要说明：本文研究具身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）跟踪模型如何在环境扰动导致的非指令自我运动下表现，发现表示和动作层面的缺陷会放大目标丢失后的错误，并证明通过极少量数据的针对性微调即可显著提升鲁棒性和恢复能力，无需改动架构。

TLDR: This paper studies how embodied Vision-Language-Action (VLA) tracking models respond to uncommanded egomotion caused by environmental disturbances, identifies representation and action gaps that amplify errors after target loss, and shows that targeted fine-tuning with minimal data can substantially improve robustness and recovery without architectural changes.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) enable simultaneous processing of egocentric video and textual target descriptions to produce action commands for embodied tracking platforms. However, these platforms rarely move exactly as commanded, in part due to unexpected environmental disturbances such as wind, unleveled terrain, and road bumps. Here we study how such models handle uncommanded egomotion. First, we explore performance across diverse disturbances by benchmarking three tracking VLAs on three datasets. We find that models differ in which environmental disturbances hurt them most, but all are sensitive to sudden target loss. Tracing egomotion from pixels to emitted actions, we identify two gaps. In representation, motion is reliably recovered through explicit relations between frames, but aggressive compression of past frames weakens small-motion readouts. In action, large rotations do reach the decision state, yet the decoded direction carries only a few percent of a mirrored rotation's effect on the turn. Targeting both gaps, we fine-tune one model, Uni-NaVid, on data amounting to just 1.7% of its original training set in a ladder of analysis-motivated variants. These gain 5-22 points after target-loss without degrading clean success; after a smooth loss, the best one improves success by 72% (relative), recovering 76% of its gap to clean. We also show that targeted fine-tuning improves recovery partly via a text-mediated action dependency, without new architecture, large-scale data collection or training from scratch.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）能够同时处理自我中心视频和文本目标描述，从而为具身跟踪平台生成动作指令。然而，这些平台在实际运行中很少完全按照指令移动，部分原因在于意外的环境扰动，如风力、不平整的地形以及路面颠簸。本文研究此类模型如何处理非指令性自我运动。首先，我们通过在三个数据集上对三个跟踪VLA模型进行基准测试，探讨模型在不同扰动下的表现差异。研究发现，不同模型受环境扰动影响最大的类型各不相同，但所有模型都对目标的突然丢失高度敏感。通过追踪从像素到输出动作的自我运动过程，我们识别出两个关键缺口。在表征层面，运动可以通过帧间的显式关系可靠恢复，但过去帧的激进压缩会削弱微小运动的读取能力。在动作层面，大幅旋转确实能够到达决策状态，但解码出的方向仅能承载镜像旋转对转向影响效果的百分之几。针对这两个缺口，我们在一个由分析驱动的变体阶梯中对Uni-NaVid模型进行微调，所用数据仅为其原始训练集的1.7%。在目标丢失后，这些变体模型的性能提升了5至22个百分点，且不损害正常运行成功率；在平滑丢失场景下，最佳变体成功率相对提升72%，恢复至其与正常运行之间差距的76%。我们还证明，定向微调部分通过文本介导的动作依赖关系改善恢复能力，而无需新架构、大规模数据采集或从头训练。

Authors: Dan Zlotnikov, Nadav Alali, Ohad Ben-Shahar

GeoVLDrive: Geometry-Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

geometry-grounded VLA 3D spatiotemporal reasoning latent chain of thought scene-grounded action scoring NAVSIM 3DQA

简要说明：GeoVLDrive 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的几何接地视觉-语言-动作框架，通过三维场景特征和结构化潜在思维链增强视觉-语言骨干网络，在NAVSIM和LingoQA基准测试中取得了优异性能。

TLDR: GeoVLDrive introduces a geometry-grounded vision-language-action framework for autonomous driving that augments a vision-language backbone with 3D scene features and a structured latent chain of thought, achieving strong performance on NAVSIM and LingoQA benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) planners inherit semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models, but their reasoning is rarely grounded in 3D scene structure and its evolution over time. We introduce GeoVLDrive, a geometry-grounded VLA framework for 3D spatiotemporal reasoning and planning. Multi-layer features from a 3D foundation model augment the vision-language backbone through gated cross-attention. A structured latent chain of thought (CoT) organizes future scene geometry, key-agent motion, and meta-actions into ordered, separately supervised latent states. An action expert generates trajectory proposals from these states and multi-layer scene features, and ranks them using scene-grounded, interacting score tokens. We also introduce NAVSIM 3DQA to train and evaluate metric 3D spatial and motion understanding. GeoVLDrive achieves 91.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. On NAVSIM 3DQA, the geometry-grounded backbone scores 89.2% overall, 4.6 percentage points above the fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-2B baseline. On LingoQA, the backbone achieves 68.6% Lingo-Judge accuracy.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）规划器继承了预训练视觉-语言模型的语义知识，但其推理过程很少基于三维场景结构及其随时间的变化。我们提出GeoVLDrive，一种面向三维时空推理与规划的几何锚定VLA框架。来自三维基础模型的多层特征通过门控交叉注意力增强视觉-语言骨干网络。结构化的潜在思维链（CoT）将未来场景几何、关键智能体运动及元动作组织为有序且分别监督的潜在状态。动作专家从这些状态及多层场景特征中生成轨迹候选，并使用基于场景锚定的交互评分令牌对其进行排序。我们还引入了NAVSIM 3DQA，用于训练和评估度量级三维空间与运动理解。GeoVLDrive在NAVSIM v1上达到91.8 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到90.9 EPDMS。在NAVSIM 3DQA上，几何锚定骨干网络整体得分为89.2%，比微调后的Qwen3-VL-2B基线高出4.6个百分点。在LingoQA上，该骨干网络达到68.6%的Lingo-Judge准确率。

Authors: JiaHui Huang, Songyan Zhang, Hanbing Li, Hanchao Leng, Kuiyuan Yang, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Chen Lv

ObsBridge: Observation-Grounded Conditioning for Ego Trajectory Prediction AutonomousDriving

trajectory prediction pedestrian forecasting ego-view observation-grounded flow-based

简要说明：ObsBridge 提出了一种基于流的轨迹预测框架，该框架同时利用恢复的历史状态和原始观测证据进行未来预测，并通过渐进式训练和残差几何适配器来提高对自主机器人导航中噪声观测的鲁棒性。

TLDR: ObsBridge introduces a flow-based trajectory forecasting framework that conditions future pedestrian prediction on both recovered historical states and raw observation evidence, using progressive training and a residual geometry adapter to improve robustness against noisy ego-view observations for autonomous robot navigation.

Abstract: Pedestrian forecasting from ego-view observations is challenging because occlusion, limited visibility, and tracking errors corrupt observed motion histories. Such errors are particularly consequential for autonomous robot navigation. Existing paradigms typically either impute noisy history positions before forecasting or jointly train an auxiliary history reconstruction branch. However, predictors trained on clean histories may be sensitive to residual errors in recovered histories at deployment. Meanwhile, auxiliary reconstruction still computes inter-agent interactions over raw, corrupted coordinates. We investigate conditioning future prediction on both recovered historical states and raw observation evidence, with progressive training to accommodate imperfect recovery. Building on this insight, we propose ObsBridge, a flow-based trajectory forecasting framework with observation-grounded historical bridging. Specifically, ObsBridge first employs a frozen estimator to recover historical motion from agent-relative and ego-relative positions, image-plane locations, and visibility states. During training, we introduce an agent-wise curriculum that gradually replaces clean teacher histories with complete estimated histories before context encoding. This progressively exposes the predictor to estimated histories during training. Furthermore, we design a residual geometry adapter to fuse the encoded motion with original observation evidence. We aggregate the resulting representations through social attention to condition the flow-based trajectory generator. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ObsBridge outperforms state-of-the-art methods. On EgoTraj-TBD, it reduces minADE@20 by 6.5\% and minFDE@20 by 8.7\%. The code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/ObsBridge.

摘要（中文）：从自我视角观察进行行人预测具有挑战性，因为遮挡、有限视野和跟踪误差会破坏观察到的运动历史。此类误差对于自主机器人导航尤为关键。现有范式通常是在预测前对含噪声的历史位置进行插补，或者联合训练一个辅助的历史重建分支。然而，在干净历史上训练的预测器在部署时可能对恢复历史中的残余误差敏感。与此同时，辅助重建仍在原始、含噪声的坐标上计算智能体间的交互。我们研究了将未来预测同时基于恢复的历史状态和原始观测证据，并采用渐进式训练以适应不完美的恢复。基于这一见解，我们提出ObsBridge——一种基于流的轨迹预测框架，具有观测锚定的历史桥接能力。具体而言，ObsBridge首先使用冻结估计器从智能体相对位置、自我相对位置、图像平面坐标和可见性状态中恢复历史运动。在训练过程中，我们引入一种智能体级课程，在上下文编码之前逐步用完整估计历史替换干净教师历史。这使预测器在训练期间逐渐暴露于估计历史中。此外，我们设计了一个残差几何适配器，将编码的运动与原始观测证据融合。我们通过社交注意力聚合所得表示，以条件化基于流的轨迹生成器。跨多个基准的大量实验表明，ObsBridge优于最先进方法。在EgoTraj-TBD上，它使minADE@20降低了6.5%，minFDE@20降低了8.7%。代码将提供于https://github.com/shawnliang420/ObsBridge。

Authors: Zhenhao Wang, Shaofeng Liang, Jiemin Wu, Sijia Chen, Keni Shi, Nan Li, Wenshuo Chen, Bowen Tian, Runwei Guan, Yutao Yue

A Mesh to Remember: Persistent Appearance for Interactive Video Worlds WorldModel

video world model mesh-guided rendering appearance persistence zero-shot transfer real-time rendering

简要说明：M2R 是一种视频世界模型，利用交互式 3D 世界中的网格作为持久空间地址，在物体表面上存储和检索渲染器生成的特征，从而在长时间交互式视频合成中实现时间和跨视图一致的外观。

TLDR: M2R is a video world model that uses meshes from interactive 3D worlds as persistent spatial addresses, storing and retrieving renderer-generated features on object surfaces to achieve temporally and cross-view consistent appearance for long-horizon interactive video synthesis.

Abstract: Video world models synthesize photorealistic observations in response to user actions but struggle to remain consistent over long interactions. Coding agents and text-to-3D models instead generate explicit 3D worlds whose geometry and state persist by construction, but whose appearance falls far short of photorealism. Recent methods combine the strengths of both by rendering such worlds into coarse proxies that guide a video model. However, since these proxies only specify where things are, the renderer must invent what they look like as the world is explored, and anything it forgets is reinvented when a surface reappears. Our key insight is that a mesh identifies which surface each pixel shows, across frames and views, even as objects move, allowing it to serve as an address for what the renderer generates. We propose M2R (Mesh to Remember), a few-step causal video renderer that stores its own features on the surfaces they depict, in each object's frame, and retrieves them by rasterizing the mesh whenever those surfaces come back into view. Appearance thus travels with objects wherever they move, persists across revisits, and is shared by every agent that observes it, while memory grows with the surfaces seen instead of the number of frames. Trained only on synthetic data, M2R transfers zero-shot to real indoor scans and to worlds authored by coding agents. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods in consistency across static, dynamic, and multi-agent benchmarks, more than doubling object permanence and nearly doubling cross-agent consistency, while rendering 720p video in real time (40 FPS).

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型能够根据用户动作合成逼真的观测结果，但在长时间交互中难以保持一致。编码智能体和文本到3D模型则生成显式3D世界，其几何和状态通过构造方式持续存在，但外观远不及照片级逼真度。近期方法通过将此类世界渲染为粗略代理（coarse proxies）来引导视频模型，从而结合两者优势。然而，由于这些代理仅指定物体所处位置，渲染器在探索世界时需自行创造物体外观，且任何被遗忘的内容都会在表面重新出现时被重新生成。我们的关键洞察在于：网格（mesh）能够跨帧、跨视角识别每个像素所对应的表面，即使物体移动时亦然，从而可作为渲染器生成内容的地址。我们提出M2R（Mesh to Remember），一种少步因果视频渲染器，将自身特征存储于其所描绘的表面之上（以各物体自身坐标系存储），并当这些表面重新进入视野时，通过光栅化网格将其检索出来。由此，外观随物体移动而迁移，跨多次回访持续存在，并被所有观测它的智能体共享，同时记忆随所见的表面增长，而非随帧数增长。M2R仅使用合成数据训练，即可零样本迁移至真实室内扫描场景及编码智能体生成的数字世界。在静态、动态及多智能体基准测试中，它在一致性方面超越现有最优方法，物体持久性提升一倍以上，跨智能体一致性提升近一倍，同时能够实时（40 FPS）渲染720p视频。

Authors: Joonghyuk Shin, Alex Trevithick, Katarína Tóthová, Liyuan Zhu, Shengyu Huang, Jaesik Park, Shalini De Mello, Laura Leal-Taixé, Riccardo de Lutio, Haithem Turki

NativeDrive: Native Multimodal Foundations for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Native multimodal models Autonomous driving Policy learning Driving Semantic Editing NAVSIM

简要说明：NativeDrive 提出了一种原生无编码器多模态驾驶框架，统一了理解与生成，并通过密集监督任务（驾驶语义编辑）提升规划性能，在 NAVSIM v1 和 v2 上取得了有竞争力的结果。

TLDR: NativeDrive introduces a native encoder-free multimodal driving framework that unifies understanding and generation, with a dense supervision task (Driving Semantic Editing) for planning and competitive results on NAVSIM v1 and v2.

Abstract: Autonomous driving requires semantic understanding and fine-grained scene perception for precise action prediction. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic priors, but low-dimensional action labels provide limited structural supervision. Some studies extend VLAs with visual generation tasks or adopt video-based world-action models (WAMs), but both approaches introduce appearance-reconstruction overhead, which is less relevant to planning. Native multimodal models offer an alternative to unify understanding and generation within one backbone. On this basis, we propose NativeDrive, a native encoder-free multimodal driving framework adapting the unified backbone for policy learning and introduce a dense supervision task tailored to driving. The Native Action Interface reuses the understanding expert's token-prediction interface for the discrete policy and adapts the generation expert for continuous policy. Driving Semantic Editing reuses the generation expert's editing capability for dense scene-structure supervision during training, while inference runs only the selected planning policy. NativeDrive achieves competitive planning performance among unified understanding-and-generation models on NAVSIM v1 and v2, with ablations validating its components' effectiveness. Code will be released.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶需要语义理解与细粒度场景感知，以实现精确的动作预测。视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）继承了语义先验知识，但低维动作标签提供的结构化监督有限。一些研究通过视觉生成任务扩展VLA，或采用基于视频的世界-动作模型（WAMs），但这两种方法都引入了与规划相关性较弱的外观重建开销。原生多模态模型提供了一种在同一骨干网络内统一理解与生成的替代方案。在此基础上，我们提出了NativeDrive，一种原生无编码器多模态驾驶框架，将统一骨干网络适配于策略学习，并引入了一项专为驾驶设计的密集监督任务。Native Action Interface复用理解专家的令牌预测接口来处理离散策略，并适配生成专家来处理连续策略。Driving Semantic Editing在训练期间复用生成专家的编辑能力，以提供密集场景结构监督，而推理时仅运行所选的规划策略。在NAVSIM v1和v2上，NativeDrive在统一理解与生成模型中取得了具有竞争力的规划性能，消融实验验证了各组成部分的有效性。代码将予以发布。

Authors: Zehua Fan, Qi Jiang, Wei Li, Kai Tang, Yue Jiang, Yujian Li, Bailin Li, Feng Gao, Yan Wang, Kun Zhan

GeoMVGen: Joint Appearance-Geometry Modeling for Multi-View Video Generation in Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

multi-view video generation pointmap geometric consistency video diffusion transformer robotic manipulation

简要说明：GeoMVGen 是一个面向机器人操作的多视角RGB视频和点图视频联合生成框架，通过视频扩散变压器及跨模态/跨视角一致性机制，提升了视频质量、几何精度和视角一致性。

TLDR: GeoMVGen is a framework that jointly generates multi-view RGB videos and pointmap videos for robotic manipulation, using a video diffusion transformer with cross-modal and cross-view consistency mechanisms to improve visual quality, geometric accuracy, and viewpoint coherence.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation requires predicting how robot-object interactions evolve over time, encompassing both visual appearance and scene geometry. In multi-camera settings, such predictions need to capture the evolving 3D scene consistently across viewpoints, while supporting controllable generation under different robot actions and camera configurations. Existing video generation models provide strong priors for visual appearance and motion but typically lack explicit geometric modeling. Meanwhile, recent advances in geometry-aware and multi-view generation have explored joint appearance-geometry modeling and cross-view consistency, yet generating temporally coherent appearance and geometry across multiple viewpoints under robotic manipulation conditions remains challenging. In this work, we propose GeoMVGen, a framework for joint multi-view RGB and pointmap video generation in robotic manipulation. Built on a video diffusion transformer, our framework employs modality-specific adaptation modules to capture the distinct characteristics of appearance and geometry, while using cross-modal residual connections to facilitate information exchange between the two modalities. To establish geometric correspondences across viewpoints, we further introduce a cross-view projection mechanism with complementary geometric supervisions, combining pointmap consistency with geometry foundation model-guided feature alignment. These designs enable controllable generation of temporally evolving multi-view observations with coherent appearance and geometrically consistent scene structures. Extensive experiments on 4D video generation dataset comprising simulated and real-world robotic manipulation scenarios demonstrate that GeoMVGen outperforms state-of-the-art methods in video quality, geometric accuracy, and cross-view consistency.

摘要（中文）：机器人操纵需要对机器人与物体之间的交互随时间的演变进行预测，涵盖视觉外观和场景几何结构两个方面。在多摄像头设置中，此类预测需要从不同视角一致地捕捉动态演化的三维场景，同时支持在不同机器人动作和摄像头配置下进行可控生成。现有的视频生成模型为视觉外观和运动提供了强大的先验知识，但通常缺乏显式的几何建模。与此同时，几何感知和多视角生成领域的最新进展探索了外观与几何的联合建模以及跨视角一致性，但在机器人操纵条件下生成跨多个视角、时间上连贯的外观和几何结构仍然具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出了GeoMVGen，一个用于机器人操纵中多视角RGB和点图视频联合生成的框架。该框架基于视频扩散Transformer，采用模态特定的适配模块来捕捉外观和几何的不同特征，同时利用跨模态残差连接促进两种模态之间的信息交换。为了建立跨视角的几何对应关系，我们进一步引入了一种带互补几何监督的跨视角投影机制，将点图一致性与几何基础模型引导的特征对齐相结合。这些设计使得能够可控地生成时间上动态演化的多视角观测，同时具备连贯的外观和几何一致的场景结构。在包含仿真和真实机器人操纵场景的4D视频生成数据集上进行的大量实验表明，GeoMVGen在视频质量、几何精度和跨视角一致性方面均优于现有最先进方法。

Authors: Qiaoqiao Jia, Guile Wu, Dongfeng Bai

CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers WorldModel

hierarchical world models goal-conditioned planning frozen rollouts visual navigation manipulation

简要说明：CriticJEPA 提出了一种基于分层世界模型的规划器，通过冻结的 rollout 在目标条件流提议中进行选择，在视觉导航和操作任务中以更低的计算成本取得更高成功率，且无需更新世界模型权重。

TLDR: CriticJEPA proposes a hierarchical world-model-based planner that uses frozen rollouts to select among goal-conditioned flow proposals, achieving higher success rates at lower compute for visual navigation and manipulation without updating world-model weights.

Abstract: Visual world models enable goal-directed planning by predicting action outcomes. Gradient-based planners optimize actions to lower predicted goal cost, but continued optimization can exploit prediction errors after execution stops improving. Comparing plans requires informative relative scores; improving them also requires reliable update directions. Exact-state execution reveals that a frozen hierarchical world model ranks goal-conditioned proposals even when its rankings among outputs of prolonged gradient search are uninformative. Effective planning pairs goal-directed candidates with predictions that distinguish their outcomes. We introduce CriticJEPA, which learns goal-conditioned flow proposals from reward-free trajectories and uses frozen rollouts to select among them at every hierarchy level. Forward selection forms a complete planner; short anchored updates refine candidates before selection. Across visual navigation and manipulation, CriticJEPA increases success at a fraction of the planning compute, transferring shared settings across independently trained models, hierarchy depths, and unseen tasks while keeping every world-model weight fixed.

摘要（中文）：视觉世界模型通过预测行动结果来实现目标导向的规划。基于梯度的规划器通过优化行动以降低预测的目标代价，但持续优化可能会在执行不再改善后利用预测误差。比较不同的规划方案需要具有信息量的相对得分；改进这些得分同样需要可靠的更新方向。精确状态执行表明，即使冻结的层次化世界模型在长时间梯度搜索输出的排序中缺乏信息量，它仍能对目标条件下的候选方案进行排序。有效的规划将目标导向的候选方案与能够区分其结果的预测相结合。我们提出了CriticJEPA，该方法从无奖励轨迹中学习目标条件下的流式候选方案，并在每个层次级别使用冻结的展开结果进行筛选。前向选择构成完整的规划器；短时锚定更新在筛选前对候选方案进行细化。在视觉导航和操作任务中，CriticJEPA以极低的规划计算成本提升了成功率，并在独立训练的模型、不同层次深度及未见任务间迁移共享设置，同时保持所有世界模型权重固定不变。

Authors: Xvyuan Liu, Jianjie Fang, Honglin Zhang, Zhaolu Wang, Xin Zhang, Wei Wu, Fengli Xu, Chen Gao, Yong Li

ReJEPA: Bounded Predictive Regulation for Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models log-cosh loss bounded gradients predictive regulation planning

简要说明：ReJEPA 提出了基于 log-cosh 损失的有界预测调节原理，用于潜在世界模型，在导航、操作和自动驾驶任务中提升了表征学习和规划性能。

TLDR: ReJEPA proposes a bounded predictive regulation principle using log-cosh loss for latent world models, improving representation learning and planning performance across navigation, manipulation, and autonomous driving tasks.

Abstract: Latent world models learn representations by predicting future states in an abstract embedding space rather than reconstructing raw pixels. When training across multi-frame sequences, however, not all frames and spatial regions are equally informative or predictable. We argue that forcing a world model to minimize every prediction error may be unnecessary and harmful. Under standard $L_2$ loss, unbounded gradients force the encoder and predictor to overfit noisy or transient frames at the expense of core physical structure, while amplifying gradient conflict with representation regularizers. Conversely, $L_1$ loss bounds large gradients, but its constant gradient magnitude near zero disrupts the local smoothness required for planning. We resolve this tension with \textbf{ReJEPA}, a bounded predictive regulation principle that combines bounded gradients for large errors with smooth quadratic behavior near zero, instantiated simply via the element-wise $\log\cosh$ loss. As a drop-in training replacement across Temporal Straightening, LeWorldModel, and V-JEPA~2.1, $\log\cosh$ consistently outperforms $L_2$, a curvature-matched quadratic control, $L_1$, and Smooth-$L_1$ baselines without altering architectures or inference procedures. Notably, the gains grow with environmental complexity, scaling from simple navigation to contact-rich manipulation and real-world autonomous driving on NAVSIM. Probing and geometric analyses confirm that relaxing the penalty on extreme errors yields representations that better capture physical states and align with the true planning cost landscape.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型通过在抽象嵌入空间中预测未来状态而非重构原始像素来学习表征。然而，在多帧序列训练过程中，并非所有帧和空间区域都具有同等的信息量或可预测性。我们认为，强制世界模型最小化每一个预测误差可能既无必要又有害。在标准$L_2$损失下，无界梯度迫使编码器和预测器过度拟合噪声帧或瞬态帧，从而牺牲核心物理结构，同时放大与表征正则化器之间的梯度冲突。相反，$L_1$损失虽能限制大梯度，但其在零附近的恒定梯度幅度破坏了规划所需的局部平滑性。我们通过提出\textbf{ReJEPA}——一种有界预测正则化原则——来解决这一矛盾，该原则对大误差提供有界梯度，同时在零附近保持平滑的二次行为，其实现方式仅为逐元素的$\log\cosh$损失。作为时间拉直、LeWorldModel和V-JEPA~2.1中的即插即用训练替代方案，$\log\cosh$在架构和推理流程不变的情况下，持续优于$L_2$、曲率匹配的二次控制、$L_1$以及Smooth-$L_1$基线。值得注意的是，性能提升随环境复杂度增加而增大，从简单导航扩展到接触丰富的操作任务以及NAVSIM上的真实世界自动驾驶。探测与几何分析证实，放宽对极端误差的惩罚能够产生更准确地捕捉物理状态、并与真实规划代价景观对齐的表征。

Authors: Fangzhou Lin, Yuping Wang, Shuo Xing, Yang Chen, Yuwen Heng, Xin Li, Wenbin He, Yuhan Yao, Zhengzhong Tu, Liu Ren

From Safety-Driven Redundancy to Value-Driven Architecture: An ODD-Based Rationalization Framework for Level 4 Autonomous Vehicles AutonomousDriving

architecture rationalization Operational Design Domain fault-tolerant architecture lifecycle cost multiobjective optimization

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于ODD的系统工程框架，用于L4级自动驾驶架构合理化，在安全约束下通过多目标帕累托分析平衡生命周期成本。

TLDR: This paper introduces an ODD-based systems-engineering framework for rationalizing Level 4 autonomous vehicle architectures, balancing safety constraints with lifecycle cost through multiobjective Pareto analysis.

Abstract: Level 4 autonomous vehicles require fault-tolerant architectures that preserve critical driving functions under sensing, computing, communication, power, and actuation failures. As these systems progress toward industrial scalability, architectural complexity, validation burden, integration effort, and lifecycle cost become increasingly relevant. This study proposes an Operational Design Domain (ODD)-based, safety-constrained systems-engineering framework for architecture rationalization. ODD-specific capabilities, physical fault assumptions, post-fault operational policies, and spatial sensing requirements are propagated through an integrated safety-feasibility gate. Architecture transformations, including removal, relocation, functional reassignment, and consolidation, are evaluated only within the resulting safety-feasible design space, followed by lifecycle-cost sensitivity and robust multiobjective Pareto analysis. A generic, synthetically parameterized Level 4 architecture is used as a demonstrative computational case study. Within this modeled design space, direct ablation showed limited rationalization potential, whereas directional redistribution and functional consolidation generated a broader set of safety-feasible candidates. Under the illustrative lifecycle-cost model, the best nominal candidate achieved a 5.55% normalized cost reduction and remained cost-reducing across all 5,000 sampled points in the prescribed uncertainty domain. The analysis identified 15 non-dominated architecture-policy solutions representing seven physical transformations. The results support capability-based, policy-conditioned, and lifecycle-aware architecture rationalization under the stated assumptions, with safety retained as a non-compensatory feasibility constraint. The reported transformations are design candidates rather than validated production architectures.

摘要（中文）：四级自动驾驶车辆要求采用容错架构，以在传感、计算、通信、动力和执行器故障情况下维持关键驾驶功能。随着这些系统迈向工业化规模应用，架构复杂性、验证负担、集成工作量及生命周期成本变得日益重要。本研究提出一种基于运行设计域（ODD）且受安全约束的系统工程框架，用于架构合理化。ODD特定能力、物理故障假设、故障后运行策略及空间感知需求通过集成的安全可行性门限进行传播。架构变换，包括移除、重新定位、功能重新分配和整合，仅在由此产生的安全可行设计空间内进行评估，随后进行生命周期成本敏感性分析和鲁棒多目标帕累托分析。本研究采用一个通用的、综合参数化的四级自动驾驶架构作为示范性计算案例。在该建模设计空间内，直接消融分析显示合理化潜力有限，而定向重新分配和功能整合则产生了更广泛的安全可行候选方案。在示例性生命周期成本模型下，最优标称候选方案实现了5.55%的归一化成本降低，并且在指定不确定性域内的全部5，000个采样点上均保持成本降低效果。分析识别出15个非支配的架构-策略解决方案，涵盖七种物理变换。研究结果支持在所述假设条件下，基于能力、策略条件约束及生命周期感知的架构合理化，同时将安全性作为不可补偿的可行性约束予以保留。所报告的变换属于设计候选方案，而非经过验证的量产架构。

Authors: Tiago Simão Ferreira, Farzad Fallahi

Self-Sensing Compliant Anthropomorphic Hand for Speed-Dictated Shared Force Control in Teleoperation Manipulation

self-sensing compliant hand teleoperation shared force control proprioceptive force estimation

简要说明：本文提出一种自感知柔顺拟人手，利用其弹性腱传动作为本体感觉传感器进行力估计，并在VR遥操作中实现共享力控制框架，提高了对易碎和重物的抓取成功率。

TLDR: This paper presents a self-sensing compliant anthropomorphic hand that uses its elastic tendon transmission as proprioceptive sensors for force estimation, enabling a shared force control framework in VR teleoperation that improves grasping success for fragile and heavy objects.

Abstract: In vision-based teleoperation of robotic hands, the operator receives no haptic feedback and therefore struggles to regulate the grasp force, while adding tactile sensors to the fingers increases wiring, cost and integration complexity. Compliant hands offer an alternative, as their mechanical compliance, usually treated only as a passive property for safe and adaptive grasping, can also serve as a source of information. Here, we show that the elastic transmission of a compliant, tendon-driven anthropomorphic hand can itself act as the sensor for shared-control telemanipulation. Series springs in the tendon routing are read by potentiometers in a forearm-mounted motor box, from which the hand estimates its joint states and finger forces without any external sensors. Building on this self-sensing, we develop a contact-aware shared-control framework for VR-based teleoperation. The robot hand is controlled through a mapping from the operator's hand kinematics until a contact is detected proprioceptively. Control then switches to a finger-level force controller whose set point is determined by the operator's grasping speed, and control authority can be allocated to individual fingers. Experiments validate the system's force estimation and increased grasp success rate compared with direct teleoperation for fragile and heavy objects. These results show that compliance can serve not only for passive adaptation but also as an intrinsic sensing resource for physical human-robot collaboration.

摘要（中文）：在基于视觉的机器人手部遥操作过程中，操作者无法获得触觉反馈，因此难以调节抓取力，而将触觉传感器集成至手指则会增加布线复杂度、成本及集成难度。柔顺手提供了一种替代方案，其机械柔顺性通常仅被视为实现安全自适应抓取的被动属性，但亦可作为信息源加以利用。本文表明，一种柔顺的、腱驱动拟人手的弹性传动机构本身即可充当共享控制遥操作的传感器。腱绳路径中的串联弹簧由安装在前臂的电机箱内的电位器读取，机器手无需任何外部传感器即可据此估计其关节状态及手指力。在此基础上，我们开发了一种基于自感知的接触感知共享控制框架，用于基于虚拟现实的遥操作。在手部运动学映射的控制下，机器人手持续运动，直至通过本体感知检测到接触；随后控制切换至手指级力控制器，其设定值由操作者的抓取速度决定，且控制权可分配至各个手指。实验验证了该系统在力和抓取成功率方面的性能，与直接遥操作相比，在抓取易碎和重物时成功率显著提高。这些结果表明，柔顺性不仅可用于被动适应，还可作为物理人机协作中的内在感知资源。

Authors: Huijiang Wang, Yu Zhang, Rui Chen, Tristan Bonato, Jaemin Eom, Kai Junge, Cheng Pan, Benhui Dai, Yue Xie, Josie Hughes

MRBench: Benchmarking Physical Necessity Reasoning in Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Manipulation Manipulation

multi-robot manipulation physical necessity reasoning team selection constrained search benchmark

简要说明：MRBench 提出了一个异构多机器人操作中的物理必要性推理基准和方法 MRScissors，表明现有协调代理在所需资源变化时表现不佳，而 MRScissors 提高了团队选择准确率。

TLDR: MRBench introduces a benchmark and method (MRScissors) for physical necessity reasoning in heterogeneous multi-robot manipulation, showing that existing coordination agents fail when required resources change, while MRScissors improves team-selection accuracy.

Abstract: Recent advances in multi-robot manipulation have shown how robots can collaborate to accomplish complex tasks. However, successful coordination does not reveal which robots are actually needed. The same task may require different teams as robot capabilities change, resources become unavailable, or objects replace robotic support. We argue that reliable multi-robot manipulation requires physical necessity reasoning: understanding what a task demands, which resources can fulfill those demands, and which are truly necessary. We introduce MRBench, a benchmark for physical necessity reasoning in heterogeneous multi-robot manipulation. It comprises eight tasks with distinct concurrency and reach constraints, each evaluated under five configurations that change the required resources while preserving the task goal. Our evaluation reveals that existing coordination agents perform well with reference teams but struggle when robot embodiments change or passive objects can replace robotic support. To address this gap, we propose MRScissors, which separates task requirements from measured physical capabilities and identifies minimal feasible teams through constrained search. Across two model backbones, MRScissors achieves 85.4% and 91.2% team-selection accuracy, outperforming the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 9.5 points, respectively. Together, these findings expose a critical gap between coordinating robots and understanding their physical necessity.

摘要（中文）：近年来，多机器人操控领域的进展表明，机器人能够协作完成复杂任务。然而，成功的协调并不能揭示哪些机器人实际上是必需的。随着机器人能力的变化、资源变得不可用，或物体取代了机器人支撑，同一任务可能需要不同的团队组合。我们认为，可靠的多机器人操控需要物理必要性推理：理解任务要求什么、哪些资源能够满足这些要求，以及哪些资源是真正必需的。为此，我们提出了MRBench，一个用于异构多机器人操控中物理必要性推理的基准测试平台。该基准包含八项具有不同并发性和可达性约束的任务，每项任务在五种配置下进行评估，这些配置在保持任务目标不变的前提下改变所需资源。我们的评估显示，现有的协调智能体在参考团队下表现良好，但当机器人形态发生变化或被动物体能够取代机器人支撑时，它们则难以应对。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了MRScissors方法，它将任务要求与实测物理能力分离，并通过约束搜索识别最小可行团队。在两个模型骨干网络上，MRScissors的团队选择准确率分别达到85.4%和91.2%，超出最强基线10.4和9.5个百分点。综上，这些发现揭示了协调机器人与理解其物理必要性之间的关键差距。

Authors: Yanzhe Chen, Zhijun Cao, Ruihe An, Chang Gong, Mike Zheng Shou

Keypose or Dense? A Controlled Comparison of Action Representations for Stage-Structured Manipulation Manipulation

keypose action representation dense action representation stage-structured manipulation imitation learning real robot

简要说明：本文比较了阶段化操作中的关键姿态和密集动作表示，发现关键姿态对演示变化更鲁棒，但依赖执行器设置，而密集在干净演示下表现更好。

TLDR: This paper compares keypose and dense action representations for stage-structured manipulation, showing that keypose is more robust to demonstration variations but depends on executor settings, while dense excels with clean demonstrations.

Abstract: Most imitation policies that predict chunks of future actions use the dense action representation, in which the chunk holds one control target per step. In stage-structured manipulation, where a task can be divided into stages with definable endpoints, the keypose action representation instead sets each step of the chunk to the endpoint of the stage that step belongs to, and a speed-capped servo supplies the motion. We compare the two in several simulated manipulation tasks and on a real robot, with the same chunk length and matched demonstrations, observations, policy architectures and update budgets; in simulation, each one's execution rule is selected on tuning scenes. When the simulated demonstrations are slowed, paused and rerouted, dense success falls sharply while keypose stays roughly level, across three policy architectures and with endpoints extracted from the recorded demonstrations; keypose also leads under object-size and position shift. With clean demonstrations, keypose leads only when they are scarce and is otherwise close to or behind dense across the simulated tasks, provided that the demonstrations and execution rule suit its executor; when they do not, it falls far below dense. The same dependence on the executor appeared on a real robot learning to open a drawer from human demonstrations: dense succeeded more often, and keypose improved substantially only after its executor's rotation and forward speed were adjusted to the demonstrations. These results suggest that keypose trades sensitivity to such variation in the demonstrations for sensitivity to execution that departs from them.

摘要（中文）：大多数预测未来动作片段的模仿策略采用密集动作表示，其中每个时间步的片段包含一个控制目标。在阶段结构化操作中，任务可以被划分为具有可定义端点的阶段，关键姿态动作表示则将片段的每一步设置为该步所属阶段的端点，并由限速伺服提供运动。我们在多个模拟操作任务和真实机器人上进行了比较，使用相同的片段长度和匹配的演示、观测、策略架构以及更新预算；在模拟中，每种执行规则都在调优场景中进行选择。当模拟演示被减速、暂停和重新规划路径时，密集策略的成功率急剧下降，而关键姿态策略在三种策略架构下保持大致稳定，且端点从记录的演示中提取；关键姿态在物体尺寸和位置偏移下也表现更优。在清晰演示条件下，关键姿态仅在演示样本稀缺时领先，在其他模拟任务中则接近或落后于密集策略，前提是演示和执行规则适合其执行器；若不匹配，则其表现远低于密集策略。在真实机器人从人类演示学习打开抽屉的任务中，也出现了对执行器的类似依赖：密集策略成功频率更高，而关键姿态仅在其执行器的旋转速度和前向速度调整到与演示匹配后才显著提升。这些结果表明，关键姿态将对演示中此类变化的敏感性转化为对偏离演示的执行行为的敏感性。

Authors: Haizhou Ge, Mengshuo Wang, Zhixing Chen, Lei Han, Chen Wang, Lu Shi, Guyue Zhou, Ruqi Huang

LaWanle: Why Can't Leading Driving Models Make a Simple Turn? AutonomousDriving

end-to-end driving closed-loop simulation DAgger fine-tuning benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了LaWanle基准，用于在逼真闭环驾驶模拟器中测试转弯能力，发现主流端到端驾驶模型因对航向敏感而无法完成简单的90度转弯，并展示了通过闭环DAgger微调少量模型参数可显著提高转弯成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces LaWanle, a benchmark of turns in photorealistic closed-loop driving simulators, revealing that leading end-to-end driving models fail simple 90-degree turns due to heading sensitivity, and shows that closed-loop DAgger fine-tuning of a small fraction of model parameters can significantly improve turn pass rates.

Abstract: We were surprised to find that leading end-to-end driving models across major paradigms, despite scoring close to human drivers on NAVSIM, cannot reliably make a simple 90-degree turn in photorealistic closed-loop simulators. To investigate why, we build LaWanle, a benchmark of turns drawn from three such simulators. Driving each turn from several starts, we find that the same model passes it from one start and fails it from another, and that the two drives look alike until they enter the junction. Rotating the car by a few degrees at the junction entry can fail a turn it otherwise passes. Conversely, a slight heading correction to the plans can rescue about half of the failed turns we tested. Such errors arise when a model drives by itself, so we post-train an open-source lane-keeping model with closed-loop DAgger on its lateral path. Training 5% of its parameters is enough to raise its turn pass rate from 19% to 76%. The gain transfers to the two other benchmarks, where the policy also scores among the leading models. Further fine-tuning on recovery data repairs the deviations it is trained on but, against a control trained equally long, improves turns on none of the three benchmarks, and every variant stays far below a human driver.

摘要（中文）：我们惊讶地发现，在NAVSIM上得分接近人类驾驶员的主流端到端驾驶模型，在照片级逼真的闭环模拟器中，却无法可靠地完成一个简单的90度转弯。为探究其原因，我们构建了LaWanle基准测试，其中包含来自三个此类模拟器的转弯场景。从多个起点分别驾驶每个转弯场景，我们发现同一模型从某个起点能够通过，而从另一起点却会失败，且两次驾驶在进入交叉口前的轨迹几乎相同。在交叉口入口处将车辆旋转几度，就可能导致原本可以通过的转弯失败。相反，对规划路径进行轻微的航向修正，则能挽救我们所测试的约一半失败转弯。这类错误在模型自主驾驶时出现，因此我们使用闭环DAgger算法对开源车道保持模型进行横向路径的后训练。仅训练其5%的参数，即可将转弯通过率从19%提升至76%。这一提升可迁移至另外两个基准测试，该策略的得分也位列领先模型之中。进一步在恢复数据上进行微调，能够修复训练中遇到的偏差，但与经过同等时长训练的对照组相比，在三个基准测试的转弯表现均无提升，且所有变体的表现仍远低于人类驾驶员。

Authors: Chengzhi Gao, Junzhe Gao, Yongzhi Liu, Weichao Zhuang, Weilong Hu, Taonian Liang, Guodong Yin

RoboRecast: Intent-Preserving Demonstration Augmentation via Diagnosis-Driven Optimization Manipulation

demonstration augmentation simulation feedback agentic optimization manipulation policy learning sim-to-real

简要说明：RoboRecast 是一个智能体优化框架，通过联合优化模拟场景和运动，在将操作演示迁移到新布局、物体或机器人时保留任务意图，从而增强策略学习，在真实单臂和模拟双臂任务上均提升了成功率。

TLDR: RoboRecast is an agentic optimization framework that augments robot manipulation demonstrations by jointly optimizing simulated scenes and motions to preserve task intent when transferring to new layouts, objects, or embodiments, improving policy learning in both single-arm real-world and simulated bimanual tasks.

Abstract: Collecting diverse real-world manipulation demonstrations is costly, motivating the use of simulation to augment existing demonstrations for robot policy learning. When objects, layouts, or robots change, transferring motions from a source demonstration can produce behavior that is semantically implausible or physically infeasible in the new setting. We introduce RoboRecast, an agentic optimization framework that preserves the interactions required by the source task while jointly optimizing the simulated scene and robot motion to make those interactions executable in the target setting. When an interaction fails, the agent uses simulation feedback to diagnose the cause, revise the relevant scene or motion parameters, and test whether the revision resolves the failure. This flexibility allows RoboRecast to generate synthetic data from both human and robot demonstrations and to adapt them to new layouts, objects, and robot embodiments. When target demonstrations are available, adding RoboRecast data improves policy success on both real-world single-arm and simulated bimanual tasks. Even without demonstrations in the target configuration, RoboRecast adapts source demonstrations to support policy learning with new objects or robot embodiments.

摘要（中文）：收集多样化的真实世界操作演示成本高昂，这促使人们利用仿真来扩充现有演示数据，以支持机器人策略学习。当物体、布局或机器人发生变化时，从源演示中迁移运动可能会在新环境中产生语义上不合理或物理上不可行的行为。我们提出RoboRecast，一个智能体优化框架，它在保留源任务所需交互的同时，联合优化仿真场景和机器人运动，使这些交互在目标环境中可执行。当交互失败时，智能体利用仿真反馈诊断失败原因，修改相关场景或运动参数，并测试修改是否解决了问题。这种灵活性使RoboRecast能够从人类和机器人演示中生成合成数据，并将其适应于新的布局、物体和机器人本体。当目标演示可用时，加入RoboRecast数据能够提高真实世界单臂任务和仿真双臂任务中的策略成功率。即使在目标配置中没有演示数据，RoboRecast也能适应源演示，以支持新物体或新机器人本体下的策略学习。

Authors: Yushi Long, Juzhan Xu, Haibin Huang, Chi Zhang, Yin Chen, Sida Peng, Ruizhen Hu, Xiaowei Zhou

An XR-Based System for Enhanced Spatial Awareness in Mobile Robot Teleoperation Other

XR teleoperation haptic feedback mobile robot LiDAR user study

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于XR的移动机器人遥操作系统，采用固定双摄像头和激光雷达生成的触觉反馈，以增强空间感知并降低避障时的认知负荷，用户研究验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper presents an XR-based teleoperation system for mobile robots that uses a fixed dual-camera setup and LiDAR-generated haptic feedback to improve spatial awareness and reduce cognitive load during obstacle avoidance, as demonstrated in a user study.

Abstract: Teleoperation of mobile robots represents a critical capability for operations in hazardous environments, yet maintaining adequate situational awareness remains challenging without effective visualization and control interfaces. This work presents a multi-modal extended reality (XR) system for robot teleoperation and scene exploration that integrates immersive visual and haptic feedback modalities. To address motion sickness commonly induced by 360-degree camera feeds in head-mounted displays (HMDs), the system employs a fixed dual-camera configuration: a forward-facing camera for primary navigation and a rear-facing camera for enhanced situational awareness without operator discomfort. For navigation in confined or low-visibility conditions, a 16-channel Velodyne LiDAR generates real-time 2D occupancy grid maps, which are converted into vibrational haptic feedback on handheld controllers to provide intuitive, non-visual obstacle detection. User evaluation with 20 participants demonstrates that this haptic modality significantly reduces the cognitive load associated with obstacle avoidance during teleoperation.

摘要（中文）：移动机器人遥操作在危险环境作业中具有关键能力，然而，若缺乏有效的可视化与控制界面，维持充分的态势感知仍具挑战性。本研究提出一种用于机器人遥操作与场景探索的多模态扩展现实（XR）系统，该系统集成了沉浸式视觉与触觉反馈模态。为缓解头戴式显示器（HMDs）中360度摄像头画面常引发的晕动症，系统采用固定双摄像头配置：前置摄像头用于主要导航，后置摄像头用于增强态势感知，同时避免操作者不适。针对狭窄或低能见度环境下的导航需求，16通道Velodyne LiDAR实时生成二维占据栅格地图，并将其转换为手持控制器上的振动触觉反馈，以提供直观的非视觉障碍物检测。基于20名参与者的用户评估表明，该触觉模态显著降低了遥操作过程中与避障相关的认知负荷。

Authors: Subhransu Sourav Priyadarshan, Valentina Pericu, Federico Rollo, Gianni Viardo Vercelli, Navvab Kashiri

Design, Control, and Teleoperation of a Dexterous Robotic Hand with Soft-Rigid Hybrid Fingers Manipulation

soft-rigid hybrid hand tendon-driven teleoperation dexterous manipulation grasp generalization

简要说明：本文介绍了一种具有软硬混合手指的五指灵巧机器人手，展示了高柔顺性、高速度以及在多种遥操作任务中的有效性。

TLDR: This paper presents a five-fingered dexterous robotic hand with soft-rigid hybrid fingers, demonstrating high compliance, fast speed, and effective teleoperated manipulation in various tasks.

Abstract: Adding compliance to robot hands results in higher grasp quality and robust contact with the environment. Soft hands are inherently compliant, but are typically more complex to control and model than rigid equivalents. We extend prior work on soft-rigid hybrid robot fingers into a five-fingered dexterous gripper --- an integrated tendon-driven hand that is highly compliant and controllable. Structural compliance combined with a rigid skeleton, when realized in a five-fingered hand, allow us to use linear control to achieve soft-grasping generality. We evaluate the use of this hand in a variety of teleoperated manipulation tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of the overall mechanical design and control strategy. Our contributions include: (1) Mechanical design of the a five-fingered Soft-Rigid Hybrid Hand, composed of 12 active degrees of freedom, demonstrating a high degree on generalization enabled by the soft-rigid architecture, with our gripper, able to complete 28 of the 33 (84.8\%) grasp postures in the human range. (2) Precise, high bandwidth (up to 1432deg/s extension speed, compared with 700deg/s for the equivalent human joint). (3) Position and task space controllers for the soft-rigid hybrid finger and whole hand. (4) A teleoperation framework for control of this hand, as well as demonstrations of its efficacy in a variety of grasping and manipulation tasks Further tests illustrate the hand's advantages in completing non-rigid manipulation tasks, such as picking up thin deformable objects (such as a dollar bill or folding cloth) as well as in interfacing with soft or delicate targets.

摘要（中文）：增加机器人手的柔性可以实现更高的抓取质量和与环境鲁棒接触。软手本质上是柔顺的，但通常比刚性手更难以控制与建模。本文将先前关于软-刚混合机器人手指的研究扩展为五指灵巧夹爪——一种集成腱驱动的高度柔顺且可控的手。结构柔性与刚性骨架相结合，在五指手中得以实现，使我们能够使用线性控制来实现软抓取的普适性。我们评估了该手在多种遥操作操控任务中的表现，验证了整体机械设计与控制策略的有效性。我们的贡献包括：（1）设计了一种包含12个主动自由度的五指软-刚混合手，展示了软-刚结构带来的高度泛化能力，该夹爪能够完成人类33种抓取姿态中的28种（84.8%）。（2）实现高带宽的精确运动（伸展速度高达1432度/秒，而对应人类关节为700度/秒）。（3）提出了针对软-刚混合手指及整手的位置控制器和任务空间控制器。（4）建立了一套用于操控该手的遥操作框架，并展示了其在多种抓取与操控任务中的效能。进一步测试表明，该手在完成非刚性操控任务中具有优势，例如拾取薄形可变形物体（如纸币或折叠布料），以及在与柔软或易碎目标交互方面表现突出。

Authors: Chao Liu, Wil J. Norton, Branden Romero, Daniela Rus

Follow-Bench 2.0: An End-to-End 3D Benchmark for Socially-Aware Robot Person Following Other

socially-aware robot person following end-to-end benchmark closed-loop evaluation perception-planning social-space intrusion

简要说明：Follow-Bench 2.0 是一个端到端 3D 基准，用于评估具有社会意识的机器人跟随任务，提供难度分级场景和统一指标以评估感知-规划耦合及社交合规性。

TLDR: Follow-Bench 2.0 is an end-to-end 3D benchmark for evaluating socially-aware robot person following, providing difficulty-leveled scenarios and unified metrics to assess perception-planning coupling and social compliance.

Abstract: Socially-aware robot person following (RPF) requires a mobile robot to follow a designated person in dynamic human environments while maintaining target identity, avoiding obstacles and pedestrians, and preserving socially comfortable formations. Existing benchmarks only partially evaluate this coupled problem: embodied visual tracking benchmarks emphasize target visibility with limited social interaction, person re-identification benchmarks study perception without closed-loop control, and motion-planning benchmarks often assume ground-truth target and pedestrian states. We introduce Follow-Bench 2.0, an end-to-end 3D benchmark for evaluating socially-aware RPF under coupled perception--planning challenges. Built in Unreal Engine, Follow-Bench 2.0 provides difficulty-leveled scenarios with diverse pedestrian flows, lighting and weather conditions, cluttered layouts, bottlenecks, queueing behaviors, distractors, and temporary target occlusions. The benchmark supports modular perception--planning pipelines, end-to-end visual policies, and foundation-model-based active trackers under a unified closed-loop protocol. It further evaluates both back- and side-following configurations and reports safety--comfort metrics covering task success, target visibility, target recovery, social-space intrusion, following formation, and motion smoothness. Experiments show that RPF-oriented modular pipelines substantially outperform current end-to-end visual policies on close and socially comfortable following, but also reveal that socially-aware RPF remains far from solved in interaction-heavy environments and especially in side-following. Follow-Bench 2.0 therefore provides a diagnostic platform for studying how perception errors, occlusions, crowd interactions, and following configurations jointly affect robot person following.

摘要（中文）：社交感知型机器人跟随（RPF）要求移动机器人在动态人类环境中跟随指定人员，同时保持目标身份、避开障碍物和行人，并维持符合社交礼仪的编队姿态。现有基准测试仅部分评估了这一耦合问题：具身视觉跟踪基准侧重于目标可见性且社交交互有限，行人重识别基准研究感知但缺乏闭环控制，运动规划基准则通常假设目标和行人的状态为真值已知。我们提出了Follow-Bench 2.0，一个端到端的3D基准测试平台，用于在感知-规划耦合挑战下评估社交感知型机器人跟随。该基准基于虚幻引擎构建，提供难度分级场景，涵盖多样化人流、光照与天气条件、杂乱布局、瓶颈区域、排队行为、干扰物以及目标临时遮挡等情况。该基准支持模块化感知-规划流水线、端到端视觉策略以及基于基础模型的主动跟踪器，并采用统一的闭环协议。进一步地，它同时评估后方跟随和侧方跟随两种配置，并报告涵盖任务成功率、目标可见性、目标恢复、社交空间侵入、跟随编队和运动平滑性在内的安全-舒适度指标。实验表明，面向RPF的模块化流水线在近距离和社交舒适的跟随任务上显著优于当前的端到端视觉策略，但同时也揭示出社交感知型RPF在交互密集环境中，尤其是侧方跟随场景下，仍远未得到充分解决。因此，Follow-Bench 2.0为研究感知误差、遮挡、人群交互和跟随配置如何共同影响机器人人员跟随提供了诊断平台。

Authors: Hanjing Ye, Tianle Zeng, Jianwei Peng, Yanci Wen, Yuchen Zhou, Yonggen Ling, Hong Zhang

EmbodiedStudio: A Task-Driven Simulation Generation Platform for Embodied Learning and Evaluation Other

simulation generation task-driven embodied learning closed-loop feedback rubric faithfulness

简要说明：EmbodiedStudio 在闭环仿真反馈下联合编写场景、任务、机器人行为和评分程序，生成物理稳定且任务就绪的具身仿真环境，并确保评估程序忠实可靠。

TLDR: EmbodiedStudio jointly authors scenes, tasks, robot behaviors, and rubrics under closed-loop simulation feedback, yielding physically stable and task-ready embodied simulation environments with faithful evaluation programs.

Abstract: Training and evaluating robots across diverse tasks requires a supply of simulation environments suited to those tasks. While recent scene and task generators offer a promising way to expand this supply, delivering a usable task environment still faces two practical gaps: generated scenes that look plausible in appearance often fail to support the intended task interactions or remain physically stable in simulation, and generated scoring programs frequently attempt task conditions without implementing them faithfully. We present EmbodiedStudio, a task-driven simulation generation platform that bridges these gaps by jointly authoring scene, task, robot-behavior, and rubric programs under closed-loop simulation feedback and independent review. Crucially, as the coding agent iteratively debugs scenes, behaviors, and stateful rubrics in simulation, this closed-loop process natively yields both forward construction experience for learning to build environments and physical execution experience for policy learning, all bound to frozen environment revisions for repeatable evaluation. Across scene generation, rubric evaluation, ablations, and learning studies, EmbodiedStudio substantially improves task readiness and rubric faithfulness while improving physical stability and retaining actionable supervision signals for layout authoring and policy adaptation.

摘要（中文）：训练和评估机器人完成多样化任务，需要提供与这些任务相适应的仿真环境。尽管近期的场景生成器和任务生成器为扩充这一供给提供了有前景的途径，但交付可用的任务环境仍面临两个实际缺口：生成的场景在外观上看似合理，却往往无法支持预期的任务交互，或在仿真中难以保持物理稳定性；同时，生成的评分程序常常尝试设定任务条件，却未能忠实地实现这些条件。我们提出了EmbodiedStudio，一个任务驱动的仿真生成平台，通过在闭环仿真反馈和独立审查下联合编写场景、任务、机器人行为和评分规则程序，弥合了上述缺口。关键在于，随着编码代理在仿真中迭代调试场景、行为和带有状态的评分规则，这一闭环过程天然地同时生成了用于学习构建环境的前向构建经验，以及用于策略学习的物理执行经验，且所有经验均绑定到固定的环境修订版本上，以确保可重复的评估。在场景生成、评分规则评估、消融实验和学习研究中，EmbodiedStudio显著提升了任务就绪度和评分规则的忠实度，同时改善了物理稳定性，并为布局编写和策略适应保留了可操作的监督信号。

Authors: Yang Zhao, Xubo Yang

AirLeg: A Robust and Accurate Self-Supervised Visual-Inertial-Leg SLAM System Locomotion

visual-inertial-leg SLAM self-supervised learning leg odometry imperative learning bundle adjustment

简要说明：AirLeg 提出了一种用于腿式机器人的自监督视觉-惯性-腿 SLAM 系统，通过命令学习使视觉和腿部本体感觉相互改进，在无真值的情况下实现鲁棒且准确的定位。

TLDR: AirLeg presents a self-supervised visual-inertial-leg SLAM system for legged robots, where vision and leg proprioception mutually improve each other through imperative learning, achieving robust and accurate localization without ground truth.

Abstract: Visual-inertial-leg (VIL) state estimation offers cost-effective localization for legged robots, adding only a camera to the onboard IMU and joint encoders. However, learning-based leg odometry is limited by its supervision: networks trained in simulation suffer from the sim-to-real gap, while real-world labels require costly sensors or inherit the errors of visual estimates. To address this, we present AirLeg, a self-supervised VIL SLAM system in which vision and leg proprioception improve each other from training to deployment. We pre-train the leg odometry network in simulation and adapt it to the robot without ground truth through imperative learning, where multi-sensor bundle adjustment uses the leg odometry to refine the visual map, which in turn supervises the network. During deployment, the fused estimates adapt the network online. To improve both localization and this supervision, a dual-window estimator fuses vision, IMU, and leg odometry, relates loaded feet to the visually reconstructed terrain through a deformation-aware constraint, and weights the constraints by variance component estimation. AirLeg completes all 17 GrandTour sequences with the lowest average error (0.19 m) among 19 methods. On a low-cost quadruped, it achieves the lowest drift (0.6%) with only 0.5 h of unlabeled data, in real time on an embedded computer.

摘要（中文）：视觉-惯性-腿部（VIL）状态估计为腿式机器人提供了经济高效的自定位方案，仅需在机载惯性测量单元和关节编码器的基础上增加一个相机。然而，基于学习的腿部里程计受限于其监督方式：在仿真中训练的网络面临仿真到现实差距的问题，而真实世界标签则要么需要昂贵的传感器，要么继承视觉估计的误差。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AirLeg，一个自监督的VIL同步定位与建图（SLAM）系统，在该系统中视觉与腿部本体感觉从训练到部署阶段相互提升。我们在仿真中预训练腿部里程计网络，并通过命令式学习在无真值情况下使其适应机器人，其中多传感器束调整利用腿部里程计优化视觉地图，而优化后的视觉地图反过来监督网络训练。在部署阶段，融合估计结果在线自适应调整网络。为提升定位精度及上述监督效果，我们设计了一个双窗口估计器，融合视觉、惯性测量单元和腿部里程计，通过变形感知约束将支撑脚与视觉重建地形相关联，并利用方差分量估计对各约束进行加权。AirLeg完成了全部17条GrandTour序列，在19种方法中取得了最低的平均误差（0.19米）。在一台低成本四足机器人上，仅使用0.5小时无标注数据，在嵌入式计算机上实时运行时，实现了最低漂移率（0.6%）。

Authors: Kuan Xu, Tianxin Hu, Ruofei Bai, Ruimeng Liu, Yuefan Hao, Zeyu Jiang, Zitong Zhan, Shenghai Yuan, Chen Wang, Lihua Xie

MRCT: An Object-Centric Two-Layer Control Architecture for Heavy-Payload Multi-Robot Transportation Manipulation

multi-robot transportation model predictive control whole-body impedance control heterogeneous mobile manipulators cooperative manipulation

简要说明：MRCT提出了一种以物体为中心的两层控制架构，将物体层的模型预测控制与机器人层的全身阻抗控制相结合，用于异构移动机械臂协同搬运重型载荷，并在仿真和硬件上得到验证。

TLDR: MRCT introduces an object-centric two-layer control architecture combining MPC at the object level with whole-body impedance control at the robot level for cooperative heavy-payload transportation by heterogeneous mobile manipulators, validated in simulations and hardware.

Abstract: Cooperative transportation of heavy payloads by heterogeneous mobile manipulators requires coordinated payload motion, force distribution, and compliant physical interaction. This paper presents MRCT, an object-centric two-layer control architecture for multi-robot transportation. At the object level, a model predictive controller (MPC) generates a coordinated contact-force reference for the payload. At the robot level, whole- body impedance control (WBIC) modules on individual robots realise the reference through a confidence-based blending of velocity-tracking and impedance torques. The blending mechanism emphasises tracking when the joint-velocity error is small and increases compliance when tracking degrades because of abrupt reference changes or physical disturbances. Simulation and hardware experiments with a heterogeneous team comprising a single-arm and a dual-arm mobile manipulator transporting a near-rated table payload demonstrate accurate object tracking, regulated contact forces, and stable payload orientation. Parameter sensitivity studies, obstacle-avoidance transportation, and step-load disturbance experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of MRCT for reliable cooperative transportation under the evaluated conditions

摘要（中文）：异构移动机械臂协同运输重载有效载荷需要在载荷运动、力分布和柔顺物理交互方面实现协调。本文提出MRCT，一种面向物体的两层级多机器人运输控制架构。在物体层级，模型预测控制器生成载荷的协调接触力参考。在机器人层级，各机器人上的全身阻抗控制模块通过基于置信度的速度跟踪与阻抗力矩融合来实现该参考。该融合机制在关节速度误差较小时强调跟踪，并在因参考突变或物理扰动导致跟踪性能下降时增加柔顺性。仿真与硬件实验采用包含单臂和双臂移动机械臂的异构团队运输近额定载重的桌面载荷，结果表明该系统实现了精确的物体跟踪、受控的接触力以及稳定的载荷姿态。参数敏感性研究、避障运输和阶跃负载扰动实验进一步验证了MRCT在所评估条件下实现可靠协同运输的有效性。

Authors: Ning Wang, Yoshihiko Nakamura, Tianwei Zhang

CoFiNav: VLM-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Semantic Navigation for Open-Ended Last-Mile UAV Delivery Other

VLM-guided navigation coarse-to-fine semantic navigation UAV delivery active 3D observation

简要说明：CoFiNav 提出了一种由 VLM 引导的由粗到细的无人机语义导航框架，通过层级语义搜索和主动 3D 观测来定位关系定义的终点，在城市场景中提升了成功率与飞行效率。

TLDR: CoFiNav proposes a VLM-guided coarse-to-fine framework for open-ended semantic UAV delivery navigation, using hierarchical semantic search and active 3D observation to ground relation-defined destinations in urban environments. It improves success rate and flight efficiency over adapted baselines.

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) delivery is an important application of the low-altitude economy, enhancing the flexibility and accessibility of last-mile logistics. Existing UAV delivery methods generally rely on precise terminal coordinates, predefined terminal specifications, or task-specific localization procedures, limiting the scope and flexibility of delivery. As UAV logistics becomes more intelligent, open-ended semantic descriptions offer a new paradigm for specifying terminal destinations. However, conventional aerial navigation methods have limited ability to generalize to delivery scenarios that require open-vocabulary terminal navigation. To enable this broader delivery paradigm, we propose CoFiNav, a VLM-guided coarse-to-fine UAV semantic navigation framework that progressively grounds relation-defined terminal destinations through hierarchical semantic search and active 3D observation. Given a task description, a coarse prior map from OpenStreetMap (OSM), and accumulated observations, CoFiNav uses a vision-language model (VLM) to determine which unresolved entity or spatial relation should be verified next. A geometry-aware module converts the semantic observation request into feasible viewpoints using RGB images and LiDAR, while conventional motion planning handles safe execution. Experiments across multiple urban environments show that CoFiNav outperforms representative adapted baselines in success rate while requiring shorter flight paths and fewer observations.

摘要（中文）：无人机配送是低空经济的重要应用，能够提升末端物流的灵活性与可达性。现有无人机配送方法通常依赖精确的目标坐标、预设的着陆点规格或针对特定任务的位置识别流程，这限制了配送的范围和灵活性。随着无人机物流日益智能化，开放式语义描述为指定配送终点提供了一种新的范式。然而，传统空中导航方法在面对需要开放词汇终点导航的配送场景时，泛化能力有限。为实现这一更广泛的配送范式，我们提出了CoFiNav——一种由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的无人机由粗到精语义导航框架，通过层次化语义搜索与主动三维观测，逐步定位由关系定义的配送终点。给定任务描述、来自OpenStreetMap（OSM）的粗粒度先验地图以及累积观测信息，CoFiNav利用视觉语言模型判断下一步应验证哪个未解析实体或空间关系。几何感知模块利用RGB图像和LiDAR将语义观测请求转换为可行视角，而传统运动规划负责安全执行。在多个城市环境中的实验表明，CoFiNav在成功率上优于具有代表性的改编基线方法，同时所需飞行路径更短、观测次数更少。

Authors: Xuanpu Wang, Shun Hu, Bing Li, Rongqing Zhang

ViTacLab: Physically Consistent Visuo-Tactile Simulation, Benchmarking, and Representation Learning for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

visuo-tactile simulation contact-rich manipulation tactile representation learning policy learning dexterous manipulation

简要说明：ViTacLab 提出了一个物理一致的视觉-触觉仿真框架、基准测试和策略表征学习方法，用于接触丰富的机器人操作，提高了力精度并支持多种夹爪的策略学习。

TLDR: ViTacLab introduces a physically consistent visuo-tactile simulation framework, benchmark, and policy representation learning method for contact-rich robotic manipulation, improving force accuracy and enabling policy learning across diverse grippers.

Abstract: Tactile sensing is essential for contact-rich robotic manipulation, but existing visuo-tactile simulators trade physical fidelity for scalability, and benchmarks largely focus on two-finger grippers. We present ViTacLab, a framework comprising ViTacSim, ViTacBench, and ViTacPolicy. ViTacSim uses a tri-modal tactile primitive: a global sparse contact-force lattice, a local dense force array, and tactile images. Anchored to PhysX contact-solver outputs, it corrects normal inconsistency through local stiffness alignment and reconstructs tangential forces under decoupled slip-stick regimes while preserving GPU parallelism. A joint projection preserves the sparse wrench and enforces local friction cones. ViTacBench spans parallel grippers, dexterous hands, and bimanual systems, with tasks ranging from vision-dominant to tactile-dominant regimes. ViTacPolicy aggregates variable numbers of heterogeneous tactile inputs using spatial-pose embeddings and a Transformer, and aligns force-array and tactile-image modalities through a two-stream VQ-VAE with a shared codebook. Controlled Hertzian-reference indentation and real-sensor sliding tests reduce normal and tangential force RMSE from 2.31 and 1.85 N to 0.42 and 0.53 N, respectively. Throughput reaches 2,482.9 tactile-pipeline FPS at 256 parallel environments. Simulation and real-world experiments show gains on several contact-rich tasks, while low absolute success on tactile-dominant tasks highlights the remaining difficulty of purely tactile control.

摘要（中文）：触觉感知对于接触密集的机器人操作至关重要，但现有的视觉-触觉模拟器在物理保真度与可扩展性之间难以兼顾，且相关基准测试主要集中在双指夹爪上。我们提出了ViTacLab框架，包含ViTacSim、ViTacBench和ViTacPolicy三个模块。ViTacSim采用三模态触觉基元：全局稀疏接触力晶格、局部密集力阵列以及触觉图像。以PhysX接触求解器输出为锚点，通过局部刚度对齐校正法向不一致性，并在解耦的滑移-粘滞机制下重建切向力，同时保持GPU并行性。联合投影保留了稀疏力旋量并施加局部摩擦锥约束。ViTacBench覆盖平行夹爪、灵巧手和双臂系统，任务范围从视觉主导到触觉主导不等。ViTacPolicy利用空间位姿嵌入和Transformer聚合可变数量的异构触觉输入，并通过共享码本的双流VQ-VAE对齐力阵列与触觉图像模态。受控赫兹参考压痕实验和真实传感器滑动测试将法向和切向力的均方根误差分别从2.31 N和1.85 N降至0.42 N和0.53 N。在256个并行环境中，吞吐量达到每秒2，482.9帧触觉处理流水线。仿真与真实世界实验表明，在多项接触密集任务上均有性能提升，而触觉主导任务上的绝对成功率较低，凸显了纯触觉控制的剩余挑战。
