Authors: Linjing You, Zeming Yang, Zhenhao Shen, Shengqiang Xu, Guanda Li, Wenxuan Li, Jiyu Guo, Jasper Lu, Kyle Xu, Shawn Xie, Junjie Zhu, Siyu Wu, Jian Liu, Changhao Zhang, Rongchong Li, Zeyi Li, Hengshuang Zhao, Ruihai Wu

Motion Chain of Thought: Disentangling Motion Semantics from Visual Appearance for Robotic Manipulation WorldModel

World Action Models motion chain-of-thought state transition tokens robotic manipulation data-efficient adaptation

简要说明：PILOT 提出了一种表征演绎方法，将运动思维链指导集成到世界动作模型中，使动作分支显式建模潜在状态转移标记，以将高层运动语义与低层轨迹细节解耦，从而提升机器人操作的成功率、泛化能力和数据效率。

TLDR: PILOT introduces a Representational Deduction approach that integrates motion chain-of-thought guidance into World Action Models, so the action branch explicitly models potential state transition tokens to decouple high-level motion semantics from low-level trajectory details, improving success rate, generalization, and data efficiency in robotic manipulation.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) aim to construct a unified architecture capable of understanding world state evolution and guiding action generation. However, existing visual branches focus on predicting static visual observation, rather than reflecting potential transition information that captures the evolution of world states under motion interactions. This leads to representational entanglement between high-level physical condition evolution and low-level action trajectory generation within the Action Model, creating a structural bottleneck while weakening the predictive capability of world evolution modeling for action generation. We propose PILOT (Physical Inference for Latent Optimized Trajectories), whose core Representational Deduction (RD) bridges this gap by integrating motion chain-of-thought (CoT) guidance as a native model capability. Specifically, RD aims to encourage the action branch to explicitly model potential state transition tokens, which are retained as CoT in the reasoning space to guide fine-grained motion trajectory. Experiments demonstrate that RD not only improves the success rate and generalization ability of WAMs in complex robotic manipulation tasks but also enhances the model's physical interpretability by decoupling high-level motion semantics from low-level trajectory details. Furthermore, the abundant state transition supervision signals introduced by RD effectively alleviate the sparse supervision in action generation, supporting data-efficient real-robot adaptation with reduced demonstration sets.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAMs）旨在构建一个能够理解世界状态演化并指导行动生成的统一架构。然而，现有的视觉分支侧重于预测静态视觉观察，而非反映能够捕捉运动交互下世界状态演化的潜在转移信息。这导致了行动模型中高层物理状态演化与低层动作轨迹生成之间的表征纠缠，形成了结构性瓶颈，同时削弱了世界演化建模对行动生成的预测能力。我们提出了PILOT（面向潜在优化轨迹的物理推理），其核心的表征演绎（RD）机制通过将运动思维链（CoT）指导作为模型的原生能力来弥合这一差距。具体而言，RD旨在鼓励行动分支显式建模潜在状态转移标记，这些标记作为CoT保留在推理空间中，以指导细粒度的运动轨迹。实验表明，RD不仅提升了WAMs在复杂机器人操作任务中的成功率和泛化能力，还通过将高层运动语义与低层轨迹细节解耦，增强了模型的物理可解释性。此外，RD引入的丰富状态转移监督信号有效缓解了行动生成中的稀疏监督问题，支持在减少示范集的情况下实现数据高效的现实机器人自适应。

Authors: Xiangkai Ma, Xinyi Wang, Junjie Wang, Sheng Xu, Mingyang Li, Yue Ma, Han Zhang, Yuzheng Zhuang, Wenzhong Li, Zhihao Yuan

Roboclock: A Unified Benchmark for Time-Aware Robotic Intelligence Manipulation

time-aware benchmark temporal constraints robotic manipulation latency-aligned evaluation VLA evaluation

简要说明：RoboClock 提出了一个面向时间感知机器人操作的综合基准，涵盖60个受时间约束的任务，并评估了30多种方法，发现即使最强的 VLA 模型也仅达到8.3%的时间成功率，揭示了当前机器人系统的关键局限。

TLDR: RoboClock introduces a unified benchmark for time-aware robotic manipulation, evaluating over 30 methods across 60 temporally constrained tasks and finding that even the best VLA only achieves 8.3% temporal success, highlighting critical limitations in current robotic systems.

Abstract: Time is a fundamental dimension of robotic intelligence: a robot may fail despite physically correct actions if it acts outside a valid time window, responds too slowly to an event, or fails to meet required throughput. Yet existing robotic benchmarks primarily emphasize spatial correctness and logical task completion, largely overlooking the temporal constraints of real-world applications. We present RoboClock, a unified benchmark for time-aware robotic manipulation featuring 60 tasks across five application domains. Mirroring these failure modes, RoboClock structures tasks around three types of temporal constraints: Temporal Window, Event-Reactive, and Throughput. Furthermore, RoboClock incorporates a Latency-Aligned evaluation protocol that continuously advances environment time during model inference and control-interface delays, paired with time-sensitive metrics. Evaluating over 30 methods, we find that the best-performing approach is the trained VLA, yet it achieves only 8.3% temporal success even on Easy-level tasks, with persistent challenges in generalization and transfer. These findings reveal fundamental limitations in current robotic systems and highlight the need to jointly optimize physical competence, temporal reasoning, and execution latency.

摘要（中文）：时间是机器人智能的一个基本维度：即使机器人在物理动作上完全正确，如果它在有效时间窗口之外行动、对事件响应过慢或未能达到所需的吞吐量，仍然可能失败。然而，现有的机器人基准测试主要强调空间正确性和逻辑任务完成，在很大程度上忽视了实际应用中的时间约束。我们提出了RoboClock，一个面向时间感知机器人操作的统一基准测试，涵盖五个应用领域的60项任务。对应于上述失败模式，RoboClock围绕三类时间约束组织任务：时间窗口、事件响应和吞吐量。此外，RoboClock引入了一种延迟对齐的评估协议，该协议在模型推理和控制系统接口延迟期间持续推进环境时间，并配套使用时间敏感型指标。在对30多种方法进行评估后，我们发现表现最佳的方法是经过训练的视觉-语言-动作模型，但即使是在简单级别任务上，其时间成功率也仅为8.3%，且在泛化和迁移方面仍面临持续挑战。这些发现揭示了当前机器人系统的根本性局限，并凸显了联合优化物理能力、时间推理和执行延迟的必要性。

Authors: Yujie Zhao, Anthony L. Hu, Zimeng Huang, Zhijing Wu, Luobin Wang, Richard Li, Shrivas Sudharsan, Henrik I. Christensen, Jishen Zhao

OVOK: A Recursive Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Video-Based Articulated Robot State Estimation Perception3D

articulated robot state estimation agentic framework self-improving video-based state estimation

简要说明：OVOK 是一个递归自改进的代理框架，通过协同进化工具和工作流来从视频中估计铰接机器人状态，在 DREAM-V 和 RoboKeyGen-V 基准上取得了最先进的结果。

TLDR: OVOK is a recursive self-improving agentic framework that jointly evolves tools and workflows to estimate articulated robot state from video, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on DREAM-V and RoboKeyGen-V benchmarks.

Abstract: Recovering articulated robot state from video supports metric spatial sensing for manipulation, scene reconstruction, and action planning. Yet the problem is ill-posed: different intrinsics, camera-to-robot poses, and joint angles can explain similar observations. Prior task-specific regressors typically assume known intrinsics, fit one robot through laborious data collection and robot-specific training, and still transfer poorly across scenes. Foundation models apply to any robot zero-shot, but their estimates have large errors. We present OVOK (One Video to Kinetics), a recursive self-improving agentic framework for this task. Under a human-authored protocol, an agentic initializer constructs robot-specific OVOK-4k; a proposer--executor--verifier loop then jointly evolves tools and executable workflows from feedback. Updated tools and workflows are accepted only when the verifier judges a positive improvement. The retained workflow is frozen for accurate inference. Experiments demonstrate that the evolved workflow achieves state-of-the-art results on DREAM-V and RoboKeyGen-V, delivering robust and accurate estimates.

摘要（中文）：从视频中恢复关节型机器人的状态，有助于实现对操作、场景重建和动作规划的度量级空间感知。然而，该问题具有不适定性：不同的内参、相机与机器人之间的位姿以及关节角度，可能解释相似的观测结果。先前的任务特定回归器通常假设内参已知，需要通过繁琐的数据采集和针对特定机器人的训练来适配单一机器人，且在不同场景间的泛化能力较差。基础模型可以零样本应用于任意机器人，但其估计误差较大。我们提出了OVOK（One Video to Kinetics），一种用于该任务的递归自改进智能体框架。在人类编写的协议指导下，一个智能体初始化器构建面向特定机器人的OVOK-4k；随后，一个“提议-执行-验证”循环在反馈驱动下联合演进工具与可执行工作流。仅当验证器判定改进为正向时，更新的工具与工作流才被采纳。保留的工作流将被冻结以用于精确推理。实验表明，演进后的工作流在DREAM-V和RoboKeyGen-V上达到了最先进的结果，提供稳健且精确的估计。

CALVIN-MAX: When Does a Mid-Execution Change Hurt a Robot Policy? Manipulation

robot policy robustness mid-execution changes CALVIN benchmark policy evaluation embodied manipulation

简要说明：该论文提出了CALVIN-MAX基准，包含7,828个在CALVIN上的中途变更案例（对象、相机、机器人或指令），并衡量了变更时机和变更后成本对十种机器人策略的影响。

TLDR: This paper introduces CALVIN-MAX, a benchmark of 7,828 cases with mid-execution changes to objects, camera, robot, or instruction on CALVIN, and measures the impact of change timing and post-change costs across ten robot policies.

Abstract: Robots must often keep working after the world changes, as when a block moves or the camera shifts while the robot still acts on what it saw before. Recent work showed that one change during a task lowers success for every policy tested, but did not separate the effect of its timing from the cost of the changed world, or measure what it costs afterwards. We introduce CALVIN-MAX, a benchmark of 7,828 cases on CALVIN's five-instruction chains, each with one change to the objects, the camera, the robot, or the instruction. Each case compares three runs that are identical until the affected instruction begins: one without the change, one with it in place from that moment, and one in which it arrives while the robot is moving. The second run against the first gives the cost of the changed world, and the third against the second the effect of meeting it mid-motion. On 1,526 held-out cases per policy, with hypotheses fixed in advance, each of ten released policies loses 4.4 to 9.9 percentage points on the affected instruction over the eight core changes. Whether timing matters depends on the change: one that alters what the robot sees costs 5.4 points less mid-motion than from the start, whereas a change to the scene itself or to the robot shows no detectable effect. Rewinding the robot to the start of the instruction removes the benefit for every policy; the stricter test we fixed in advance, that the rewound run then matches the second run, passes for three. The cost also outlasts the affected instruction: the change stays in place, and a policy that still completes that instruction is 5.0 to 16.8 points less likely to complete the next one.

摘要（中文）：机器人必须在世界发生变化后继续工作，例如当一个方块移动或相机移位时，机器人仍然基于之前的观察采取行动。近期研究显示，任务过程中的一次变化会降低所有被测试策略的成功率，但该研究未将变化发生的时间点与变化后世界本身的代价区分开来，也未衡量变化之后所带来的影响。我们引入了CALVIN-MAX，一个包含7，828个案例的基准测试，基于CALVIN的五指令链，每个案例涉及对物体、相机、机器人或指令的一次变化。每个案例对比三种运行方式，这三种方式在受影响指令开始前完全相同：一种无变化，一种从该时刻起变化已生效，另一种是变化在机器人运动过程中出现。第二种运行与第一种运行对比，得出变化后世界本身的代价；第三种运行与第二种运行对比，得出机器人在运动中途遇到变化的影响。在每种策略的1，526个保留案例上，预先设定假设，十个已发布的策略在八个核心变化中，受影响指令上的成功率下降了4.4到9.9个百分点。时间点是否重要取决于变化的类型：改变机器人所见内容的变化，在运动中途出现比从一开始就存在少损失5.4个百分点，而场景本身或机器人的变化则未显示出可检测的影响。将机器人倒回到指令开始处会消除所有策略的上述优势；我们预先设定的更严格测试，即倒回后的运行需与第二种运行一致，结果只有三种策略通过。该代价还会延续到受影响指令之后：变化持续存在，且仍能完成该指令的策略，完成下一条指令的可能性会降低5.0到16.8个百分点。

Authors: Sajjad Pakdamansavoji

BendGS: Observation-Conditioned Gaussian Self-Modeling for Continuum Robots Manipulation

3D Gaussian self-model continuum robots virtual backbone command-conditioned deformation next-state prediction

简要说明：BendGS 提出了一种用于连续体机器人的高斯自模型，通过从观测中估计虚拟骨架来驱动命令条件下的变形，从而在无需关节角度标签的情况下，从多视图图像预测下一个三维形状、外观和末端姿态。

TLDR: BendGS introduces a Gaussian self-model for continuum robots that estimates a virtual backbone from observations to drive command-conditioned deformation, predicting the next 3D shape, appearance, and tip pose from multi-view images without joint angle labels.

Abstract: Visual self-models learn from images how a robot moves under motor commands. Continuum robots need them even more, as they bend continuously without measured joint angles or fixed link geometry. Existing continuum self-models predict point clouds, image-space curves, or future images, but not the next 3D shape, appearance, and tip pose together from an observed body. 3D Gaussians offer a renderable representation of shape and appearance, yet articulated Gaussian self-models rely on joint angles to drive deformation. In this work, we propose BendGS, which uses a virtual backbone estimated from observation to drive command-conditioned Gaussian deformation, enabling next-state prediction for continuum robots without measured joint angles. In Gaussian modeling, a feed-forward network reconstructs the robot as 3D Gaussians from multi-view images, and the backbone, a chain of coordinate frames, is fitted to back-projected depth points to estimate the bending state. In transition, a network predicts its change under a relative motor command to deform the bound Gaussians. The deformed Gaussians render the next images and the 3D shape, and the distal frame gives the tip pose. Training losses use RGB-D images and masks, without bending or tip labels. On simulated and real robots, BendGS achieves the lowest Chamfer distance, best image quality, and lowest tip errors among the compared methods.

摘要（中文）：视觉自模型通过图像学习机器人在电机指令下的运动方式。连续体机器人对此类模型的需求更为迫切，因为它们在无测量关节角度或固定连杆几何的情况下连续弯曲。现有连续体自模型可预测点云、图像空间曲线或未来图像，但无法同时从观测到的机体预测下一个三维形状、外观和末端姿态。三维高斯提供了一种可渲染的形状与外观表示，然而铰接式高斯自模型依赖关节角度驱动形变。在本工作中，我们提出BendGS，它利用从观测中估计的虚拟骨架来驱动指令条件化的高斯形变，从而实现在无测量关节角度情况下对连续体机器人的下一状态预测。在高斯建模中，前馈网络从多视角图像中将机器人重建为三维高斯，骨架作为坐标系链，拟合至反投影深度点以估计弯曲状态。在状态转移中，网络预测其在相对电机指令下的变化，以形变绑定的高斯。形变后的高斯渲染出下一图像和三维形状，末端坐标系给出末端姿态。训练损失使用RGB-D图像和掩膜，无需弯曲或末端标签。在仿真和真实机器人上，BendGS在对比方法中取得了最低的Chamfer距离、最佳的图像质量和最低的末端误差。

Authors: Jeong Woon Lee, Doungjun Kim, Namho Kim, Seungheon Chae, Jongwoo Kim, Hyoseok Hwang

VG-GP: Uncertainty-Gated Visuo-Geometric Memory for Negative-Transfer-Resistant Grasp Adaptation Manipulation

grasp adaptation Gaussian Process closed-loop SE(2) negative transfer visuo-geometric memory

简要说明：VG-GP 提出了一个即插即用的视觉-几何高斯过程记忆框架，用于在闭环 SE(2) 残差抓取迁移中适配预训练的对掌抓取策略，并在仿真中显著提升了抓取成功率且无回退。

TLDR: VG-GP introduces a plug-and-play visuo-geometric Gaussian Process memory framework that adapts pretrained antipodal grasping policies to novel objects in closed-loop SE(2) residual grasp transfer, demonstrating significant lift-rate improvements in simulation with zero regressions.

Abstract: Pretrained antipodal grasping networks generalize well to canonical shapes but frequently fail zero-shot on novel objects with irregular mass distributions, thin rims, or unfamiliar handles. While episodic experience memory adapts a frozen base policy without retraining, naive retrieval suffers from visual appearance bias, negative transfer from overriding working base grasps, and degenerate closed-loop acquisition. We present VG-GP, a plug-and-play Visuo-Geometric Gaussian Process memory framework for closed-loop $SE(2)$ residual grasp transfer. First, we fuse color-invariant surface-normal DINOv2 features, canonical $SE(2)$ gripper-aligned 3D local heightmaps, and contact-geometry descriptors under a product kernel with Automatic Relevance Determination (ARD) lengthscales learned strictly on source objects. Second, we model the joint posterior over the base grasp and candidate $SE(2)$ alternatives, overriding the base policy only when the joint-covariance Lower Confidence Bound (LCB) clears a risk-sensitive threshold. Third, an online counterfactual curation gate using single-record necessity and sufficiency interventions quarantines source experiences causing negative transfer. Fourth, we close the acquisition loop via Bayesian Expected Improvement (EI) over equal-budget $SE(2)$ probes. Across 42 disjoint YCB objects in ManiSkill3 (20 source, 12 development, 10 held-out test), VG-GP wraps a pretrained GR-ConvNet base policy and raises physical lift rate across all 22 unseen objects from 38.6% (34/88) to 53.4% (47/88) with zero regressions (+13 rescues, 0 losses; object-clustered 95% CI [+6.8%, +22.7%], exact McNemar $p = 0.00024$). On the 10 held-out objects, EI active acquisition reaches 45.0% (18/40 vs. 32.5% base, 5/7 of oracle headroom), achieves 55.0% probe divergence over passive fallback, and monotonically reduces epistemic uncertainty.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 预训练的对掌抓取网络在典型形状上具有良好的泛化能力，但在面对质量分布不规则、薄边缘或不熟悉把手的新型物体时，零样本抓取常常失败。尽管情节经验记忆可以在不重新训练的情况下适配冻结的基础策略，但朴素检索存在视觉外观偏差、覆盖有效基础抓取导致的负迁移以及闭环采集退化等问题。我们提出VG-GP，一种即插即用的视觉-几何高斯过程记忆框架，用于闭环$SE(2)$残差抓取迁移。首先，我们在乘积核下融合颜色不变的表面法向DINOv2特征、规范的$SE(2)$夹爪对齐三维局部高度图及接触几何描述符，并采用仅在源物体上学习的自动相关性确定（ARD）长度尺度。其次，我们对基础抓取与候选$SE(2)$替代方案的联合后验进行建模，仅当联合协方差下置信界（LCB）超过风险敏感阈值时才覆盖基础策略。第三，在线反事实筛选门控利用单记录必要性与充分性干预，隔离导致负迁移的源经验。第四，我们通过等预算$SE(2)$探测的贝叶斯期望改进（EI）闭环采集过程。在ManiSkill3中42个不相交的YCB物体上（20个源物体、12个开发物体、10个保留测试物体），VG-GP包装预训练的GR-ConvNet基础策略，将全部22个未见物体的物理提升率从38.6%（34/88）提升至53.4%（47/88），且无任何回退（+13次成功救援，0次损失；物体聚类95%置信区间[+6.8%，+22.7%]，精确McNemar检验$p = 0.00024$）。在10个保留测试物体上，EI主动采集达到45.0%（18/40，对比基础策略的32.5%，占理想性能余量的5/7），相较于被动回退实现55.0%的探测发散率，并单调降低认知不确定性。

Authors: Yonglong Zhang

CATWAY: Cost-sensitive agentic three-way robot decisions with calibrated language-model confidence VLA

cost-sensitive decision three-way decision gate calibrated confidence robot instructions loss matrix

简要说明：CATWAY 提出了一种成本敏感的三向决策门控机制，用于语言模型机器人代理，从损失矩阵和校准概率中推导出执行/询问/拒绝的阈值，并在多个领域中展示了成本效益的改进。

TLDR: CATWAY proposes a cost-sensitive three-way decision gate for language-model robot agents, deriving execute/ask/refuse thresholds from a loss matrix and calibrated probabilities, and shows improved cost-effectiveness across multiple domains.

Abstract: A language-model robot agent must decide whether to execute, question or refuse an instruction, and an unsafe execution costs far more than an unneeded question. No prior robot gate derives all its thresholds from error costs or acts on calibrated probabilities, and none was fitted in one domain and evaluated unchanged in another. We propose CATWAY, a cost-sensitive three-way decision gate: a loss matrix over four instruction conditions (clear, ambiguous, infeasible, unsafe) fixes execute, ask and refuse regions on the probability simplex, the question being the information-gathering step. Its probabilities fuse a ten-sample vote with graded scores of ambiguity, infeasibility and risk by logistic regression. Fitted on household instructions and frozen, CATWAY was tested on text-level decisions of three small models in-domain, in two new robot domains and on the external TRUST-NAV benchmark. At eleven generations per decision against one, it was significantly cheaper than a direct prompt, a cost-aware prompt and an unguarded agent in all 18 household comparisons (mean loss per item 0.28 against 0.57-0.83), in 9 of 18 in the new domains and in 10 of 18 on TRUST-NAV (Holm per set), and never significantly costlier. It executed none of the 142 unsafe test instructions. On a unanimous vote, the minimum-expected-loss rule reduces calibration to one loss-derived threshold, so for two of six model configurations a gate on the vote alone never executed a clear instruction, costing 0.49 per item on TRUST-NAV against CATWAY's 0.13 and 0.09; the fused estimate avoided this on every set.

摘要（中文）：语言模型机器人智能体必须决定是执行、质疑还是拒绝一条指令，而不安全执行的代价远高于不必要的质疑。此前的机器人门控机制没有一种是从错误代价中推导出所有阈值的，也没有一种基于校准概率运行，更没有一种在某一领域完成拟合后，未经修改便能在另一领域进行评估。我们提出了CATWAY，一种代价敏感的三向决策门控机制：一个覆盖四种指令情形（清晰、模糊、不可行、不安全）的损失矩阵，在概率单纯形上划定执行、质疑和拒绝区域，其中质疑是信息收集步骤。其概率融合了十次样本投票与逻辑回归对模糊性、不可行性和风险的分级评分。CATWAY在家庭指令上完成拟合后被冻结，并在三个小模型的文本级决策任务中进行了域内测试，同时应用于两个新的机器人领域以及外部TRUST-NAV基准测试。在每次决策生成十一次而非一次的条件下，CATWAY在所有18项家庭指令比较中显著优于直接提示、代价感知提示和无防护智能体（每项平均损失为0.28，对比0.57至0.83），在新领域的18项比较中9项胜出，在TRUST-NAV上18项中10项胜出（每组采用Holm校正），且从未在统计上显著更差。它未执行142条不安全测试指令中的任何一条。在一致投票情况下，最小期望损失规则将校准简化为一个由损失推导出的阈值，因此在六种模型配置中，有两种仅依赖投票的门控机制从未执行过清晰指令，在TRUST-NAV上每项损失为0.49，而CATWAY分别为0.13和0.09；融合估计在每一组上都避免了这一问题。

Authors: Erik Derner

Exteroceptive Sensor Faults in Autonomous Vehicles: A Cross-Modal Taxonomy and Fault Injection Toolkit AutonomousDriving

sensor faults fault injection autonomous vehicles taxonomy safety validation

简要说明：本文提出了自动驾驶汽车外部传感器故障的跨模态分类法，并发布了一个包含94个例程的开源故障注入工具包，以支持感知系统的安全验证和基准测试。

TLDR: This paper proposes a cross-modal taxonomy of exteroceptive sensor faults in autonomous vehicles and releases an open-source fault injection toolkit with 94 routines to support safety validation and benchmarking of perception systems.

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles rely on cameras, LiDAR, and radar to perceive their surroundings, yet these exteroceptive sensors can be degraded by hardware aging, environmental interference, miscalibration, embedded software errors, and combinations of these causes, with direct consequences for perception quality and safety. Existing surveys and benchmarks mostly address individual sensors, isolated conditions, or vehicle-level consequences, and no common vocabulary relates fault origins across the three modalities. This paper reviews the literature on exteroceptive sensor faults and proposes a cross-modal, origin-driven taxonomy that organizes them into five categories, namely hardware, environmental, calibration, software, and synergistic faults, mapping each entry to its physical or logical mechanism, observable manifestation, and affected subsystem, and relating the categories to the safety analyses of ISO 26262 and ISO 21448. To make the taxonomy operational, we release an open-source fault injection toolkit with 94 symptom-level routines (41 camera, 27 LiDAR, and 26 radar), four graded severity levels, reproducible burst scheduling, and per-frame labels recording the fault category, affected subsystem, and severity. Examples on the Boreas dataset illustrate how each category alters camera images, LiDAR point clouds, and radar scans. Together, the taxonomy and the toolkit provide a shared reference and a controlled testbed for studying sensor reliability, developing and benchmarking fault detection and diagnosis methods, and building fault-annotated datasets for the safety validation of perception systems. The toolkit is publicly available at https://github.com/davidepossenti/AV-SensorFault-Toolkit.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶汽车依赖摄像头、激光雷达和雷达来感知周围环境，然而这些外部感知传感器可能因硬件老化、环境干扰、标定误差、嵌入式软件错误以及上述因素的组合而性能退化，直接影响感知质量与安全性。现有综述和基准研究大多针对单一传感器、孤立条件或整车层面的后果展开，尚未形成一种通用术语体系来跨三种传感器模态关联故障成因。本文回顾了有关外部感知传感器故障的文献，并提出了一种跨模态、以原因为导向的分类体系，将其归纳为五类，即硬件类、环境类、标定类、软件类和协同类故障，同时将每一类映射至其物理或逻辑机理、可观测表现及受影响的子系统，并将各分类与ISO 26262和ISO 21448的安全分析相关联。为使该分类体系具备可操作性，我们发布了一套开源故障注入工具包，内含94个症状级程序（其中摄像头41个、激光雷达27个、雷达26个）、四个分级严重度等级、可复现的突发调度机制，以及逐帧标签用于记录故障类别、受影响子系统和严重程度。在Boreas数据集上的示例展示了每类故障如何改变摄像头图像、激光雷达点云和雷达扫描数据。综合而言，该分类体系和工具包为研究传感器可靠性、开发和评估故障检测与诊断方法，以及构建用于感知系统安全验证的故障标注数据集，提供了共同的参考框架和受控测试平台。该工具包公开获取地址为：https://github.com/davidepossenti/AV-SensorFault-Toolkit。

Authors: Davide Possenti, Daniele Cianca, Stefano Arrigoni, Francesco Braghini

Collision Rendering: GPU-Accelerated Trajectory Planning on Sparse Voxel Radiance Fields with Risk-Bounded Collision Checking Perception3D

sparse voxel radiance fields collision checking trajectory planning GPU-accelerated

简要说明：本文提出了碰撞渲染框架，利用稀疏体素辐射场实现GPU加速、风险有界的碰撞检测，从而实现快速且无碰撞的机器人轨迹规划。

TLDR: The paper introduces Collision Rendering, a GPU-accelerated trajectory planning framework that leverages sparse voxel radiance fields for risk-bounded collision checking, enabling fast and collision-free robot motion planning.

Abstract: Although radiance fields provide detailed scene representations for robotics, they remain underexplored for trajectory planning, without a widely agreed-upon way to translate learned spatial primitives into reliable collision criteria. To bridge this gap, we introduce Collision Rendering, the first trajectory planning framework on sparse voxel radiance fields (SVR), which supports GPU-accelerated, risk-bounded collision checking and a differentiable collision cost. Our key insight is that the structured volumetric density of SVR allows its rendering pipeline to serve as a fast numerical approximator of collision probability. We approximate the robot with collision spheres and place a coinciding spherical camera at each sphere. Under a probabilistic collision model, we derive an upper bound on each sphere's maximum directional collision probability from the camera's rendering pipeline. Evaluating this bound on the GPU yields a modular collision checker that integrates with established sampling-based planners without an auxiliary geometric map or changes to the learned representation. We further compute a collision cost and its gradients from rendered opacities through the same pipeline, extending the framework to trajectory optimization. Experiments demonstrate millisecond collision checking time on a consumer-grade GPU and collision-free trajectories in all queries, outperforming other radiance field-based planners.

摘要（中文）：虽然辐射场为机器人技术提供了详细的场景表示，但在轨迹规划中的应用仍未充分探索，缺乏一种广泛认可的方法来将学习到的空间基元转化为可靠的碰撞判据。为弥合这一空白，我们提出了碰撞渲染（Collision Rendering），这是首个基于稀疏体素辐射场（SVR）的轨迹规划框架，支持GPU加速、风险有界的碰撞检测以及可微碰撞代价。我们的关键洞察在于，SVR的结构化体积密度使其渲染管线能够作为碰撞概率的快速数值近似器。我们用碰撞球体近似表示机器人，并在每个球体位置放置一个重合的球形相机。在概率性碰撞模型下，我们从相机的渲染管线推导出每个球体最大方向碰撞概率的上界。在GPU上评估该上界，可得到一个模块化的碰撞检测器，能够与基于采样的既有规划器集成，而无需辅助几何地图或修改已学习的表示。我们还通过同一管线从渲染的不透明度计算碰撞代价及其梯度，从而将框架扩展到轨迹优化。实验表明，在消费级GPU上可实现毫秒级碰撞检测时间，且所有查询均生成无碰撞轨迹，性能优于其他基于辐射场的规划器。

Authors: Byoungkwon Yoon, Han Gyeom Lee, Hojun Lee, Yuseop Sim, Daniel Sungwoo Bae, Martin Byung-Guk Jun

Embodied Neuro-symbolic AI: Making Robot Behavior Auditable, Safe, and Scalable VLA

neuro-symbolic AI VLA constraint-aware planning auditability safety constraints

简要说明：本文提出一种具身神经符号AI范式，将学习感知、规划与控制同显式、机器可读的背景知识和形式化约束相结合，以提升机器人部署的可审计性、安全性和可扩展性，解决VLA模型的脆弱性和合规机制缺乏问题。

TLDR: This paper proposes an embodied neuro-symbolic AI paradigm that integrates learned perception, planning, and control with explicit, machine-readable knowledge and formal constraints to improve the auditability, safety, and scalability of robot deployment, addressing VLA models' brittleness and lack of compliance mechanisms.

Abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) end-to-end systems have driven major progress in robot learning, yet they still face persistent barriers to dependable real-world deployment. In practice, these models often exhibit brittle generalization under distribution shift (i.e., novel objects, layouts, lighting, or contact conditions), limited physical and causal reasoning, and inconsistent fine-grained motor control. Critically, many VLA pipelines offer limited ways to express and audit what a robot must not do, making it difficult to provide assurance in safety-critical settings. These limitations constrain scalability, maintainability, and trust when robots move beyond controlled demonstrations. We propose Embodied Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) AI: a deployment-oriented paradigm that integrates learned perception, planning and control with explicit, machine-readable background knowledge and formal constraints. By combining knowledge-guided perception, constraint-aware symbolic planning, and hybrid learning, Embodied NeSy AI enables robots to reason about their environment, adapt to new tasks, and provide auditable, machine-checkable compliance with safety and operational requirements, thus supporting scalable, trustworthy robot deployment.

摘要（中文）：当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）端到端系统推动了机器人学习的重大进展，但在实际部署中仍面临持续性障碍。在实践中，这些模型在分布偏移（即新物体、布局、光照或接触条件）下往往表现出脆弱的泛化能力，物理与因果推理能力有限，且细粒度电机控制不一致。关键问题是，许多VLA流程在表达和审计机器人“不可为”的行为方面手段有限，这使得在安全关键环境中提供保障变得困难。这些局限限制了机器人超越受控演示场景后的可扩展性、可维护性和可信度。我们提出具身神经符号（NeSy）人工智能：一种面向部署的范式，将学习感知、规划与控制同显式、机器可读的背景知识和形式化约束相结合。通过融合知识引导的感知、约束感知的符号规划以及混合学习，具身NeSy AI使机器人能够推理其环境、适应新任务，并提供可审计、机器可核查的安全与操作合规性，从而支持可扩展、可信赖的机器人部署。

Authors: Ruwan Wickramarachchi, Jonathan Francis, Alessandro Oltramari

Learning from Human Corrections through Temporal Preferences RLRobot

learning from corrections temporal preferences value functions goal inference correction forecasting

简要说明：该论文提出通过从干预后的纠正行为和干预前的时间关系中构建偏好对来从人类纠正反馈中学习价值函数，并证明结合两种信息源能改进目标推断和纠正预测。

TLDR: This paper proposes learning value functions from human corrective feedback by constructing preference pairs from both post-intervention corrected behavior and pre-intervention temporal relationships, showing that combining both sources improves goal inference and correction forecasting.

Abstract: When people intervene to correct a robot, they provide information not only through how they correct its behavior, but also through when they choose to intervene. Existing approaches to Learning from Corrections focus on comparing the new trajectory to the robot's originally intended behavior, thus underutilizing the context of the robot's behavior before the intervention. In this work, we investigate how both pre- and post-intervention behavior can be translated into preference pairs for learning value functions that approximate a human's latent reward. We construct post-intervention preferences by comparing corrected behavior with the behavior it replaces, and pre-intervention preferences from temporal relationships among states leading up to an intervention. We evaluate the learned value representations through two downstream tasks: goal inference and correction forecasting. Our results show that post-intervention preferences are particularly effective for goal inference, while pre-intervention preferences provide strong correction-forecasting performance. Combining both sources of information performs strongly across both tasks, even when generalizing to participants unseen during training. These findings demonstrate that both when and how humans correct provide complementary information for learning value representations from corrective interactions.

摘要（中文）：当人们介入纠正机器人时，他们不仅通过如何纠正其行为提供信息，还通过选择介入的时机传达信息。现有的“从纠正中学习”方法侧重于将新轨迹与机器人原本意图的行为进行比较，从而未能充分利用介入前机器人行为的背景信息。在本研究中，我们探讨了如何将介入前和介入后的行为转化为偏好对，以学习逼近人类潜在奖励的价值函数。我们通过将纠正后的行为与它所替代的行为进行比较来构建介入后偏好，并根据导致介入的状态间的时间关系构建介入前偏好。我们通过两个下游任务评估学到的价值表示：目标推断和纠正预测。结果表明，介入后偏好在目标推断方面尤其有效，而介入前偏好在纠正预测方面表现出色。将两种信息来源结合起来，在两项任务中均表现优异，即使泛化到训练中未见过的参与者时也是如此。这些发现表明，人类纠正的时机和方式为从纠正性交互中学习价值表示提供了互补的信息。

Authors: Anjiabei Wang, Tesca Fitzgerald

Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking WorldModel

motion-conditioned world modeling embodied visual tracking latent state transitions future visual feature reconstruction target motion prediction

简要说明：本文提出运动条件世界建模，将预测的目标运动分布和机器人自身运动融入潜在状态转移，通过未来视觉特征重建训练运动预测器和策略，用于具身视觉跟踪，在多个基准上提升了性能并增强了跨环境泛化能力。

TLDR: This paper proposes Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which integrates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent world model transitions, using future visual feature reconstruction to train the motion predictor and policy for embodied visual tracking, achieving improved performance and cross-environment generalization.

Abstract: World models support embodied decision-making by predicting future environment states. In embodied visual tracking, uncertain target motion and robot-induced viewpoint changes jointly affect visual observations, making future-state prediction challenging. We propose Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions. A Geometry--Progress module jointly models geometric paths and single-step travel distances through shared motion modes and path-conditioned progress distributions. This formulation captures uncertainty in route selection and motion progress while preserving their dependence. Action-induced coordinate transformations express predicted paths in the next robot frame, providing geometrically grounded conditions for future visual-state prediction. Future visual feature reconstruction supervises the motion predictor through the conditioned transition branch, linking explicit motion representations to subsequent observations. The model is jointly optimized with motion likelihood, feature reconstruction, and expert-action supervision, enabling the tracking policy to combine visual context with predictive motion cues.Experiments on three embodied tracking benchmarks demonstrate improved tracking performance and cross-environment generalization with a lightweight $0.5$B backbone.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过预测未来环境状态来支持具身决策。在具身视觉跟踪中，目标运动的不确定性以及机器人自身位姿变化共同影响视觉观测，使得未来状态预测具有挑战性。我们提出一种运动条件化世界建模方法，将预测的目标运动分布与机器人自身运动融入潜在状态转移中。几何-进度模块通过共享运动模式和路径条件化进度分布，联合建模几何路径与单步行进距离。该公式在保留路径选择与运动进度之间依赖关系的同时，捕捉其不确定性。动作引起的坐标变换将预测路径表达至下一机器人坐标系中，为未来视觉状态预测提供几何上有依据的条件。未来视觉特征重建通过条件化转移分支对运动预测器进行监督，将显式运动表征与后续观测联系起来。该模型联合优化运动似然、特征重建和专家动作监督，使跟踪策略能够融合视觉上下文与预测性运动线索。在三个具身跟踪基准上的实验表明，该模型在轻量级$0.5$B骨干网络下提升了跟踪性能与跨环境泛化能力。

Authors: Jiahao Zhang, Xuan Yao, Junyu Gao, Changsheng Xu

Learning World Models through Contrastive Identification of Actions WorldModel

latent world models inverse dynamics contrastive learning visual control goal-directed planning

简要说明：本文提出对比动作识别（CIA），通过让潜在世界模型识别执行的动作来提升目标导向规划，在不修改规划器的情况下，在多个视觉控制基准上取得了更高的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), a method for improving latent world models by training them to identify the executed action among alternatives, which enhances goal-directed planning and achieves higher success rates across visual control benchmarks without modifying the planner.

Abstract: Latent world models enable goal-directed planning from offline visual data, but prediction alone does not specify which action-related distinctions their representations should preserve. Inverse dynamics provides auxiliary supervision, yet squared-error action regression rewards additional information only through changes in the conditional action mean. We propose Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), which identifies the executed action among alternatives sampled from a history-conditioned behavior proposal. Comparing actions plausible in the same context targets information supplied by the next latent beyond history. Under exact behavior matching, we show that CIA can reward action information that leaves optimal inverse-regression error unchanged, and verify this distinction through a controlled learning example. CIA achieves higher planner-averaged mean success than the base world model and a regression inverse-dynamics baseline across five visual control benchmarks, without modifying the planner.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型能够从离线视觉数据中实现目标导向的规划，但仅靠预测并不足以明确其表示应保留哪些与动作相关的区分信息。逆动力学提供了辅助监督，然而平方误差动作回归仅通过条件动作均值的变化来奖励额外信息。我们提出对比动作识别方法（CIA），该方法在基于历史条件的动作提案所采样的候选中识别实际执行的动作。在同一情境下比较可能合理的动作，可以针对下一隐状态相对于历史所提供的额外信息进行优化。在精确行为匹配的条件下，我们证明CIA能够奖励那些在最优逆回归误差不变的情况下仍提供动作信息的内容，并通过一个受控学习实例验证了这一区别。在不修改规划器的情况下，CIA在五个视觉控制基准上相较于基础世界模型和回归逆动力学基线，实现了更高的规划器平均成功率。

Authors: Hayeong Lee, Youngjun Suh, Byung-Jun Lee

EviCraft: Can Minecraft Agents Find What They Cannot See? Other

evidence closure Minecraft embodied agents perception-grounded benchmark

简要说明：EviCraft 是一个在 Minecraft 智能体中强制证据封闭性的运行时和基准，表明标准的加载状态工具会显著虚高任务成功率，而仅移除可见性检查或在工具中加载状态并不能弥合差距。它形式化并衡量了体内决策中智能体可见证据的作用。

TLDR: EviCraft is a runtime and benchmark that enforces evidence closure in Minecraft agents, showing that standard loaded-state tools significantly inflate task success scores compared to perception-grounded decision-making, and that removing only visibility checks or loading state in tools does not close the gap. It formalizes and measures the role of agent-visible evidence in embodied decision-making within a common testbed.

Abstract: In Minecraft, a common testbed for embodied agents, semantic tools such as mineBlock pick targets from the simulator's loaded world state without a visibility test, so a buried ore the agent has never seen is one call away, and scores cannot show whether the agent searched. We formalize the missing requirement as evidence closure: every decision of an agent system, including those inside its tools, may depend on the world only through facts for which the agent holds evidence. EviCraft is a runtime and benchmark that enforces closure below the agent and makes the admission rule an experimental variable: a perception-grounded regime (G) admits only what is in line of sight or returned by the agent's own actions, and a loaded-state regime (L) reproduces standard tool stacks, with agents, tools, and worlds held fixed. On Survival, the regime effect exceeds the strongest agent's lead: under G, three mid-sized agents reach the diamond in 32%-40% of runs, against 76%-94% under L, and the strongest agent under G scores below each of them under L. In two models, removing only the line-of-sight test closes 93%-96% of the score gap, and loading state only inside tools recovers 70%-98%, so safeguards on observations and queries leave most of the leak open. In open-ended acquisition, the gain from L concentrates in items that depend on buried resources or mobs. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/AllenReder/EviCraft

摘要（中文）：在Minecraft这一具身智能体常用测试平台中，语义工具（如mineBlock）直接从模拟器加载的世界状态中选取目标，而不进行可见性检测，因此智能体从未见过的埋藏矿石也能被一步获取，评分无法反映智能体是否进行了搜索。我们将这一缺失的要求形式化为证据封闭性：智能体系统的每一个决策，包括其工具内部的决策，只能通过智能体持有证据的事实来依赖世界。EviCraft是一个运行时与基准测试平台，在智能体之下强制实施封闭性，并将准入规则设为实验变量：基于感知的规则（G）仅允许视线内或由智能体自身行动返回的内容，而基于加载状态的规则（L）复现标准工具栈，同时保持智能体、工具和世界不变。在Survival任务中，规则效应超过了最强智能体的领先优势：在G规则下，三个中等规模的智能体在32%-40%的回合中到达钻石，而在L规则下为76%-94%，且G规则下最强的智能体得分低于L规则下每一个中等规模智能体。在两个模型中，仅移除视线检测就弥合了93%-96%的得分差距，而仅在工具内部加载状态则恢复了70%-98%的差距，这表明对观测和查询的防护措施仍留下了大部分泄漏。在开放式采集任务中，L规则带来的增益集中在依赖埋藏资源或生物的物品上。代码和基准测试平台见https://github.com/AllenReder/EviCraft。

Authors: Wenyou Yi, Lantian Zhang, Guanlin Chen, Xingqiu Xu, Haiyang Sun, Minrui Huang, Tianle Liang, Hao Chen, Haorui Xu, Zhou Zhao

Verify then Steer: Progress Hallucination-Aware Recovery for Continuous Vision-and-Language Navigation VLN

Vision-and-Language Navigation progress hallucination test-time recovery conformal calibration contextual bandit

简要说明：本文提出 PHAR，一种用于视觉-语言导航（VLN）的测试时恢复框架，通过验证 VLM 表示中的跨模态证据并利用上下文赌博机回退指令进度来应对‘进度幻觉’，在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上提升了导航成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces PHAR, a test-time recovery framework for Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) that addresses 'progress hallucination' by verifying cross-modal evidence in VLM representations and using a contextual bandit to rewind instruction progress for recovery, improving success rates on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to follow language instructions to reach a target in an unseen 3D environment. However, existing methods still struggle to recover from route deviations at test time. We investigate this limitation through the lens of instruction progress, and trace it to a phenomenon we term progress hallucination: agents misinterpret off-route observations as evidence of task progress, causing their internal instruction progress to advance beyond the actual task stage and hindering recovery based on earlier sub-instructions. To address this failure mode, we propose PHAR (Progress Hallucination-Aware Recovery), a test-time recovery framework following a verify-then-steer paradigm. The verifier examines residual-stream representations of the Vision-Language Model (VLM) to identify mismatch of cross-modal evidence along the trajectories, and uses split conformal calibration to control false alarms. When an alarm is raised, the steering module uses a contextual bandit to adaptively select the rewind extent of instruction progress for online recovery. Through extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, our framework enhances the reliability of multiple state-of-the-art vision-language navigation methods at test time.

摘要（中文）：视觉与语言导航（VLN）要求智能体依据语言指令在未见过的三维环境中到达目标位置。然而，现有方法在测试阶段遇到路线偏离时，仍难以有效恢复。我们通过指令进展的视角来探究这一局限，并将其追溯至一种我们称之为“进展幻觉”的现象：智能体将偏离路线的观测误判为任务进展的证据，导致其内部指令进展超前于实际任务阶段，从而阻碍了基于较早子指令的恢复。为解决这一失效模式，我们提出PHAR（进展幻觉感知恢复），一种遵循“先验证后引导”范式的测试时恢复框架。验证器检查视觉语言模型（VLM）的残差流表示，以识别轨迹中跨模态证据的不匹配，并采用分割共形校准来控制误报率。当触发警报时，引导模块利用上下文赌博机自适应地选择指令进展的回退程度，以实现在线恢复。通过在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的大量实验，我们的框架在测试时显著提升了多种最先进视觉语言导航方法的可靠性。

Authors: Jiewen Hou, Guanxiang Qi, Meina Kan, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen

DiffAnchor: Anchor-Space Diffusion for Monocular 3D Hand Pose Estimation Perception3D

3D hand pose estimation diffusion model anchor-space diffusion monocular perception efficient inference

简要说明：DiffAnchor 提出了一种少步锚空间扩散框架，用于单目 3D 手部姿态估计，其中扩散过程优化中间锚点而非最终关节，从而以单假设实现准确且高效的预测。

TLDR: DiffAnchor proposes a few-step anchor-space diffusion framework for monocular 3D hand pose estimation, where diffusion refines intermediate anchors instead of final joints, enabling accurate and efficient prediction with a single hypothesis.

Abstract: Accurate and efficient monocular 3D hand pose estimation is an important perception capability for embodied human interaction and dexterous manipulation. Recent diffusion-based methods model pose uncertainty by iteratively denoising 3D joint coordinates. However, directly diffusing the final joints requires the generative process to simultaneously explore plausible poses and recover precise coordinates, often relying on additional denoising steps or multiple hypotheses and consequently increasing inference cost. In this work, we propose DiffAnchor, a few-step anchor-space diffusion framework that diffuses anchors rather than joints. Our key insight is that stochastic exploration does not need to operate directly on the final output. Instead, diffusion searches for informative intermediate anchors that serve as local 3D regressors, while anchor-to-joint offset prediction and weighted aggregation complete precise joint localization. Specifically, fixed context anchors provide stable global references, whereas noisy dynamic anchors are iteratively refined toward informative joint regions. An importance-guided anchor selection and replenishment mechanism further retains useful anchors, removes ineffective ones, and explores insufficiently covered regions. This design reduces the precision burden of the diffusion process and enables accurate prediction using only a few denoising steps and a single hypothesis. Extensive experiments on HO-3D V2, NYU, ICVL, and InterHand2.6M demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the first three benchmarks and competitive performance on challenging interacting-hand estimation, while maintaining inference efficiency comparable to deterministic regression baselines.

摘要（中文）：摘要：准确高效的单目3D手部姿态估计是具身人机交互和灵巧操作中的重要感知能力。近年来，基于扩散的方法通过对3D关节坐标进行迭代去噪来建模姿态不确定性。然而，直接对最终关节进行扩散要求生成过程同时探索合理的姿态并恢复精确的坐标，通常依赖于额外的去噪步骤或多假设方案，从而增加了推理成本。在本工作中，我们提出了DiffAnchor，一种少步锚点空间扩散框架，该框架对锚点而非关节进行扩散。我们的关键洞察在于，随机探索无需直接作用于最终输出，而是通过扩散搜索信息丰富的中间锚点作为局部3D回归器，同时通过锚点到关节的偏移预测和加权聚合实现精确的关节定位。具体而言，固定上下文锚点提供稳定的全局参考，而带噪声的动态锚点通过迭代细化向信息丰富的关节区域收敛。此外，重要性引导的锚点选择与补充机制能够保留有效锚点、移除无效锚点，并探索覆盖不足的区域。该设计降低了扩散过程的精度负担，使得仅需少量去噪步骤和单一假设即可实现精确预测。在HO-3D V2、NYU、ICVL和InterHand2.6M上的大量实验表明，本方法在前三个基准上达到了最先进的性能，在具有挑战性的交互手估计任务上也表现出具有竞争力的性能，同时保持了与确定性回归基线相当的推理效率。

Authors: Changlong Jiang, Youci Tang, Haohong Kuang, Hang Xu, Jinghong Zheng, Ran Wang, Zhenghong Yu, Chen Feng, Xiaofeng Yue, Yang Xiao

OmniPersist: Persistent Dynamic World Modeling via Coupled Panoramic Evolution WorldModel

action-conditioned world models panoramic evolution dynamic object persistence video diffusion revisit consistency

简要说明：OmniPersist 提出一种单阶段扩散框架，将透视视频生成与低帧率全景演化耦合，以在相机返回时保持动态物体的持续性，提升重访一致性和动态持久性。

TLDR: OmniPersist proposes a single-stage diffusion framework coupling perspective video generation with lower-frame-rate panoramic evolution to maintain dynamic object persistence across camera re-visits, improving revisit consistency and dynamic persistence in action-conditioned world models.

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models play a vital role in robotics and autonomous driving, yet existing video diffusion models struggle to maintain dynamic object persistence. When the camera turns away and returns, out-of-view moving entities fail to evolve plausibly in latent space, often mutating or vanishing entirely due to bounded perspective views. To resolve this issue, we propose OmniPersist, a unified framework that couples perspective video generation with panoramic evolution within a single-stage diffusion model, without relying on auxiliary models or initial panoramic inputs. To maintain efficiency, we model the panoramic stream at a lower frame rate, bridging both views across space and time via Geometric Anchoring (GeoAnch) for spatial correspondence and Temporal Compensation (TemComp) for temporal aggregation. OmniPersist is agnostic to camera-control architectures, supporting both latent-level and attention-level conditioning. Extensive experiments on a newly constructed dynamic benchmark across image-to-video and video continuation tasks demonstrate consistent gains in visual quality, camera controllability, revisit consistency, and dynamic persistence.

摘要（中文）：基于动作的条件世界模型在机器人和自动驾驶领域发挥着至关重要的作用，然而现有的视频扩散模型在维持动态物体持续性方面存在不足。当相机转离后又返回时，视野外的运动实体无法在潜在空间中合理演化，往往因有限的视角范围而发生变异或完全消失。为解决这一问题，我们提出了OmniPersist，一个统一框架，在单阶段扩散模型中将透视视频生成与全景演化相结合，无需依赖辅助模型或初始全景输入。为保持效率，我们以较低的帧率建模全景流，并通过几何锚定（GeoAnch）实现空间对应，通过时间补偿（TemComp）实现时间聚合，从而在空间和时间上桥接两个视角。OmniPersist与相机控制架构无关，支持潜在层级和注意力层级的条件控制。在新构建的动态基准上，针对图像到视频和视频延续任务的大量实验表明，该方法在视觉质量、相机可控性、重访一致性和动态持续性方面均取得了一致的提升。

Authors: Zhilu Zhang, Xiaoyu Liu, Wenxi Liu, Shengfeng He

Instant LiDAR: Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction for LiDAR Simulation AutonomousDriving

LiDAR reconstruction feed-forward Gaussian assets autonomous driving simulation multi-frame consolidation

简要说明：Instant LiDAR 是一种前馈式 LiDAR 重建方法，可将激光雷达扫描重建为可复用的高斯资产，用于闭环自动驾驶仿真，重建速度比现有方法快 46-70 倍，同时保持下游检测精度。

TLDR: Instant LiDAR is a feed-forward pipeline that reconstructs LiDAR scans into reusable Gaussian assets for closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, achieving 46-70x faster reconstruction than prior methods while maintaining downstream detection accuracy.

Abstract: LiDAR reconstruction supports closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, but hours of per-scene optimization make large asset libraries costly to build and maintain. We present Instant LiDAR, a feed-forward pipeline that reconstructs multiple LiDAR scans as reusable Gaussian assets in minutes without per-scene optimization. LiDAR measurements provide strong geometric priors, but directly initializing Gaussians from them yields poor reconstruction due to nonuniform sampling and a limited field of view. Sparse returns leave surface gaps, while combining scans expands coverage but introduces redundant primitives. To address these challenges, Instant LiDAR combines measurement-anchored Gaussian prediction, sampling-aware Gaussian scales, and multi-frame consolidation. The predictor refines attributes anchored to recorded returns, while the scales adapt spatial support to LiDAR sampling. Multi-frame consolidation merges overlapping predictions into a compact asset spanning the driving log. Compared with NuRec, Instant LiDAR reconstructs scenes approximately 46 times faster on Physical AI (PAI) and 70 times faster on Waymo. It also achieves comparable downstream 3D detection accuracy on Waymo.

摘要（中文）：激光雷达重建支持闭环自动驾驶仿真，但每场景数小时的优化使得大型资产库的构建与维护成本高昂。我们提出Instant LiDAR，一种前馈式流水线，能在数分钟内将多次激光雷达扫描重建为可复用的高斯资产，无需逐场景优化。激光雷达测量提供了强大的几何先验，但直接从中初始化高斯体会因非均匀采样和有限视场导致重建质量不佳。稀疏回波导致表面存在间隙，而合并扫描虽扩大了覆盖范围，却引入了冗余基元。为应对这些挑战，Instant LiDAR结合了测量锚定高斯预测、采样感知高斯尺度以及多帧整合。预测器对锚定于记录回波的属性进行优化，尺度则根据激光雷达采样调整空间支撑范围。多帧整合将重叠预测合并为覆盖整个驾驶日志的紧凑资产。与NuRec相比，Instant LiDAR在Physical AI（PAI）上场景重建速度提升约46倍，在Waymo上提升约70倍，同时在Waymo上实现了相当的下游3D检测精度。

Authors: Xin Kang, Jiahui Huang, Jiawei Ren, Sipeng Zhang, Yu Chen, Weihua Zhang, Junjie Lai

Learning Agent States for Latent Action Modeling WorldModel

Latent action model Agent-state representation Temporal discrimination World-model prediction Unlabeled video

简要说明：本文提出Agent-State LAM，通过联合学习紧凑的智能体状态表示和潜在动作，并引入空间匹配时间判别方法，提升了从无标签视频中恢复动作、下游控制及世界模型预测的性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces Agent-State LAM, a latent action model that learns a compact agent-state representation with spatially matched temporal discrimination to improve action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction from unlabeled video.

Abstract: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-like latents from unlabeled video by coupling frame-pair inference with latent-conditioned prediction, enabling policy and world-model pretraining. However, what the latent must explain depends on the representation space used for action inference and transition prediction. When this space entangles the agent's evolving physical state with visual context, such as background and persistent agent appearance, inferred latents can encode information unrelated to the agent's actions. To address this challenge, we propose Agent-State LAM, which jointly learns a compact agent-state representation and latent actions modeling its transitions. The compact state aggregates dense visual features into a shared space for both action inference and forward prediction. To guide what this state retains, we introduce spatially matched temporal discrimination (SMTD), which trains the state to distinguish its source frame from nearby frames through spatially flexible matching with frozen local visual features. Rather than comparing global frame representations, SMTD scores each frame by emphasizing its strongest local feature matches across spatial locations. This scoring allows background and persistent agent appearance to remain matched across frames despite displacement, making these shared cues less informative for identifying the source frame and encouraging the representation to capture the agent's evolving physical state. Extensive experiments on distracting control tasks and six real robot video datasets demonstrate improved action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM.

摘要（中文）：潜在动作模型（LAMs）通过将帧对推断与潜在条件预测相结合，从未标记的视频中学习类似动作的潜在变量，从而实现策略与世界模型的预训练。然而，潜在变量必须解释的内容取决于用于动作推断和转移预测的表示空间。当该空间将智能体不断演化的物理状态与视觉背景（如背景和持久的智能体外观）纠缠在一起时，推断出的潜在变量可能编码与智能体动作无关的信息。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了智能体状态潜在动作模型（Agent-State LAM），该模型联合学习一个紧凑的智能体状态表示及其转移的潜在动作建模。紧凑状态将密集的视觉特征聚合到一个共享空间中，用于动作推断和前向预测。为了引导该状态所保留的内容，我们引入了空间匹配的时间判别（SMTD），该机制通过空间灵活的匹配与冻结的局部视觉特征，训练状态区分其来源帧与邻近帧。SMTD并非比较全局帧表示，而是通过强调每帧在空间位置上的最强局部特征匹配来对其进行评分。这种评分允许背景和持久的智能体外观即使发生位移也能在各帧之间保持匹配，使得这些共享线索在识别来源帧时信息量降低，从而鼓励表示捕捉智能体不断演化的物理状态。在干扰控制任务和六个真实机器人视频数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在动作恢复、下游控制及世界模型预测方面均有所改进。代码和检查点可在 https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM 获取。

Authors: Shaoan Xie, Fan Feng, Peiyuan Zhu, Peter Spirtes, Kun Zhang

EmbodiSafety: Benchmarking Risk Understanding and Response in Embodied AI Other

embodied AI safety risk understanding safety benchmark trajectory tasks safety alignment

简要说明：本文提出了 EmbodiSafety，一个用于评估具身 AI 系统风险理解和安全决策的基准，包含 844 个视觉场景中的 1,092 个快照任务和 540 个轨迹任务，并展示了基于 4 万个示例的安全对齐训练能提升小型语言模型的安全决策准确率。

TLDR: This paper introduces EmbodiSafety, a benchmark for evaluating risk understanding and safe decision-making in embodied AI systems, with 1,092 snapshot and 540 trajectory tasks across 844 visual scenarios, and shows that safety-alignment training on 40k examples improves the safety decision accuracy of small language models.

Abstract: Progress in embodied foundation models is largely measured by task success, while the physical safety of their decisions remains underexamined. Safety evaluations centered on rule following and binary judgments do not adequately assess whether embodied models understand environmental hazards and make safe decisions. We introduce EmbodiSafety, comprising 1,092 snapshot tasks and 540 trajectory tasks across 844 visual scenarios to assess safety over short and long horizons. Six response modes cover direct execution, refusal, clarification, constrained execution, autonomous recovery, and human escalation. Distinguishing recovery from human intervention makes the boundary of safe autonomy an explicit evaluation target. Our protocol assesses mode correctness, risk identification, and actionable handling, with complete decision accuracy requiring all applicable checks to pass. Claude-Opus-5.5 achieves the highest complete decision accuracy among reference models, reaching 56.1% on snapshots and 61.5% on trajectories. We further develop a data construction pipeline and curate 40k examples for safety alignment. Supervised training on this corpus raises the complete decision accuracy of Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3.5-4B.

摘要（中文）：体现基础模型的进展主要依据任务成功率来衡量，而其决策的物理安全性仍缺乏充分审视。以规则遵循和二元判断为核心的安全评估，无法充分判断体现模型是否理解环境危害并做出安全决策。我们提出EmbodiSafety，包含1,092个快照任务和540个轨迹任务，覆盖844个视觉场景，用以评估短时与长时范围内的安全性。六种响应模式涵盖直接执行、拒绝、澄清、受限执行、自主恢复和人工升级。将恢复与人工干预加以区分，使安全自主的边界成为明确的评估目标。我们的协议评估模式正确性、风险识别和可操作处理，完整决策准确率要求所有适用检查均通过。参考模型中，Claude-Opus-5.5在完整决策准确率上表现最佳，快照任务达56.1%，轨迹任务达61.5%。我们进一步构建数据生成流水线，并整理4万条样本用于安全对齐。基于该语料库的监督训练将Qwen3.5-2B和Qwen3.5-4B的完整决策准确率显著提升。

Authors: Erfei Cui, Shengjia Zhao, Yan Qin, Kaixuan Wang, Junming Chen, Ping Luo, Tianxing Chen

At the Limit: Autonomous Vehicle Drifting under Generative Policies AutonomousDriving

autonomous drifting online reinforcement learning flow policies stochastic differential equations agile control

简要说明：本文提出了一种在线强化学习方法，结合SDE采样和基于价值的策略优化，在仿真中实现自动驾驶车辆漂移控制，支持从零训练和从演示微调，提高跟踪精度和鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper proposes an online reinforcement learning method for flow policies that combines SDE sampling with value-based optimization, enabling autonomous vehicle drifting on circular and figure-eight paths in simulation. The method supports both training from scratch and fine-tuning from demonstrations, achieving real-time drift control with improved tracking, success rates, and robustness.

Abstract: Autonomous drifting requires agile control despite tire-force saturation and highly nonlinear vehicle dynamics. We propose an online reinforcement learning method for flow policies that combines stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling for exploration with value-based policy optimization. This method supports both training from scratch and fine-tuning a policy pretrained on expert demonstrations. After training, control actions can be generated using either SDEs or ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Experiments on circular and eight-shaped drifting in an F1TENTH digital twin platform show that both training strategies can achieve effective real-time drift control, with tighter tracking, higher success rates, and better robustness under noisy conditions.

摘要（中文）：自主漂移要求在轮胎力饱和及高度非线性车辆动力学条件下仍具备敏捷控制能力。我们提出了一种面向流策略的在线强化学习方法，该方法将随机微分方程（SDE）采样用于探索，并结合基于值的策略优化。该方法既支持从零开始训练，也支持对在专家演示上预训练的策略进行微调。训练完成后，控制动作既可基于随机微分方程生成，也可基于常微分方程（ODE）生成。在F1TENTH数字孪生平台上进行的圆形及“8”字形漂移实验表明，两种训练策略均能实现有效的实时漂移控制，具有更紧致的轨迹跟踪、更高的成功率，并在噪声条件下表现出更强的鲁棒性。

Authors: Jie He, Meixun Qu, Cheng Hu, Lei Xie, Ezio Bartocci, Radu Grosu

CAPER: PartGround and PlanRefine for Reliable Manual-Guided Robotic Assembly Planning VLA

robotic assembly planning vision-language models part grounding evidence refinement finite inventory consistency

简要说明：CAPER 通过 PartGround 和 PlanRefine 模块，利用视觉语言模型结合库存感知的部件匹配，从手册中可靠生成装配流程，减少部件 ID 错误和库存不一致问题。

TLDR: CAPER introduces PartGround and PlanRefine modules that use visual-language models with inventory-aware grounding to reliably generate assembly procedures from manuals, reducing part-ID errors and inventory inconsistencies in robotic assembly planning.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) used in robot task planning to derive assembly procedures from existing manuals may correctly interpret individual assembly actions yet confuse exact part identities, predict unsupported Part IDs, or produce inconsistent parts across assembly steps. Thus, we propose CAPER (Capacity-Aware Part-grounding and Evidence Refinement), a manual-guided robotic assembly framework that enables VLMs to generate assembly procedures with two modules--PartGround and PlanRefine. PartGround aligns step-level manual evidence with product-specific inventory and part-reference information to identify exact Part IDs and quantities, transforming free-form hardware prediction into evidence-guided assignments represented in a shared Assembly Intermediate Representation (Assembly IR). PlanRefine audits PartGround assignments against finite inventory by removing the lowest-confidence assignments. Uncertain identity cases remain marked for review in the Assembly IR. We evaluate CAPER on the IKEA Assembly in the Wild (IAW) dataset. Experiment results show that CAPER reaches a Finite-inventory Consistency Rate of 83.33% and produces zero observed out-of-inventory Part-ID occurrences. At the plan level, PlanRefine removes all observed inventory-overuse pairs (9 -> 0) and excess units (51 -> 0). Overall, the results indicate that PartGround and PlanRefine improve part reliability, while also enhancing finite-inventory consistency and local prediction accuracy. Project page and video: https://xhzzzz123.github.io/CAPER/

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在机器人任务规划中用于从现有手册推导装配程序时，可能能够正确解释单个装配动作，却容易混淆具体的零件身份，预测出不存在的零件编号，或在装配步骤之间生成不一致的零件。为此，我们提出了CAPER（容量感知的零件定位与证据细化），一种基于手册引导的机器人装配框架，通过两个模块——PartGround和PlanRefine——使VLMs能够生成装配程序。PartGround将步骤级手册证据与产品特定库存及零件参考信息对齐，以识别确切的零件编号和数量，将自由形式的硬件预测转化为由证据引导的分配结果，并以统一的装配中间表示（Assembly IR）呈现。PlanRefine通过移除置信度最低的分配结果，对照有限库存审计PartGround的分配结果。身份不确定的情况仍在Assembly IR中标记以供复核。我们在野外宜家装配（IAW）数据集上评估了CAPER。实验结果表明，CAPER的有限库存一致性率达到83.33%，并且观测到的超出库存的零件编号出现次数为零。在规划层面，PlanRefine消除了所有观测到的库存超用配对（从9降至0）及多余单元（从51降至0）。总体而言，结果表明PartGround和PlanRefine提高了零件的可靠性，同时增强了有限库存一致性及局部预测准确性。项目页面和视频：https://xhzzzz123.github.io/CAPER/

Authors: Hanzhao Xi, Zhonghao Li, Suxuan Liu, Shanghan Zhou, Zesheng Chen, Qiufeng Wang, Yaran Chen

DOPER: Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited Perception3D

6D pose estimation keypoint prediction Perspective-n-Point multi-view geometric supervision real-time RGB pose

简要说明：DOPER 提出了一种基于 RGB 的 6D 物体姿态估计框架，通过共享骨干网络联合学习检测、分割和关键点，结合合成训练、部分真实监督和多视图几何约束，在多个基准上实现了实时最先进性能。

TLDR: DOPER presents an RGB-based 6D object pose estimation framework that jointly learns detection, segmentation, and keypoints with a shared backbone, using synthetic training, partial real supervision, and geometric multi-view constraints, achieving real-time state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.

Abstract: We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.

摘要（中文）：我们提出DOPER，一种RGB姿态估计框架，该框架在目标检测、分割和关键点预测之间共享视觉主干网络，通过透视n点（Perspective-n-Point）方法恢复已知物体的6D姿态。从合成训练出发，DOPER利用部分监督适应真实观测，同时保留合成关键点标签。标定后的多视角观测为关键点监督提供几何约束。在推理阶段，可选的热图细化直接将刚体姿态拟合到预测的关键点分布上，无需深度输入或学习式姿态精化器即可解决模糊对应问题。从欠限定的CAD模型开始，DOPER逐步优化物体表示和姿态估计器。在SPEED+和SHIRT上的实验结果进一步证明了该方法对光照变化的有效适应性和准确的时间姿态估计能力。在评估的单视角和多视角配置中，DOPER在仅使用RGB且实时运行（单块GB300上每个物体模型35 Hz）的条件下，在HANDAL、HOPEv2、HOT3D和T-LESS上取得了最先进的检测AP结果。这些结果验证了联合学习检测与姿态关键点的有效性，并展示了真实观测与几何约束的协同作用。

Authors: Hugo Hadfield, Alperen Degirmenci, Jonathan Tremblay

Semidefinite Programming for Cold-Start GNSS Doppler-Based Alignment: A Comparison with Nonlinear Least Squares AutonomousDriving

GNSS Doppler alignment semidefinite programming nonlinear least squares integrated navigation driving datasets

简要说明：本文比较了半定规划（SDP）和非线性最小二乘（NLS）在GNSS多普勒初始化姿态对齐中的应用，表明模块化SDP认证器能以较低延迟恢复全局精度，并保留协方差输出，适用于真实驾驶数据集。

TLDR: This paper compares semidefinite programming (SDP) and nonlinear least squares (NLS) for GNSS Doppler-based initialization of attitude alignment in integrated navigation, showing that a modular SDP certifier can recover global accuracy at lower latency and preserving covariance outputs for real-world driving datasets.

Abstract: Initial attitude alignment between local navigation frames and the Earth-centered Earth-fixed (ECEF) frame is a critical prerequisite for multi-sensor integrated navigation, such as Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)/inertial/odometry fusion, before global and local measurements can be jointly processed. While GNSS Doppler-based alignment eliminates the need for carrier-phase ambiguity resolution or multi-antenna hardware, solving this non-convex problem via local nonlinear least squares (NLS) suffers from local minima, whereas direct semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation incurs high latency and omits local covariance outputs. This study systematically compares NLS and SDP on a unified maximum-likelihood Doppler objective across Monte Carlo simulations and three real-world driving datasets. We demonstrate that attaching a modular dual SDP certifier to a standard manifold NLS solver recovers the global accuracy of direct SDP within 0.001 degrees, reduces real-world 95th-percentile yaw errors from over 86 degrees down to 2.88 degrees to 4.70 degrees, and cuts median solve times by up to an order of magnitude while preserving native Jacobian covariances. We conclude that candidate-driven certification bridges local estimation and global optimization due to two structural advantages: (1) our theoretical comparison reveals that SDP relaxation enlarges the feasible region while preserving the lifted cost, allowing Lagrangian duality to verify whether a fixed NLS candidate attains the global lower bound without invoking a full SDP solver, and (2) the candidate-driven architecture acts as a non-intrusive module that plugs directly into existing navigation pipelines without replacing the local estimator, preserving native tangent-space covariance outputs and low typical latency.

摘要（中文）：初始导航坐标系与地心地固坐标系之间的姿态对准是多传感器组合导航（如全球导航卫星系统/惯性/里程计融合）在全球与局部测量联合处理之前的关键前提。尽管基于全球导航卫星系统多普勒的对准方法无需载波相位模糊度解算或多天线硬件，但通过局部非线性最小二乘求解该非凸问题易陷入局部极小值，而直接采用半定规划松弛则存在高延迟且无法输出局部协方差。本研究在统一的最大似然多普勒目标函数下，系统比较了非线性最小二乘与半定规划在蒙特卡洛仿真及三组真实驾驶数据集中的表现。我们证明，在标准流形非线性最小二乘求解器上附加模块化双半定规划验证器，可在0.001度精度范围内恢复直接半定规划的全局精度，将真实场景中第95百分位航向误差从超过86度降至2.88度至4.70度，并将中位求解时间缩短至多一个数量级，同时保留原生雅可比协方差。我们得出结论，基于候选解的验证方法之所以能够弥合局部估计与全局优化之间的鸿沟，得益于两项结构性优势：（1）理论比较揭示，半定规划松弛在保持提升代价的同时扩大了可行域，使得拉格朗日对偶性能够在不调用完整半定规划求解器的情况下验证固定非线性最小二乘候选解是否达到全局下界；（2）候选驱动架构作为一种非侵入式模块，可直接嵌入现有导航流程而无需替换局部估计器，从而保留原生切空间协方差输出并维持较低典型延迟。

Authors: Baoshan Song

A Face Robot which Imitates Human Musculoskeletal Skin System and Its Evaluation on Basic Movement of Facial Expression HumanoidEmbodied

facial robot musculoskeletal system FACS action units wire-driven muscles silicone skin

简要说明：本文提出一种解剖学启发的面部机器人，复制人体肌肉骨骼分层结构，使用65条线驱动肌肉复现FACS动作单元，在皮肤附着后实现47个AU中的30个。

TLDR: This paper presents an anatomically inspired facial robot replicating human musculoskeletal layers with 65 wire-driven muscles to reproduce FACS action units, achieving 30 of 47 AUs after skin attachment.

Abstract: Facial robots require many coordinated, smallamplitude motions, but accommodating these motions in a compact face remains difficult. This paper presents an anatomically inspired facial-robot platform that reproduces the layered organization of the human facial musculoskeletal system. The platform comprises bone, muscle, and skin components whose geometry, shape, and attachment locations are derived from three-dimensional anatomical data. Wire-driven, compliant muscle components are routed through PTFE tubes, allowing actuation to be placed away from the face. We describe the selection and fabrication of 65 muscles (34 muscle types) required to reproduce the 47 target action units (AUs) in the Facial Action Coding System (FACS). We then evaluate the reproducibility of individual AUs in two stages: muscle actuation without skin and actuation after the silicone skin is attached. Forty of the 47 target AUs were reproduced with the muscle components, and 30 were reproduced after skin attachment. These results demonstrate the feasibility of reproducing a broad range of FACS facial expressions using an anatomically inspired musculoskeletal structure. The proposed platform provides a foundation for the systematic development and evaluation of future anatomically inspired facial robots

摘要（中文）：面部机器人需要大量协调的小幅度运动，但在紧凑的面部结构中实现这些运动仍具挑战。本文提出了一种基于解剖学启发的面部机器人平台，可再现人类面部肌肉骨骼系统的分层组织结构。该平台由骨骼、肌肉和皮肤组件构成，其几何形状、形态及附着位置均依据三维解剖数据确定。线驱动、柔顺的肌肉组件穿过聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）管进行布线，使得驱动装置可远离面部放置。我们描述了为复现面部动作编码系统（FACS）中47个目标动作单元（AUs）所需的65块肌肉（34种肌肉类型）的选取与制作过程，并在两个阶段评估了各动作单元的可复现性：无皮肤状态下的肌肉驱动，以及硅胶皮肤贴合后的驱动。结果显示，47个目标动作单元中，有40个可通过肌肉组件复现，皮肤贴合后有30个可复现。这些结果证明了利用解剖学启发的肌肉骨骼结构复现FACS中广泛面部表情的可行性。所提出的平台为未来系统化开发与评估解剖学启发式面部机器人奠定了基础。

Authors: Shun Kaneko, Shunnosuke Yoshimura, Akihiro Miki, Kento Kawaharazuka, Kei Okada

Does Research-Paper Context Improve LLM-Generated Quadruped Navigation? An Exploratory Simulation Study Locomotion

quadruped navigation LLM code generation research paper context Isaac Sim incremental replanning

简要说明：本文测试了将研究论文作为上下文是否有助于提升LLM生成的四足机器人导航代码，发现物理仿真下可能降低鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper tests whether providing research papers as context improves LLM-generated quadruped navigation code, finding that it can hurt robustness under physics simulation.

Abstract: Large language models can write competent robot navigation code, but not only does the research on the topic advance, a model may also, due to the volume of findings, fail to recall relevant findings and apply them to the task at hand. In this work, we test whether providing particular research papers as context improves the LLM-written navigation code for the Go2 quadruped, with the LLM (Claude Opus 5) and locomotion policy frozen. Specifically, we compare the navigation controllers the LLM writes when provided with and without particular papers across three settings: behavior trees, navigators edited from a shared base, and controllers written from scratch. When a maze's shortest route is blocked mid-episode, 2 of 8 controllers written with the context of an incremental-replanning paper complete all four trips under Isaac Sim physics, against 7 of 8 without it (two-sided Fisher's exact test, p = 0.041). This difference appears only under physics: in an idealized kinematic simulator, the controllers written with and without the paper are indistinguishable. We hypothesize that an LLM provided research papers as context tends to overweight both their content and their goals -- in this case, the efficiency of incremental replanning -- negatively affecting the fulfillment of the main task and leading to less robust code.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型能够编写出胜任的机器人导航代码，但相关研究不断推进的同时，模型也可能因文献数量庞大而无法回忆起相关发现并将其应用于当前任务。在本研究中，我们测试了将特定研究论文作为上下文提供给模型，是否能改进针对Go2四足机器人所生成的LLM导航代码，其中LLM（Claude Opus 5）和运动策略均保持固定不变。具体而言，我们在三种设置下比较了LLM在提供和不提供特定论文时所编写的导航控制器：行为树、从共享基础版本修改而来的导航器，以及从零编写的控制器。当迷宫的最短路径在运行中途被阻断时，在提供增量重规划论文上下文的情况下，8个控制器中有2个能够在Isaac Sim物理仿真下完成全部四次行程，而在未提供该论文的情况下，这一数字为8个中的7个（双尾Fisher精确检验，p = 0.041）。这一差异仅在物理仿真条件下出现：在理想化的运动学仿真器中，有无论文上下文所编写的控制器之间没有显著区别。我们推测，当LLM获得研究论文作为上下文时，往往会过度强调论文的内容及其目标——在本案例中即为增量重规划的效率——从而对主要任务的完成产生负面影响，并导致生成的代码鲁棒性下降。

Authors: Barnabas Juhasz, Rolf Pfister

GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM Perception3D

Gaussian splatting SLAM Omnidirectional camera LiDAR depth UAV platform Depth-Aware Map Extension and Pruning

简要说明：GOLD-SLAM 是一个利用全景相机和 LiDAR 深度的高斯泼溅 SLAM 系统，在球面域进行跟踪和建图，实现了高质量的渲染和精确的几何重建，并引入了新方法和数据集。

TLDR: GOLD-SLAM is a Gaussian-splatting SLAM system that uses panoramic cameras and LiDAR depth to achieve high-quality rendering and accurate geometric reconstruction, with new methods for mapping in spherical domains and a dataset for evaluation.

Abstract: Panoramic cameras capture nearly the entire spherical field of view in a single frame. However, the mismatch between this panoramic coverage and the field of view of LiDAR poses a substantial challenge for panoramic Gaussian splatting SLAM that relies on LiDAR depth priors. We introduce GOLD-SLAM, a Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM system that combines high-quality rendering with accurate geometric reconstruction. It performs tracking and mapping in the spherical domain and uses tracked visual features in regions without LiDAR coverage to improve pose estimation. To address insufficient coverage of newly observed surfaces and floating artifacts during incremental mapping, we introduce Depth-Aware Map Extension and Pruning (DAEP). To enable broader evaluation, we collect a new dataset, WHOLE, using a UAV platform across Weak-geometry, High-dynamic, Omnidirectional, Low-light, and Easy scenarios. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and WHOLE demonstrate competitive rendering quality and improved geometric accuracy relative to perspective systems. Compared with existing panoramic baselines, GOLD-SLAM improves mean PSNR by 5.56-9.10 dB and reduces mean Depth-L1 by 71.9-83.9%. To assess deployment feasibility on resource-constrained platforms such as UAVs, we evaluate an embedded configuration of GOLD-SLAM on a Jetson Orin NX (16 GB), demonstrating online operation at the cost of reconstruction quality.

摘要（中文）：全景相机能够在单帧图像中捕获近乎完整的球面视野。然而，全景覆盖范围与激光雷达视场之间的不匹配，给依赖激光雷达深度先验的全景高斯溅射SLAM带来了巨大挑战。我们提出了GOLD-SLAM，一种高斯溅射全向激光雷达深度SLAM系统，它将高质量渲染与精确的几何重建相结合。该系统在球面域中进行跟踪与建图，并利用激光雷达未覆盖区域中的跟踪视觉特征来改善位姿估计。为了解决增量建图过程中新观测表面覆盖不足及漂浮伪影的问题，我们引入了深度感知地图扩展与剪枝（DAEP）方法。为了进行更广泛的评估，我们使用无人机平台收集了一个新数据集WHOLE，涵盖弱几何、高动态、全向、低光照和简单场景。在公开基准和WHOLE数据集上的大量实验表明，与透视系统相比，GOLD-SLAM在渲染质量和几何精度方面均具有竞争力。与现有的全景基线方法相比，GOLD-SLAM将平均PSNR提升了5.56-9.10 dB，并将平均深度L1误差降低了71.9-83.9%。为了评估在无人机等资源受限平台上的部署可行性，我们在Jetson Orin NX（16 GB）上对GOLD-SLAM的嵌入式配置进行了评测，结果表明其能够以牺牲重建质量为代价实现在线运行。

Authors: Weicong Zhang, Yuan Huang, Yu Zheng, Lin Chenxiao, Yingying Li, Lilong Fan, Liangdong Zhuang, Yufan Chen, Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Jiaming Zhang

Effect-Driven Skill Abstractions for Offline Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

offline RL skill abstraction effect-driven action chunk goal-conditioned RL

简要说明：本文提出一种新的技能抽象方法，基于动作对状态的影响对动作块进行聚类，以改进离线RL中的长时程目标条件控制，并在导航和操作任务中展示了改进。

TLDR: This paper proposes a novel skill abstraction method for offline RL that clusters action chunks based on their effects on the state, enabling better long-horizon goal-conditioned control, and demonstrates improvements in navigation and manipulation tasks.

Abstract: We seek to learn discrete skill abstractions to facilitate long-horizon, goal-conditioned reinforcement-learning (RL) tasks. Recent approaches have shown success by quantizing actions via clustering or reconstruction. However, these objectives lead to skills that are not directly related to what the current state affords or what the goal requires. Instead, we argue that goal-directed skills should be driven by \emph{how they affect the state} of the agent. To realize this, we introduce a novel quantization method for action chunks that optimizes next-state predictions conditioned on the current state and action. This objective encourages skills to be distinguished by the future states they lead to, resulting in a vocabulary that spans diverse outcomes reachable from a given state. Our framework can easily be paired with common offline RL methods by replacing their continuous actor head with a discrete one that selects among the learned skills. We can execute these skills in the environment by converting them back to continuous actions using a trained low-level controller. Experiments on benchmark navigation and manipulation tasks largely show substantial and consistent improvements over both the continuous-actor baselines and reconstruction-based discretizations. Our project page can be found at: https://burcukilic.github.io/projects/effect-driven-skill-abstractions/.

摘要（中文）：我们旨在学习离散的技能抽象，以促进长时程、目标条件的强化学习任务。近期的方法通过聚类或重构对动作进行量化，已取得一定成功。然而，这些目标所生成的技能与当前状态所允许的行为或目标所要求的行为并无直接关联。相反，我们认为目标导向的技能应基于其如何影响智能体的状态来驱动。为实现这一点，我们提出了一种新的动作块量化方法，该方法在给定当前状态和动作的条件下优化下一状态的预测。这一目标促使技能根据其带来的未来状态进行区分，从而形成一种涵盖从给定状态可达到的多样化结果的词汇表。我们的框架可以轻松地与常见的离线强化学习方法结合使用，只需将其连续动作头替换为在所学技能中进行选择的离散动作头。通过使用训练好的低级控制器，我们可以将这些技能转换回连续动作，从而在环境中执行。在基准导航与操作任务上的实验表明，相较于连续动作基线和基于重构的离散化方法，我们的方法普遍取得了显著且一致的改进。我们的项目页面见：https://burcukilic.github.io/projects/effect-driven-skill-abstractions/。

Authors: Burcu Kilic, David Drexel, Emre Ugur, Justus Piater

POISE: Curvature-Aware Critic Regularization for Smooth Actor-Critic Control RLRobot

actor-critic smooth control critic regularization curvature-aware continuous control

简要说明：POISE 是一种针对演员-评论家控制的曲率感知批评者正则化方法，通过惩罚贪心动作位移的曲率加权能量来减少连续控制任务中的高频动作振荡，在不修改演员的情况下优于基线方法的平滑性。

TLDR: POISE is a curvature-aware critic regularization method for actor-critic control that reduces high-frequency action oscillations in continuous control tasks by penalizing the curvature-weighted energy of greedy-action shifts, improving smoothness over baselines without modifying the actor.

Abstract: Actor-critic methods achieve high returns in robotic control, yet trained actors exhibit high-frequency action oscillations. Most smoothness methods constrain the actor, whereas PAVE regularizes the critic by separately penalizing action-gradient variation and encouraging negative action curvature. The same gradient change, however, moves the critic's preferred action farther where the critic is flat, and separate penalties do not measure this motion. We characterize this motion through the greedy shift, which approximates greedy-action displacement across state transitions to first order under local concavity. Since displacement alone does not reflect its critic-value consequences, the analysis further shows that the shift's curvature-weighted energy approximates the value lost by retaining the previous greedy action to second order. Based on this relationship, POISE regularizes the curvature-weighted energy along temporal and spatial state displacements. It employs a saddle-free curvature metric and reward-scale-consistent scaling while leaving the actor unchanged. On six continuous control tasks with TD3, POISE reduces the smoothness score on every task by $5.9\times$ on average ($4.5\times$ geometric mean), compared with $2.2\times$ ($1.9\times$) for the strongest baseline, and achieves the lowest score on five tasks. Paired return intervals include zero on four tasks, with a 14% increase on Ant and an 11% decrease on Hopper.

摘要（中文）：演员-评论家方法在机器人控制中取得了高回报，然而训练得到的演员会出现高频动作振荡。大多数平滑方法对演员进行约束，而PAVE则通过对动作梯度变化进行单独惩罚并鼓励负动作曲率来正则化评论家。然而，相同的梯度变化在评论家较为平坦的区域会使评论家偏好的动作移动得更远，而单独的惩罚无法衡量这种移动。我们通过贪婪位移来刻画这一移动，该位移在局部凹性条件下近似贪婪动作在状态转移间的一阶变化。由于位移本身并不反映其评论家值的后果，进一步的分析表明，位移的曲率加权能量近似于保留先前贪婪动作所损失价值的二阶量。基于这一关系，POISE沿时间和空间状态位移对曲率加权能量进行正则化。它采用无鞍点曲率度量和奖励尺度一致的缩放，同时保持演员不变。在六个连续控制任务上，与TD3结合时，POISE在每个任务上的平滑度得分平均降低了$5.9\times$（几何平均$4.5\times$），而最强基线的降幅为$2.2\times$（几何平均$1.9\times$），并在五个任务上取得了最低得分。成对回报区间在四个任务上包含零，其中Ant任务增加14%，Hopper任务减少11%。

Authors: Jeong Woon Lee, Namho Kim, Hyoseok Hwang

Interactive Neural Computers WorldModel

generative world model interactive screen prediction surprise-gated slot memory residual rendering VLM-assisted reasoning

简要说明：本文提出交互式神经计算机，一种从用户操作预测屏幕的生成式世界模型，利用惊喜门控槽记忆、VLM推理和残差渲染，在长时程交互中提高离线内容回忆和文本精度。

TLDR: The paper proposes an Interactive Neural Computer, a generative world model that predicts screens from user actions, using surprise-gated slot memory, VLM-based reasoning, and residual rendering to improve recall and text accuracy in long rollouts.

Abstract: Computers and their interfaces are usually treated as fixed, so a person, or increasingly an AI agent, must adapt to whatever the operating system presents. This is limiting when someone needs a different workflow, or an interface suited to hands-free use or a disability. We explore an overlooked alternative. Rather than training an agent to operate an existing computer, we train a generative model to be the computer, predicting each next screen from past screens and the user's mouse and keyboard actions. Treating a desktop as an interactive world model raises problems that natural-video world models largely avoid. Without a camera pose to index memory, the model must remember content that has left the screen without any geometric cues. Arithmetic in a terminal has to be exactly right, not merely plausible. Small interface text must also stay legible at interactive frame rates. Our Interactive Neural Computer is structured like a Neural Turing Machine and starts to address these problems with three modules trained end to end from pixels and actions. A surprise-gated slot memory, supervised by latent next-frame prediction (MEMORY-JEPA), stores what is off screen. An exploratory query bridge brings in the reasoning of a pretrained VLM, and a residual renderer predicts only the latent changes between frames. In long closed-loop rollouts, our model recalls occluded files in 64.2% of trials (chance is 33.3%), compared with at most 56.0% for recurrent and sliding-window baselines. It also raises terminal-text OCR accuracy from 1.3% to 50.1%. Finally, because the memory is explicit, it can be transplanted at test time to causally change what the model renders.

摘要（中文）：计算机及其界面通常被视为固定不变的，因此一个人，或日益增多的AI智能体，必须适应操作系统所提供的任何界面。当用户需要不同的工作流程，或需要一个适合免提操作或残障人士使用的界面时，这种固定性便成为限制。我们探索了一个被忽视的替代方案。与其训练一个智能体去操作现有计算机，我们训练一个生成模型本身作为计算机，根据过去的屏幕画面以及用户的鼠标和键盘操作，预测下一帧屏幕。将桌面视为一个交互式世界模型，会引发自然视频世界模型在很大程度上回避的问题。由于没有相机位姿来索引记忆，模型必须记住已离开屏幕的内容，而没有任何几何线索。终端中的算术运算必须精确无误，而不仅仅是看似合理。小号界面文本也必须在交互帧率下保持清晰可读。我们的交互式神经计算机，其结构类似于神经图灵机，并通过三个端到端训练（从像素和操作到输出）的模块开始解决这些问题。一个由潜在下一帧预测（MEMORY-JEPA）监督的、带有惊喜门控的槽记忆模块，负责存储屏幕外的内容。一个探索性查询桥接模块引入预训练视觉语言模型的推理能力，而一个残差渲染器仅预测帧之间的潜在变化。在长时间的闭环 rollout（自回归生成）中，我们的模型在64.2%的试验中能回忆起被遮挡的文件（随机概率为33.3%），而循环网络和滑动窗口基线模型的最高准确率为56.0%。该模型还将终端文本的OCR准确率从1.3%提升至50.1%。最后，由于记忆是显式的，可以在测试时进行移植，从而因果性地改变模型所渲染的内容。

ADE: A Zero-Training Unlearning Method for Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models zero-training unlearning closed-form backdoor removal MuJoCo

简要说明：本文提出ADE，一种针对潜在世界模型的零训练闭式遗忘方法，通过分析协方差降阶和级联编辑消除后门触发和过时转移，在MuJoCo基准上优于基线并迁移至DreamerV3。

TLDR: This paper proposes ADE, a zero-training closed-form unlearning method for latent world models, which removes backdoor triggers and stale transitions by analytically downdating covariances and cascading edits across the model, outperforming baselines on MuJoCo benchmarks and transferring to DreamerV3.

Abstract: Latent world models learn compact recurrent dynamics from offline trajectories, yet deployed simulators can retain backdoor triggers or stale transitions from outdated physical regimes. Existing unlearning methods fail in autoregressive physics: gradient updates distort latent manifolds and compound rollout drift, naive output zeroing suppresses valid control responses on trigger onset, and single-step deletion leaves corruption inside recurrent hidden states. We propose Analytical Dynamics Excision (ADE), a deterministic, zero-training closed-form unlearning algorithm for latent world models. Using only cached pretraining moments, ADE recovers retain covariances via single-pass matrix downdating without raw retain data and cascades closed-form edits across the input bottleneck, hidden states, and downstream heads. Pairing orthogonal excision with whitened recurrent damping and mean-preserving affine calibration neutralizes out-of-manifold backdoors and realigns in-manifold shifts without variance collapse. Across four regimes on three MuJoCo benchmarks, ADE outperforms seven tuned baselines on DreamerV1, eliminating HalfCheetah and Hopper velocity-flip triggers $4.4\times$ faster than fine-tuning, and transfers zero-shot to DreamerV3.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型从离线轨迹中学习紧凑的循环动态，然而部署的模拟器可能保留后门触发器或来自过时物理机制的状态转换。现有的遗忘方法在自回归物理场景中失效：梯度更新扭曲潜流形并加剧展开漂移，简单的输出置零在触发启动时抑制有效的控制响应，而单步删除则会在循环隐藏状态中留下污染。我们提出解析动力学切除（ADE），一种确定性的、零训练的闭环遗忘算法，用于潜在世界模型。仅利用缓存的预训练矩，ADE通过单遍矩阵降阶更新恢复保留协方差，无需原始保留数据，并将闭环编辑级联应用于输入瓶颈、隐藏状态和下游头部。将正交切除与白化循环阻尼及均值保持仿射校准相结合，可中和流形外后门并重新对齐流形内偏移，而不会导致方差坍缩。在三个MuJoCo基准的四种场景中，ADE在DreamerV1上优于七个调优基线，消除HalfCheetah和Hopper速度翻转触发器的速度比微调快$4.4\times$，并零样本迁移至DreamerV3。
