Authors: Sirui He, Chi Zhang

SurgGenesis: A Generative Surgical World Model for Future-Aware Surgical Understanding WorldModel

surgical world model video diffusion LoRA future prediction long-tail rebalancing

简要说明：SurgGenesis 是一种生成式手术世界模型，通过三阶段渐进式 LoRA 扩散方法从视频和文本预测未来手术状态，并通过未来感知指标和下游任务增益验证其有效性。

TLDR: SurgGenesis is a generative surgical world model that predicts future surgical states from video and text via a three-stage progressive LoRA diffusion approach, and demonstrates usefulness through future-awareness metrics and action-faithful downstream task gains.

Abstract: Surgical scene understanding is constrained by data scarcity and long-tail class imbalance, as annotating surgical videos demands scarce clinical expertise while rare procedural events remain underrepresented. We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

摘要（中文）：外科场景理解受限于数据稀缺和长尾类别不平衡的问题，因为标注手术视频需要稀缺的临床专业知识，而罕见的手术事件在数据中始终代表性不足。我们通过数据生成来应对这一挑战，提出了SurgGenesis——一个生成式手术世界模型，该模型在潜在空间中从视觉观察和文本手术流程描述中学习未来手术状态的转换，可作为可扩展的手术数据引擎。为了在不发生灾难性遗忘的情况下将大规模视频扩散模型适应于数据稀缺的手术领域，我们引入了一种三阶段渐进式LoRA策略，逐步注入内窥镜视觉先验、手术流程语义和空间运动线索。我们不仅以视觉保真度来评判生成结果，还沿着两条将世界模型与通用生成器区分开来的轴线验证SurgGenesis：(i) 未来感知性，通过将预测的未来与真实未来进行比较，采用GT潜在预测差距和时间跨度分析；(ii) 动作忠实的有用性，通过检查生成的片段是否包含指令所要求的手术三元组，以及使用这些片段来重新平衡长尾事件并驱动下游理解任务（分割、三元组识别、三维重建）是否能够带来动作特定的性能提升。因此，条件化的未来生成与传统长尾采样形成了互补。代码：https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

Authors: Qirui Zhong, Quande Liu, Yang Chen, Cheng Xue

SPAR: Self-Referenced World-Model Rewards for Physical Alignment in Video Generation WorldModel

physical plausibility world-model rewards video generation spatiotemporal refinement inference-time alignment

简要说明：SPAR提出了一种自参考世界模型奖励框架，通过将预测误差与静态帧重复的误差进行比较，使视频生成动态更符合物理合理性，从而提升文本到视频和图像到视频的生成质量。

TLDR: SPAR introduces a self-referenced world-model reward framework that aligns video generation dynamics with physical plausibility by comparing prediction errors against static frame repetitions, enhancing text-to-video and image-to-video generation quality.

Abstract: Generating videos with physically plausible dynamics remains challenging despite advances in visual quality. Latent world models offer predictive signals for evaluating physical plausibility, but higher agreement between predicted and observed features may reflect easier-to-predict scene content rather than more plausible dynamics. We propose \textbf{S}elf-Referenced \textbf{P}hysical \textbf{A}lignment \textbf{R}ewards (\textbf{SPAR}), a framework that uses world-model predictions for inference-time physical alignment. SPAR compares each video's prediction error with that of static clips constructed by repeating its own frames, providing a content-matched reference for evaluating generated dynamics. To account for the uneven spatial and temporal distribution of physical interactions, we introduce a unified \textbf{spatiotemporal reward refinement} strategy. \textbf{Spatial refinement} emphasizes localized prediction discrepancies, while \textbf{temporal refinement} moderates brief error peaks and supplements prediction errors with agreement between predicted and observed feature changes. Evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SPAR improves the physical plausibility of both \textbf{text-to-video generation} and \textbf{image-to-video continuation}, bringing generated dynamics into closer alignment with the physical regularities governing real-world events. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/spar-page/

摘要（中文）：生成具有物理合理动态的视频尽管在视觉质量方面取得了进展，仍然具有挑战性。潜在世界模型为评估物理合理性提供了预测信号，但预测与观察特征之间更高的一致性可能反映的是更容易预测的场景内容，而非更合理的动态。我们提出**自参考物理对齐奖励**（**SPAR**），该框架利用世界模型的预测进行推理时的物理对齐。SPAR将每个视频的预测误差与由重复其自身帧构建的静态片段的预测误差进行比较，为评估生成的动态提供内容匹配的参考。为了考虑物理交互在空间和时间分布上的不均匀性，我们引入了一种统一的**时空奖励精细化**策略。**空间精细化**强调局部预测差异，而**时间精细化**则缓和短暂误差峰值，并用预测与观察特征变化之间的一致性补充预测误差。跨多个基准的评估表明，SPAR提升了**文本到视频生成**和**图像到视频延续**的物理合理性，使生成的动态更贴近支配真实世界事件的物理规律。更多结果和资源请访问 https://gavin-jy.github.io/spar-page/。

Authors: Junyi Zhang, Qichao Wang, Wenzhe Qian, Yuanchuan Wang, Min Zhang

DraftKV: Protecting Persistent Worlds through Hierarchical Streaming Retrieval WorldModel

interactive video world models historical KV cache retrieval CPU offloading tile-wise streaming attention geometric grounding

简要说明：DraftKV 是一种无需训练的框架，通过基于几何基础和查询相关性的历史 KV 缓存检索，并结合 CPU 卸载与分块流式注意力，提升了交互式视频世界模型的长期一致性，同时降低了延迟和 GPU 内存。

TLDR: DraftKV is a training-free framework that improves long-term consistency in interactive video world models by retrieving historical KV caches based on geometric grounding and query relevance, using CPU offloading and tile-wise streaming attention to reduce latency and GPU memory.

Abstract: Interactive video world models enable action- and camera-controlled exploration, yet struggle to maintain consistent spatial geometry and appearance when revisiting previously explored locations. Historical KV caches help auto-regressive video diffusion models maintain long-term consistency, but their retrieval and attention computation introduce substantial latency as history grows. We propose DraftKV, a training-free framework that retrieves historical KV caches based on geometric grounding and query-conditioned relevance, while combining CPU offloading with tile-wise streaming attention to reduce GPU memory usage and inference latency. Theoretically, we show that draft relevance reproduces the mean branch of full-resolution block relevance exactly, so its deviation is confined to the $β$-weighted max branch, and we bound retrieval utility loss in terms of the measured Top-K selection overlap. We further show that draft relevance cannot distinguish blocks with similar pooled descriptors regardless of camera pose, motivating geometric grounding before refinement. Then, we introduce streaming CG-Attention, which overlaps CPU-to-GPU KV transfers with attention computation through tile-wise streaming, hiding transfer latency while maintaining bounded GPU memory usage. Experiments across diverse model families show that DraftKV achieves superior generation quality and consistency while achieving $3.27\times$ end-to-end speedup and 42.2% peak GPU memory reduction over other CPU-offloaded KV cache retrieval methods. Notably, DraftKV enables high-quality interactive world generation with historical KV retrieval on a single H100 GPU using SolarWM-33B.

摘要（中文）：交互式视频世界模型支持动作和相机控制的探索，但在重新访问先前探索过的位置时，难以保持一致的空间几何结构和外观。历史KV缓存有助于自回归视频扩散模型维持长期一致性，但随着历史增长，其检索和注意力计算会引入显著延迟。我们提出DraftKV，一种无需训练的框架，基于几何锚定和查询条件相关性检索历史KV缓存，同时将CPU卸载与分块流式注意力相结合，以降低GPU内存使用和推理延迟。理论上，我们证明草稿相关性能够精确重现全分辨率块相关性的均值分支，因此其偏差仅局限于β加权最大值分支，并基于实测的Top-K选择重叠度界定了检索效用的损失。进一步，我们证明草稿相关性无法区分具有相似池化描述符的块（无论相机姿态如何），这促使在细化之前引入几何锚定。随后，我们提出流式CG-Attention，通过分块流式将CPU到GPU的KV传输与注意力计算重叠，在保持GPU内存使用有界的同时隐藏传输延迟。跨多种模型家族的实验表明，DraftKV在生成质量和一致性上均表现优越，与其他CPU卸载的KV缓存检索方法相比，实现了$3.27\times$的端到端加速和42.2%的峰值GPU内存缩减。值得注意的是，DraftKV使得在单个H100 GPU上使用SolarWM-33B能够实现高质量的历史KV检索交互式世界生成。

Authors: Xiaoling Zhou, Haopeng Li, Yufa Zhou, Rui Ding, Yu Li, Jun Lin, Enze Xie, Chunhua Shen, Xuan Shen

TANDEM: Temporal Anchor Densification With Reliability-Aware Memory for Lightweight Sparse Depth Completion in Endoscopic Robotic Navigation Perception3D

sparse depth completion endoscopic robotic navigation temporal memory reliability-aware lightweight

简要说明：TANDEM 是一种用于内窥镜机器人导航的轻量级因果稀疏深度补全框架，通过可靠性感知记忆随时间加密度量深度证据，以 5.58M 参数达到最先进精度。

TLDR: TANDEM is a lightweight causal sparse depth completion framework for endoscopic robotic navigation that densifies metric depth evidence over time using reliability-aware memory, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy with 5.58M parameters.

Abstract: For endoscopic robotic surgery, accurate dense depth perception serves as a foundational capability, which enables navigation, instrument localization, and tissue interaction. However, endoscopic video lacks reliable metric depth, while metric measurements obtained via tracking, time-of-flight sensing, or instrument contact only cover a small fraction of pixels in each frame, rendering sparse depth completion an urgent and unsolved challenge. In this work, we propose Temporal Anchor Densification with Reliability-Aware Memory (TANDEM), a causal sparse depth completion framework for endoscopic video. It adopts a lightweight design and leverages the video stream: past measurements re-projected into the current view recover the metric evidence unavailable within a single sparse frame. To keep this evidence interpretable, accurate, and efficient, an explicit memory scores each re-projected measurement with analytic re-observation, age, and motion-parallax factors without overriding current measurements. A compact network then reconstructs depth via reliability-weighted gradient integration and a frequency-gated reference prior. We evaluate TANDEM on the C3VD colonoscopy and StereoMIS laparoscopy datasets. With only 5.58 M parameters, TANDEM reduces the root mean square error by 11.7% and 32.0%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. It also remains accurate under pose errors of the magnitude reported for endoscopic pose estimation. Code will be released at https://github.com/Wk-cpu-art/TANDEM upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）：对于内窥镜机器人手术而言，准确的密集深度感知是一项基础能力，它为导航、器械定位和组织交互提供了支持。然而，内窥镜视频缺乏可靠的度量深度信息，而通过追踪、飞行时间传感或器械接触获得的度量测量结果仅覆盖每帧中极少数的像素，这使得稀疏深度补全成为一个紧迫且尚未解决的挑战。在本工作中，我们提出了一种名为TANDEM（时间锚点致密化与可靠性感知记忆）的因果稀疏深度补全框架，专用于内窥镜视频。该框架采用轻量级设计，并充分利用视频流：将过去的测量值重新投影至当前视角，以恢复单帧稀疏数据中无法获得的度量证据。为使这些证据保持可解释性、准确性和高效性，显式记忆机制为每个重新投影的测量值评分，综合考虑解析性重观测、时效和运动视差等因素，且不会覆盖当前测量值。随后，一个紧凑型网络通过可靠性加权梯度积分和频率门控参考先验来重建深度。我们在C3VD结肠镜数据集和StereoMIS腹腔镜数据集上对TANDEM进行了评估。仅用558万个参数，TANDEM相比最强基线将均方根误差分别降低了11.7%和32.0%，达到了当前最优精度。在内窥镜姿态估计所报告的幅度的位姿误差下，该框架仍能保持准确性。代码将在论文被接收后于https://github.com/Wk-cpu-art/TANDEM发布。

Authors: Weikuan Qiu, Jiale Hou, Chongzhao Xu, Jinlian Ma

SceneMemBench: A Benchmark for Scene Memory in Interactive Video World Models WorldModel

scene memory interactive video world models novel-view recovery benchmark

简要说明：SceneMemBench 为交互式视频世界模型中的场景记忆评估引入了一个基准，区分了已见视角回忆与新视角恢复、受控诊断与完整交互，并发现新视角恢复更具挑战性，且模型表现特征在两种设置下有所不同。

TLDR: SceneMemBench introduces a benchmark for evaluating scene memory in interactive video world models, distinguishing seen-view recall from novel-view recovery and controlled diagnosis from full interaction, revealing that novel-view recovery is more challenging and that model performance profiles differ between settings.

Abstract: Interactive video world models generate navigable worlds frame by frame, but a persistent world requires previously observed scenes to remain recoverable as users move away and return. Existing memory evaluations, however, often focus on seen-view revisits and full rollouts, leaving cross-view scene recovery underexplored while entangling memory with trajectory-following errors and accumulated generation degradation. We introduce SceneMemBench, a benchmark for scene memory in interactive video world models. It evaluates two complementary dimensions: seen-view recall versus novel-view recovery, and controlled diagnosis versus end-to-end interaction. We introduce Continued Rollout from a shared ground-truth observation history, alongside Full Rollout over complete model-generated interactions. SceneMemBench contains 600 controlled trajectories across 33 Unreal Engine scenes and 60 Full Rollout cases, covering eight representative open- and closed-source models. We evaluate scene recovery along subject consistency, appearance fidelity, and geometric consistency. Results show that novel-view recovery is generally more challenging than seen-view recall, while model profiles under controlled histories can differ markedly from those observed in full interaction. Together, these findings reveal complementary failure modes obscured by seen-view revisits or end-to-end rollouts alone.

摘要（中文）：交互式视频世界模型逐帧生成可导航的世界，但一个持久化的世界要求当用户离开后再返回时，先前观察到的场景仍然可以被恢复。然而，现有的记忆评估往往侧重于已见视角的重访和完整轨迹展开，导致跨视角场景恢复研究不足，同时又将记忆与轨迹跟随误差及生成退化累积问题混为一谈。我们提出了SceneMemBench，一个用于交互式视频世界模型中场景记忆评估的基准。它评估两个互补维度：已见视角回忆与新颖视角恢复，以及受控诊断与端到端交互。我们引入了从共享的真实观测历史出发的持续展开（Continued Rollout），以及覆盖完整模型生成交互的全轨迹展开（Full Rollout）。SceneMemBench包含跨越33个虚幻引擎场景的600条受控轨迹和60个全轨迹展开案例，覆盖了八个具有代表性的开源和闭源模型。我们从主体一致性、外观保真度和几何一致性三个方面评估场景恢复效果。结果表明，新颖视角恢复通常比已见视角回忆更具挑战性，而受控历史条件下的模型表现可能与完整交互中观察到的结果存在显著差异。综上，这些发现揭示了仅通过已见视角重访或端到端展开所掩盖的互补性失败模式。
